corpus_topic: Gift idea capture with budget range tag and recipient
query_text: Make a gift idea tracker for my phone where I can jot down gift ideas for different people in my life, each with a budget range like under 50 dollars or 50 to 100 dollars, and a label for who it is for. I want to be able to add a new idea quickly and browse everything in one place so I stop forgetting good ideas I had months ago.
query_text_zh: 给我的手机做一个礼物创意追踪工具，我可以为生活中的不同人记下礼物想法，每个想法都能标记预算范围（比如50美元以下或50到100美元）和收礼人的名字。我想快速添加新想法，并在一个地方浏览所有的想法，这样就不会忘记几个月前想到的那些好主意。

corpus_topic: Trip itinerary builder from AI-suggested POIs
query_text: Create a trip planner app for mobile where I type in a destination and the app suggests interesting places to visit, then I can pick the ones I like and drag them into a day-by-day schedule. It should be easy to rearrange stops on my phone and see roughly how much time each day looks like so I can have a solid itinerary ready before I travel.
query_text_zh: 帮我开发一个手机版的行程规划应用，输入目的地后应用会推荐有趣的景点，我可以选中喜欢的地点然后按日期拖入日程安排。应该能在手机上轻松调整行程顺序，还能看到每天大概需要多少时间，这样出发前就能有个完整的行程计划。

corpus_topic: Reading list entry with estimated time and priority tag
query_text: Make a reading list manager for my phone where I can save books or articles I want to get to, and for each one I can set how long I think it will take to read and mark it as something to get to soon or just whenever. I want to open the app and quickly add something new or see what I have queued up, sorted by how soon I should tackle it.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机版的阅读列表管理器，我可以保存想要阅读的书籍或文章，为每一项设置预计阅读时间，还能标记为近期要读或随时读。打开应用就能快速添加新内容或查看已有的列表，并且能按优先级排序。

corpus_topic: Pet profile onboarding with health history and photo
query_text: Need a pet profile app for my phone where I can set up a profile for my dog or cat by filling in their name, breed, age, and uploading a photo, and also log their health history like past vet visits, vaccines, and any conditions. The whole thing should feel like a little card for each pet so everything important is in one spot when the vet asks.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机宠物档案应用，我能为我的狗或猫建立档案，填入它们的名字、品种、年龄，还能上传照片。还需要记录健康历史，比如之前的兽医访问、疫苗接种和任何健康状况，这样所有重要信息都在一个地方，兽医问的时候我就能快速展示。

corpus_topic: Social post draft composer with media attach and hashtag
query_text: Need a social post drafting tool on my phone where I can write out a caption, attach a photo or video from my gallery, and add a few hashtags before I decide to post anywhere. I want a clean place to save drafts I am still thinking about, and each draft should show me a rough preview of how it might look so I can tweak the wording before sending.
query_text_zh: 需要手机上一个社交媒体文案草稿工具，我能写下文案，从相册里附加照片或视频，添加几个话题标签，然后决定要发到哪里。我想有个干净的地方保存还在思考的草稿，每个草稿都能显示粗略的预览效果，这样发送前我能调整措辞。

corpus_topic: Product listing creation with variant, price and stock
query_text: Build a product listing creator for mobile where I can fill in a product name, description, price, and how many are in stock, and also add different options like sizes or colors so each variant has its own quantity. I want to tap through each step on my phone and have the listing ready to copy or publish once I fill everything in.
query_text_zh: 帮我做个手机版的商品列表创建工具，我能填写商品名称、描述、价格和库存数量，还能添加尺寸或颜色这样的不同选项，每个变体都有自己的库存量。我想在手机上逐步完成，填完所有信息后列表就可以复制或发布。

corpus_topic: Project kickoff form with team invite and phase timeline
query_text: A project kickoff tool for my phone where I fill out the basic project details, invite teammates by typing in their names or emails, and then lay out the main phases with rough start and end dates so everyone can see the high-level timeline. Each phase should have a spot to describe what the goal is, and the whole thing feels like a simple form I can fill out while sitting in a meeting.
query_text_zh: 想要一个手机项目启动工具，我填写基本项目信息，通过输入名字或邮箱邀请团队成员，然后列出主要阶段和大致的开始结束日期，这样大家都能看到高层的时间表。每个阶段都能有地方描述目标，整个流程就像一个简单表单，我可以在开会时填写。

corpus_topic: Medical appointment scheduler with provider search
query_text: Build a medical appointment scheduler for my phone where I can search for a doctor or clinic by specialty or name, see who is available, and book a time slot with just a few taps. It should remember my basic info so I do not have to retype everything each time, and I can see my upcoming appointments all in one place so nothing slips through.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机医疗预约安排应用，我可以按专科或名字搜索医生或诊所，查看谁有时间，然后只需轻点几下就能预约。应用应该记住我的基本信息，这样我就不用每次都重新输入，还能在一个地方看到所有快要到来的预约，不会有遗漏。

corpus_topic: Subscription enrollment with side-by-side plan comparison
query_text: Build a subscription sign-up tool as a mobile app where I can look at two or three plan options side by side, see what features each one includes and what the price difference is, and then tap to enroll in the one I want. The comparison should be clear enough that I can decide on my phone without squinting at tiny text or missing anything important.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机订阅注册工具，我能并排看到两三个套餐方案，看清每个套餐包含什么功能和价格差异，然后轻点选择想要的。对比应该够清楚，让我在手机上就能决定，不用眯眼看小字或担心遗漏重要信息。

corpus_topic: Report template creation with data-source binding
query_text: Create a report template builder for my phone where I can set up a reusable layout with named fields, then link each field to a data source so the numbers fill in automatically when I run the report. I want to be able to name the template, pick which data to pull into each spot, and save it so I can generate the same report again later without rebuilding it from scratch.
query_text_zh: 给我做个手机版报告模板生成器，我可以设置一个有具名字段的可复用布局，然后把每个字段链接到数据源，这样运行报告时数字就能自动填充。我想给模板命名，选择哪些数据填入每个位置，然后保存，以后就能快速生成同样的报告，不用从零开始。

corpus_topic: Report data field correction with reason and audit trail
query_text: Create a report correction tool for my phone where I can open a report entry, fix the wrong value, and type in a short reason for the change so there is a clear record of why it was updated. Every correction should save a history of the old value, the new value, who changed it, and when, so anyone reviewing the report can follow the trail of edits.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机报告修正工具，我可以打开一条报告记录，修改错误的数值，并输入简短的修改原因，这样就有了清晰的修改记录。每次修正都应该保存历史信息，包括旧值、新值、谁修改了它，以及什么时候修改的，这样任何人查看报告时都能跟踪编辑的历程。

corpus_topic: Setting toggle with instant live preview pane
query_text: Build a settings editor app for mobile where I can flip a toggle or adjust a value and immediately see a live preview of how the change looks, all on one screen on my phone. I want the settings on one side and the preview updating in real time on the other, so I can tweak things until they look right before I save.
query_text_zh: 帮我开发一个手机设置编辑应用，我可以切换开关或调整数值，然后立即在同一个屏幕看到变化的实时预览。我想左边是设置选项，右边是实时更新的预览，这样我可以调整到满意为止再保存。

corpus_topic: Template content edit with version diff compare
query_text: Create a template editing tool for my phone where I can open an existing template, make changes to the content, and then see a side-by-side view comparing my new version to the old one so I know exactly what I changed. It should highlight the differences clearly and let me confirm or roll back before saving, kind of like track changes but simple enough to use on a phone.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机模板编辑工具，我可以打开现有模板，修改内容，然后看到新旧版本的并排对比，这样能清楚地知道改了什么。应该突出显示差异，让我能在保存前确认或回滚修改，有点像跟踪更改，但用手机就足够简单。

corpus_topic: Form field reorder with live preview and confirm
query_text: Make a form builder app for my phone where I can grab a field and move it up or down in the list, then immediately see the form update in a small preview so I can check that the order makes sense. Once I am happy with how it looks I can tap a confirm button and save the new arrangement, and the preview should feel instant so there is no guessing.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机表单生成器应用，我可以拖动字段在列表中上下移动，然后立即在小预览里看到表单的更新效果，确保顺序合理。满意后我就能轻点确认按钮保存新的排列，预览应该是即时的，这样就不用猜测。

corpus_topic: Subscription plan upgrade with prorated cost breakdown
query_text: A subscription upgrade tool for mobile where I tap the plan I want to switch to and the app shows me exactly what I owe for the rest of my current billing period, broken down in plain numbers so I can see the prorated amount before I commit. I want to understand the cost difference clearly on my phone and then confirm the upgrade in one final tap.
query_text_zh: 想要一个手机订阅升级工具，我轻点想要切换到的套餐，应用就会精确显示当前计费周期剩余时间需要支付多少，用清晰的数字分解，这样我能看到分摊的金额再做决定。我想在手机上清楚地了解费用差异，然后再最后轻点一次确认升级。

corpus_topic: Shared resource permission level change with email notify
query_text: Create a sharing manager for my phone where I can open a file or folder, change who has view or edit access, and the app automatically sends an email to anyone whose permission level changed so they know right away. I want to see the current permission list, make adjustments, and have the notifications go out the moment I save the changes.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机分享管理工具，我能打开一个文件或文件夹，改变谁可以查看或编辑，应用会自动给权限改变的人发送邮件，让他们立即知道。我想看到当前的权限列表，做出调整，并在保存更改的同时让通知立即发送出去。

corpus_topic: Tag rename applied globally across all linked items
query_text: Need a tag manager for my phone where I can rename a tag and have that new name automatically update everywhere it is used across all my saved items, so I do not have to hunt down every place it appears. It should show me how many things are linked to that tag before I rename it, just so I know the scope of the change.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机标签管理器，我能重命名标签，这个新名字会自动更新到所有使用这个标签的地方，这样就不用四处寻找每个用到它的位置。应该显示有多少项目链接到这个标签，这样我就知道修改的影响范围。

corpus_topic: Schedule edit with conflict detection and suggestion
query_text: A schedule editing tool for my phone where I can move or resize an event and the app checks for conflicts with other things on my calendar, then shows me a couple of alternative times to pick from if there is a clash. I want it to feel fast on my phone, where I drag something, see any problems flagged right away, and tap a suggested fix to resolve it.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机日程编辑工具，我能移动或调整事件大小，应用会检查日历上是否有冲突，如果有的话就给我几个替代时间选择。我想在手机上感觉流畅，拖动某个东西后立即看到任何问题被标出来，然后轻点一个建议的修复方案。

corpus_topic: Health record correction with doctor approval workflow
query_text: Make a health record correction app for my phone where I can flag an entry that needs fixing, describe what needs to change, and submit it for a doctor to review and approve before the record is actually updated. I want to see the status of each pending correction so I know whether it has been looked at yet, and get notified once the doctor approves or declines.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机健康记录修正应用，我能标记需要修改的记录条目，描述需要怎样改，然后提交给医生审阅批准后记录才会真正更新。我想看到每个待处理修正的状态，知道是否已被查看，一旦医生批准或拒绝就能收到通知。

corpus_topic: Multi-language content update with translation sync panel
query_text: Make a content translation manager for my phone where I can edit the text in one language and see the translated versions lined up alongside it so I can tell at a glance which translations are in sync and which ones still need updating. When I save a change in the original, it should flag the other language versions that are now out of date so I remember to update them too.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机内容翻译管理器，我能编辑某种语言的文本，同时看到翻译版本排列在旁边，这样我一眼就能看出哪些翻译是同步的，哪些还需要更新。当我保存原文的修改时，应该标记出那些现在不是最新的其他语言版本，这样我就记得要去更新它们。

corpus_topic: Federated search across connected data sources
query_text: A search tool for my phone that can look through all the different places my stuff is saved, like notes, documents, and files from connected services, all at once from a single search bar. I want results grouped by where they came from and I can tap into any result to see the full thing, so I stop jumping between different apps just to find one piece of information.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机搜索工具，能同时搜索我保存东西的所有不同地方，比如笔记、文档和连接的服务上的文件，全部从单个搜索栏搜索。我想按来源对结果分组，可以轻点任何结果查看完整内容，这样就不用在不同应用之间跳来跳去来找一条信息。

corpus_topic: Date and time range filter in search results
query_text: Need a search results filter for my mobile app where I can pick a start date and end date to narrow down results to a specific time window, and the results update right away on my phone so I only see things from that period. It should be easy to adjust the range with a couple of taps rather than typing out dates manually.
query_text_zh: 需要为手机应用设计搜索结果过滤器，我能选择开始日期和结束日期来将结果缩小到特定时间范围，结果在手机上立即更新，只显示那个时期的内容。应该能轻松地通过几次轻点来调整范围，而不是手动输入日期。

query_text: Create a smarter search tool for my phone that understands related words so if I search for car it also shows me results about vehicles or automobiles, and if it thinks I may have made a typo it gently suggests the word it thinks I meant before showing results. I want search to actually understand what I am looking for rather than being strict about exact wording.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个更智能的手机搜索工具，它能理解相关词汇，比如我搜索汽车时也能显示车辆或汽车的结果，如果它认为我可能打错了字，就在显示结果前温和地建议我可能想要的词。我想搜索真正理解我的意思，而不是对准确措辞要求严格。

corpus_topic: Search history list with one-tap rerun option
query_text: A search history tracker for my phone where I can see a list of everything I have looked up recently, with the most recent ones at the top, and tap any past search to run it again instantly. I also want to be able to clear individual entries or wipe the whole history when I want a fresh start.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机搜索历史追踪器，我能看到最近查询过的所有内容列表，最新的在最上面，轻点任何之前的搜索就能立即运行它。我还想能清除单个条目或在想要重新开始时擦除整个历史。

corpus_topic: Predictive search for user's recurring queries
query_text: Build a smart search tool for my mobile app that learns the things I search for regularly and starts suggesting them as soon as I open the search bar, before I even type anything. I want it to pick up on patterns from my past searches so the suggestions feel relevant to me personally and I can find the things I look up often in just one tap.
query_text_zh: 帮我开发一个学会记忆的手机搜索工具，它能学会我经常搜索的内容，一打开搜索栏就开始推荐它们，甚至都不用我输入什么。我想让它从我过往的搜索中学会规律，这样建议就能感觉和我个人相关，我能只轻点一次就找到我经常查的东西。

corpus_topic: Offline full-text search in downloaded content
query_text: Need a mobile app that lets me search through all my downloaded articles, notes, and documents even when my phone has no internet, because scrolling through everything manually to find one sentence is such a waste of time. I want a search bar that looks through the full text of everything I've saved, highlights the matching words when I tap on a result, and shows me which file or note they came from so I can jump right to it.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用，让我即使手机没有网络也能搜索已下载的文章、笔记和文档，因为手动滚动浏览一切来找一句话实在是太浪费时间了。我想要一个搜索栏能搜索我保存的一切的完整文本，轻点结果时突出显示匹配的词，并告诉我它们来自哪个文件或笔记，这样我就能直接跳过去。

corpus_topic: Conversation and chat history keyword search
query_text: Create a chat history search tool for my phone that lets me type in a keyword and instantly pulls up every message from any conversation that contains that word, because digging back through hundreds of old chats to find something someone said weeks ago is genuinely painful. The results should show me the contact name, the date, and a short snippet of the message around the matched word so I can tell right away if it's the one I'm looking for.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机聊天历史搜索工具，我能输入关键词，立即显示任何包含这个词的聊天记录中的每条消息，因为要从成百上千条旧聊天中翻出几周前某人说过的某句话简直太痛苦了。结果应该显示联系人名字、日期和消息中匹配词周围的短片段，这样我能立即判断是不是我要找的。

query_text: Build a search app for my phone that automatically figures out which language I'm typing in, whether it's English, Chinese, or a mix of both, and finds the right results without me having to switch any settings manually. It's so annoying to search in one language and get nothing because the app doesn't understand what I typed, so I want it to just detect my input and return matching results across all stored content right away.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机搜索应用，它能自动判断我输入的是什么语言，不管是英语、中文，还是两种混合，然后在不需要我手动切换任何设置的情况下找到正确的结果。用一种语言搜索却什么都找不到是因为应用不明白我输入的什么，这太烦人了，所以我想让它自动检测我的输入并立即返回所有保存内容中的匹配结果。

corpus_topic: Fuzzy person or contact name search with phonetic match
query_text: Build a contact finder app for my phone where I can type a name even if I only remember roughly how it sounds, and the app still surfaces the right person because it matches based on how names sound, not just exact spelling. I always forget if someone spells their name differently or I saved it wrong, so I want results that show close sound-alike matches and let me tap through to their contact details in one go.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机联系人查找应用，我可以输入一个名字，即使我只是大概记得怎么读，应用也能找到对的人，因为它是按名字的发音匹配，而不仅仅是准确拼写。我总是不记得别人的名字是怎么拼的，或者我当初保存错了，所以我想要显示接近的谐音匹配，并让我一次轻点就能看到他们的完整联系方式。

query_text: Create a recipe finder app for my phone where I can type in a few ingredients I have sitting in my fridge and it immediately shows me all the recipes I can actually make with those things, because I always waste time googling and landing on stuff that needs ten more items I don't have. I want to be able to add two or three ingredients, see a list of matching recipes, and tap one to get the full steps right there on my phone.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机食谱查找应用，我能输入我冰箱里现有的几种食材，它立即显示我能用这些东西做的所有食谱，因为我总是浪费时间谷歌搜索最后找到的都是需要十几种我没有的食材的食谱。我想能输入两三种食材，看到匹配的食谱列表，然后轻点一个在手机上就能直接看到完整步骤。

corpus_topic: Comparison mode selection of two or more items side-by-side
query_text: Build a comparison tool for my phone that lets me pick two or more items, like products, options, or plans, and shows them side by side with their key details lined up in matching rows so I can actually see the differences at a glance. I want to be able to tap to add items to the comparison, scroll down through the matching rows together, and then choose the one I want from the same screen once I've decided.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机对比工具，我能选择两个或多个项目，比如产品、选项或方案，并排显示它们和关键信息在匹配的行中对齐，这样我能一眼看出区别。我想能轻点来添加项目到对比中，向下滚动时各匹配行一起动，决定好后就能从同一个屏幕选择想要的。

corpus_topic: AI top-pick suggestions with confidence indicator
query_text: Build a recommendation tool for my phone that gives me a short list of top picks based on what I'm looking for, and next to each suggestion shows a simple indicator of how confident the app is in that recommendation, like a percentage or a small bar so I know whether it's a strong match or just a guess. I like having two or three clear options with the confidence level right there, so I can make a quick choice without second-guessing myself.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机推荐工具，根据我在找什么给我一个短的精选列表，每个建议旁边都有一个简单的指示器显示应用对这个推荐的把握程度，比如百分比或小条，这样我就知道它是强匹配还是只是猜测。我喜欢有两三个清晰选项并且信心指数就在那儿，这样我能快速选择不用自我怀疑。

corpus_topic: Audio track selection with waveform and duration preview
query_text: An audio picker app for my phone where I can browse through all my sound files and see a small waveform picture and the track length listed right next to each one, so I can tell what kind of clip it is before I even tap play. I want to be able to tap a track to hear a quick preview and then confirm my selection, instead of guessing what each file sounds like from the filename alone.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机音频选择器应用，我能浏览我所有的音频文件，看到每个旁边都有小波形图和音轨长度，这样我不用按播放就能判断这是什么类型的音频。我想能轻点一个音轨听个快速预览然后确认选择，而不是根据文件名猜测每个文件听起来怎样。

corpus_topic: Time slot grid selection in scheduling interface
query_text: Build a scheduling planner for my phone where I can look at a grid of time slots across a day or week and tap on the ones I want to book, with each slot showing whether it's open or taken at a glance. I want to be able to select a range of slots by tapping and dragging, see a quick summary of what I've chosen, and confirm the booking all on one screen without jumping back and forth.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机日程规划工具，我能看到一天或一周的时间槽网格并轻点想要预订的那些，每个槽都一眼就能看出是开放的还是被占的。我想能通过轻点拖动来选择一个范围的槽，看到我选择的快速总结，并在同一个屏幕确认预订，不用来回跳跃。

corpus_topic: Language and locale selection with region grouping
query_text: Create a language settings tool for my phone where I can browse through all available languages and regions, grouped by area like Asia, Europe, or Americas, so I can find my choice quickly instead of scrolling through one huge unsorted list. I want a search bar at the top to type in a language name if I know it, and once I tap my choice it should apply right away and show me a confirmation on that same screen.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机语言设置工具，我能浏览所有可用的语言和地区，按地区分组，比如亚洲、欧洲或美洲，这样我能快速找到选项而不是滚动浏览一个巨大的无序列表。我想上面有个搜索栏，能输入我知道的语言名字，轻点选择后应该立即应用并在同一个屏幕显示确认。

corpus_topic: Icon picker for label or category with search
query_text: Create an icon picker for my phone where I can assign a small picture or symbol to each of my categories or labels, with a search bar at the top so I can type a word like 'food' or 'money' and see matching icons instantly instead of scrolling through hundreds of them. I want to be able to tap an icon to select it, see it preview next to the label name, and save it all on one screen without any extra steps.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机图标选择器，我能给我的每个分类或标签分配一个小图片或符号，上面有个搜索栏，我能输入一个词比如食物或金钱，立即看到匹配的图标，而不是滚动浏览成百上千个。我想能轻点图标来选择它，看到它在标签名旁边的预览，并在同一个屏幕保存，不用额外步骤。

corpus_topic: Font family selector with live text preview
query_text: Build a font picker tool for my phone where I can scroll through a list of available fonts and see my own sample text displayed in each one as I browse, so I know exactly what it will look like before I pick it. I want to type a short sentence into a text box at the top, and have that same sentence update live in every font row below so I can compare them side by side and tap to apply the one I like.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机字体选择工具，我能滚动浏览可用字体列表，在浏览时看到我自己的样本文本用每种字体显示，这样我就知道选择前它会是什么样子。我想在上面的文本框输入一个短句子，下面每个字体行都实时用那个句子更新，这样我能并排对比并轻点应用我喜欢的。

corpus_topic: Template gallery selection with full preview and apply
query_text: Need a template picker app for my phone that shows me all available templates in a browsable gallery, where I can tap any one to see a full preview of how it actually looks before applying it, because choosing a template blind and then having to undo it is so annoying. I want a clear confirm button on the preview screen so I can go from browsing to applying in just two taps, without any guesswork about what the result will be.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机模板选择器应用，给我显示一个可浏览的模板库，我能轻点任何一个看完整预览，了解它实际看起来怎样才能应用，因为盲目选择一个模板然后不得不撤销太烦人了。预览屏幕上有个清晰的确认按钮，我能从浏览到应用只需两次轻点，不用对结果有任何猜测。

corpus_topic: Subscription plan comparison table with selection CTA
query_text: Build a subscription plan picker for my phone that lists all available plans in a clean side-by-side layout, with the features and prices lined up in matching rows so I can actually compare them without squinting. I want each plan to have a clearly visible choose button right under it, and tapping one should take me straight to the checkout or confirmation screen so I can finish signing up without hunting around.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机订阅方案选择器，列出所有可用方案用清晰的并排布局，特性和价格都对齐在匹配的行里，这样我能真正对比而不用眯眼看。每个方案在它下面都有个清晰可见的选择按钮，轻点一个应该直接带我去结账或确认屏幕，这样我能完成注册不用四处寻找。

corpus_topic: Venue seat map selection with availability color
query_text: Need a seat picker app for my phone that shows a map of the venue with all the seats laid out, where each seat is colored differently depending on whether it's available, taken, or reserved, so I can see what's open at a glance. I want to tap a seat to select it, see the seat number and price pop up, and be able to pick a couple of seats in a row before tapping confirm to move on.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机座位选择器应用，显示场地的地图，所有座位都铺开，每个座位根据是否可用、已占或已预留用不同颜色表示，这样我能一眼看到什么是开放的。我想能轻点座位来选择它，看到座位号和价格弹出来，能在轻点确认继续前选择一排中的几个座位。

corpus_topic: Difficulty level filter in education quiz list
query_text: Create a quiz practice app for my phone where I can filter the question list by difficulty level, like easy, medium, or hard, so I can focus on the questions that actually match where I am right now instead of wading through a pile of stuff that's way too simple or way over my head. I want the filter to be simple buttons at the top of the list, and the questions should update on the spot when I tap a level so I can get practicing right away.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机测验练习应用，我能按难度级别过滤问题列表，比如简单、中等或困难，这样我能专注于真正和我现在水平匹配的问题，而不是被堆积的太简单或太难的东西淹没。我想过滤器就是列表上面的简单按钮，轻点一个级别时问题立即更新，这样我能立即开始练习。

corpus_topic: Time slot availability filter in booking calendar
query_text: Need a booking app for my phone where I can look at a calendar and filter the time slots to only show the ones that are actually open, because scrolling past a wall of grayed-out unavailable times to find a single open slot every week is a real hassle. I want to be able to tap a day, see only the available slots for that day, and then tap my preferred time to confirm the booking all on one screen.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机预订应用，我能看一个日历然后过滤时间槽只显示真正开放的那些，因为每周都要滚过一堆灰掉的不可用时间来找单个开放槽太麻烦了。我想能轻点一天，只看那一天的可用槽，然后轻点我喜欢的时间在同一个屏幕确认预订。

corpus_topic: File type and size range filter in library
query_text: Make a file manager app for my phone where I can filter my saved files by type, like PDFs, images, or videos, and also set a size range so I can hunt down the big files that are eating my storage. I want the filter options to be simple enough that I can set them in a few taps, and the file list should update right away so I can see what matches and decide what to keep or delete.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机文件管理应用，我能按类型过滤我保存的文件，比如PDF、图像或视频，还能设置大小范围来找那些吞掉我存储空间的大文件。我想过滤选项简单到我能在几次轻点内设置，文件列表应该立即更新，这样我能看到什么匹配并决定保留或删除什么。

corpus_topic: Combined table filter and sort on data grid
query_text: Create a data tracker app for my phone that shows information in a table and lets me both filter rows by a specific value and sort columns in one place, because switching back and forth between separate menus to do both things is a pain. I want a simple row of filter options above the table and tap-to-sort on each column header, so I can narrow down exactly what I need and have it ordered the way I want in just a few taps.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机数据追踪应用，显示表格中的信息，让我既能按特定值过滤行也能在一个地方排序列，因为在分别的菜单之间切换来做这两件事太麻烦了。我想上面有简单的过滤选项行，每个列头能轻点排序，这样我能精确缩小到我需要的并按我想要的方式排序，只需几次轻点。

corpus_topic: Filter undo and redo with history panel
query_text: A filter manager app for my phone where every time I change a filter setting the app remembers the previous state, so I can step backwards through my filter history one tap at a time if I mess something up, and also step forward again if I change my mind. There should be a simple list somewhere on the screen showing my recent filter states so I can jump back to any earlier combination without having to redo everything from scratch.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机过滤管理应用，每次我改变过滤设置应用都记住之前的状态，这样如果我搞错了，我能一次轻点一次往回踏过我的过滤历史，如果我改主意了还能再往前走。屏幕某个地方应该有个简单列表显示我最近的过滤状态，这样我能跳回到任何之前的组合而不用从头重做一切。

corpus_topic: Dynamic filter options based on prior selection
query_text: Create a smart filter tool for my phone where picking one filter option automatically narrows down what shows up in the next filter, so I only see choices that actually make sense together instead of hitting empty results because I picked two incompatible things. I want the filter to update after each selection so every step only shows valid options, and I can see the results list refresh as I go without tapping a separate apply button.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机智能过滤工具，选择一个过滤选项会自动缩小下一个过滤中显示的内容，这样我只看到在一起真正有意义的选择，而不是因为选了两个不兼容的东西而得到空结果。过滤应该在每个选择后更新，这样每一步只显示有效的选项，结果列表会随我进行而刷新，不用轻点单独的应用按钮。

corpus_topic: Content type filter in media browser (image/video/audio)
query_text: Make a media browser app for my phone where I can tap a simple row of buttons at the top to show only photos, only videos, or only audio files, because right now everything is dumped together and I always have to scroll forever to find the type of file I actually want. I want the filter to switch instantly when I tap a type, and a count next to each button so I can see how many files of each kind I have before I even tap.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机媒体浏览应用，我能轻点上面简单的一行按钮来只显示照片、只显示视频或只显示音频文件，因为现在所有东西都堆在一起我总是要滚很久才能找到我真正想要的文件类型。过滤应该在我轻点一个类型时立即切换，每个按钮旁边有个计数，这样轻点前我就能看到每种文件有多少。

corpus_topic: Language and region filter for global content feed
query_text: A content feed app for my phone where I can set my preferred language and choose one or more regions so the feed only shows me articles and posts from places I actually care about, because getting a wall of content in languages I can't read or from countries completely unrelated to me is just noise. I want the language and region choices to be easy to find on the main screen, and the feed should refresh the moment I change a setting.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机内容动态应用，我能设置我喜欢的语言并选择一个或多个地区，这样动态就只显示我真正关心的地方的文章和帖子，因为看一堆我读不了的语言或完全和我无关的国家的内容简直就是噪音。我想语言和地区的选择在主屏幕上容易找到，轻点改变一个设置时动态应该立即刷新。

corpus_topic: Dietary restriction multi-filter for food discovery
query_text: Make a food discovery app for my phone where I can check off multiple dietary needs at once, like gluten-free, nut-free, and vegetarian together, and the results instantly show only dishes that fit all of my requirements at the same time. I want the filter options laid out as simple checkboxes I can tick in a few taps, and a results count that updates live as I select more, so I know how many options I still have left to browse.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机美食发现应用，我能一次勾选多个饮食需求，比如无麸质、无坚果和素食一起，结果立即只显示同时符合我所有需求的菜肴。我想过滤选项作为简单复选框展开，我能在几次轻点内勾选，还有个结果计数在我选择更多时实时更新，这样我就知道还有多少选项可浏览。

corpus_topic: Sensor threshold filter with numeric input in IoT
query_text: Make a smart home monitor app for my phone that lists readings from all my connected sensors and lets me type in a specific number threshold so I can filter the list to only show sensors that are above or below the value I care about. I want a simple input field where I type the cutoff number, pick whether I want readings above or below it, and see the sensor list narrow down immediately so I can spot the ones that need attention fast.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机智能家居监测应用，列出我所有连接传感器的数据，让我输入特定的数值阈值来过滤列表只显示高于或低于我关心的值的传感器。我想有个简单的输入框来输入截断数值，选择我想要高于还是低于它的数据，并立即看到传感器列表缩小，这样我能快速找到需要关注的那些。

corpus_topic: Kick group member with reason note and confirmation
query_text: Make a group manager tool for my phone where I can remove a member from any group by tapping their name, writing a short reason for kicking them, and then hitting a confirm button before it actually goes through, because right now there is no step between selecting someone and booting them and I keep doing it by accident with no record of why.
query_text_zh: 给手机做个群组管理工具，我可以通过点击成员名字来把他们从群里删除，写一个简短的理由说明为什么要把他们踢出去，然后再点确认按钮才真的执行，因为现在选中某个人之后就直接删除了，我经常不小心操作错误，也没有任何记录说明理由。

corpus_topic: Discard draft with unsaved-changes recovery prompt
query_text: Create a writing tool for mobile where whenever I try to throw away a draft I get a quick prompt asking if I want to save a backup copy first, so I stop losing half-finished notes that I deleted by accident thinking I had already saved them somewhere.
query_text_zh: 创建一个手机写作工具，当我想要丢弃某个草稿时，会快速弹出一个提示问我是否想先保存一个备份副本，这样我就不会再不小心删除那些我以为已经保存过但其实没有的半成品笔记了。

corpus_topic: Remove tag from multiple items in batch operation
query_text: Create a mobile tag manager app where I can select a bunch of items at once and strip a tag off all of them in one go rather than going into each item one by one, because right now removing a tag from thirty notes takes forever and I always give up halfway through.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机标签管理应用，我可以同时选中一批条目，然后一次性从它们全部删除某个标签，而不是逐个进入每一项操作，因为现在从三十条笔记上删除一个标签要花很久，我通常做到一半就放弃了。

corpus_topic: Delete recurring event with scope selector (this / all / future)
query_text: Make a calendar tool for my phone where when I delete a repeating event it asks me whether I want to remove just this one occurrence, all of them, or everything from today forward, so I stop wiping out an entire series when I only meant to cancel one date.
query_text_zh: 给手机做个日历工具，当我删除一个重复的事件时，它会问我是要删除只是这一次，还是所有的，或者从今天起的全部，这样我就不会在只想取消一个日期时不小心把整个系列都删除了。

corpus_topic: Remove trusted device with re-auth gate
query_text: Need a security tool on my phone that lets me see all the devices I have trusted and remove any of them, but requires me to re-enter my password or do a quick verification before the removal actually goes through so random people cannot just open my phone and quietly remove devices.
query_text_zh: 手机上需要一个安全工具，让我可以看到所有我信任的设备并删除它们，但删除前需要我重新输入密码或进行快速验证，这样陌生人就不能打开我的手机然后偷偷删除我的设备。

corpus_topic: Revoke API key with usage log summary display
query_text: A key manager app for mobile where I can see all the API keys I have created, tap one to revoke it, and before it gets deleted the app shows me a quick summary of how many times it was used and when it was last active, so I know if I am revoking something still in use.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机密钥管理应用，我可以看到所有我创建过的API密钥，点击一个来撤销它，在真正删除前应用会显示这个密钥被使用过多少次以及最后一次活动的时间，这样我就知道是否在撤销一个仍在使用的密钥。

corpus_topic: Delete project with sub-task archive prompt
query_text: Need a project manager on my phone where when I go to delete a whole project it asks me whether I want to archive the sub-tasks under it or delete those too, so I do not lose a bunch of individual task notes just because I closed the parent project they were sitting in.
query_text_zh: 手机上需要一个项目管理器，当我要删除一整个项目时，它会问我是想要归档里面的子任务还是也一起删除，这样我就不会因为关闭了一个父项目而丢失里面的所有单个任务笔记。

corpus_topic: Remove cart item with save-for-later shortcut
query_text: Need a shopping cart tool for my phone that lets me remove items but also gives me a quick one-tap option to save something to a wishlist instead of deleting it entirely, because I always end up removing things I actually want later but forget what they were called.
query_text_zh: 给手机做个购物车工具，让我可以移除商品，同时也提供一个一键快速选项把东西保存到心愿单而不是直接删除，因为我总是删除一些其实后来想要的东西，但已经忘记它叫什么了。

corpus_topic: Message recall within time window with seen-status warning
query_text: Build a messaging tool for my phone where I can recall a message I sent within a short time window, and before I confirm the recall it tells me whether the other person has already seen it, so I can decide if recalling it even makes sense or if I should just send a follow-up instead.
query_text_zh: 给手机构建一个消息工具，我可以在短时间内撤回我发送的消息，在确认撤回前它会告诉我对方是否已经看过这条消息，这样我可以决定是否撤回有意义，还是应该直接发一条后续消息。

corpus_topic: Delete annotation on shared document with comment thread
query_text: Build a document annotation tool on my phone where I can delete a comment I added to a shared file, but it keeps the reply thread visible so everyone else can still see the conversation that happened around my original note even after I remove it.
query_text_zh: 在手机上做一个文档批注工具，我可以删除我添加到共享文件中的评论，但它会保留回复线程使其可见，这样其他人仍然可以看到围绕我原始笔记发生的对话，即使我删除了它。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Portfolio URL and custom link management
query_text: Build a personal profile editor for mobile that has a clean, minimal section just for links, where I can add my portfolio address plus a few custom links, each with its own little label, and the whole thing feels like a curated page rather than a cluttered list of raw URLs.
query_text_zh: 为手机构建一个个人资料编辑器，有一个干净简洁的链接专用部分，我可以添加我的作品集地址加上几个自定义链接，每个都有自己的小标签，整个部分看起来像一个精选页面而不是混乱的原始网址列表。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Birthday and demographic field with per-field visibility
query_text: Create a profile settings app for my phone with a soft, airy birthday and personal details section where each field has its own little privacy toggle right next to it, so the whole thing looks intentional and tasteful rather than a blunt form demanding all my information at once.
query_text_zh: 为手机创建一个资料设置应用，有一个柔和通风的生日和个人详情部分，每个字段旁边都有自己的小隐私开关，这样整个部分看起来有意图且品味良好，而不是一个粗鲁地要求我所有信息的表格。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Payment and billing address secure update flow
query_text: Need a billing manager on my phone that feels polished and trustworthy when I update my payment details or mailing address, with a clean step-by-step flow that does not feel rushed, and some reassuring visual cue that my information is being handled securely before I hit save.
query_text_zh: 手机上需要一个账单管理器，当我更新支付详情或邮寄地址时感觉精致可靠，有一个干净的分步流程不会让人觉得仓促，还有一些令人放心的视觉提示表明我的信息正在被安全处理，然后才是保存按钮。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Subscription tier display with one-tap upgrade shortcut
query_text: Create a subscription manager app for my phone with a beautiful side-by-side tier comparison that shows what I currently have versus what I could upgrade to, and a single prominent tap to upgrade that does not make me hunt through several screens to find where to actually do it.
query_text_zh: 为手机创建一个订阅管理应用，有一个漂亮的并排方案对比，显示我目前拥有的和我可能升级到的，还有一个单一突出的按钮可以升级，不需要我在多个屏幕间翻找才能找到实际升级的地方。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Profession and company detail update with verification
query_text: A professional profile editor for mobile where the job title and company fields feel elegant and deliberate, maybe with a soft badge or checkmark that appears once the details are verified, so my profile feels credible and put-together rather than just a plain text box anyone could fill in with anything.
query_text_zh: 一个手机专业资料编辑器，工作职位和公司字段看起来优雅刻意，可能在细节被验证后会出现一个柔和的徽章或复选标记，这样我的资料看起来可信且完整，而不仅仅是任何人都可以填入任何内容的普通文本框。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
query_text: Make a mobile interests picker that feels more like browsing a curated mood board than filling out a checklist, where I can tap topic tiles to select the things I care about and the selected ones light up or shift in a way that feels satisfying and visually cohesive.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机兴趣爱好选择器，感觉更像是在浏览一个精选的情绪版而不是填一份清单，我可以点击主题方块来选择我关心的东西，被选中的会亮起来或者以某种令人满足且视觉协调的方式改变。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Profile theme and color accent picker with live preview
query_text: Need a profile personalization tool on my phone where I can pick a color accent for my profile and see it actually applied in a live preview right there on the same screen, so I can try out a few options and feel confident about the choice before saving it.
query_text_zh: 手机上需要一个资料个性化工具，我可以为我的资料选择一个颜色主题，并在同一个屏幕上的实时预览中看到它真的被应用上去，这样我可以尝试几个选项并在保存前对选择充满信心。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Personal data download request and export status
query_text: A personal data export tool for mobile that looks calm and reassuring rather than technical, where I can tap a button to request a download of all my data, and then see a gentle status indicator showing where the export is in the process so I am not left wondering if anything is happening.
query_text_zh: 一个手机个人数据导出工具，看起来平静令人放心而不是很技术性，我可以点击一个按钮来请求下载我的所有数据，然后看到一个温和的状态指示符显示导出进行到了哪一步，这样我不会一直在想是否有任何东西在进行。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Account deletion with data-wipe confirmation steps
query_text: Create a mobile account manager that handles deleting an account with a graceful, step-by-step confirmation process that feels considered rather than alarming, with a clear note at each step about what data will be removed so the whole experience feels respectful and intentional.
query_text_zh: 创建一个手机账户管理器，用一个优雅的分步确认流程来处理删除账户，让人感觉是经过深思而不是令人担忧的，在每一步都有清晰的说明表示哪些数据会被删除，这样整个体验感觉尊重且有意图。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Email change with reverification and rollback grace period
query_text: Create a mobile account settings tool for changing my email address that has a clean, two-step verification flow, and includes a reassuring note about a grace period where I can roll back to my old address in case something goes wrong, so the whole thing feels safe and polished.
query_text_zh: 创建一个手机账户设置工具来更改我的电子邮件地址，有一个干净的两步验证流程，并包含一个令人放心的说明关于有一个宽限期可以在出问题时回滚到我的旧地址，这样整个过程感觉安全且精致。

corpus_topic: Selective download from collection with size estimate
query_text: Need a mobile downloader tool that lets me browse a collection and pick specific files to save to my phone rather than grabbing everything at once, and shows me the total estimated size of what I have selected before I start, so I know if I have enough storage before committing to the download.
query_text_zh: 手机上需要一个下载工具，让我可以浏览一个集合并选择特定的文件来保存到我的手机，而不是一次性抓取所有内容，并在我开始前显示我已选择内容的总估计大小，这样我知道开始下载前是否有足够的存储空间。

corpus_topic: Download manager with pause, resume and queue
query_text: Need a download manager app on my phone where I can see all my active and queued downloads in one place, pause any of them when I want to save data, resume them later without starting over, and move things up or down in the queue so the most important file always finishes first.
query_text_zh: 手机上需要一个下载管理应用，我可以在一个地方看到所有我的活跃和排队下载，在我想节省数据时暂停任何一个，之后在不重新开始的情况下恢复它们，并在队列中上下移动东西，这样最重要的文件总是首先完成。

corpus_topic: Offline content package download for travel mode
query_text: Create a travel prep tool for my phone that lets me download a full offline content package before a trip, so everything I need is already saved locally and works without any signal, because I am always stuck somewhere with no internet trying to find things I forgot to grab beforehand.
query_text_zh: 为手机创建一个旅行准备工具，让我可以在旅行前下载一个完整的离线内容包，这样我需要的所有东西都已经保存在本地并且在没有任何信号的情况下也能工作，因为我总是困在某个地方没有网络，而我忘记提前抓取一些东西。

corpus_topic: CSV or vCard contact import with field mapping
query_text: Build a contact import tool on my phone that can read a CSV file or vCard and walk me through matching the columns to the right fields like name, phone, and email, so I can bring in a whole list of contacts at once without manually retyping every single person.
query_text_zh: 在手机上构建一个联系人导入工具，可以读取CSV文件或vCard并引导我将列与正确的字段匹配，比如姓名、电话和电子邮件，这样我可以一次性导入一个整个联系人列表，而不用手动重新输入每一个人。

corpus_topic: Health or fitness data import from third-party app
query_text: Build a health tracker on my phone that can pull in my existing workout and fitness data from another app I already use, so I do not have to re-enter months of history by hand, and shows me a simple mapping step so I can confirm which data types are being brought over correctly.
query_text_zh: 在手机上构建一个健康追踪器，可以从我已经使用的另一个应用中拉取我现有的运动和健身数据，这样我就不用手工重新输入几个月的历史记录，并显示给我一个简单的映射步骤，这样我可以确认哪些数据类型被正确地导入。

corpus_topic: Bulk export with date range and format selector
query_text: A bulk export tool for my phone where I can pick a date range and choose what format to save everything in, like CSV or PDF, then grab all the records at once instead of going one by one every single time. I always have to export stuff for monthly reports and doing it file by file is such a pain. The app just needs a date picker, a format selector, and a button that bundles everything up and saves it to my phone.
query_text_zh: 手机上的一个批量导出工具，我可以选择一个日期范围并选择要保存成什么格式，比如CSV或PDF，然后一次性抓取所有记录，而不是逐个进行。我总是要为月度报告导出东西，逐个文件进行真的太麻烦了。应用只需要一个日期选择器、一个格式选择器和一个把所有东西打包并保存到我手机的按钮。

corpus_topic: Download history with one-tap re-download option
query_text: A download history tracker for my phone that keeps a list of everything I have downloaded before, with the file name, date, and a button right next to each item so I can grab it again in one tap if I need it. I always end up hunting through my folders trying to find something I already downloaded once, and it wastes so much time. The app should just show the list in order and let me re-download anything instantly.
query_text_zh: 手机上的一个下载历史记录追踪器，保留我之前下载过的所有内容的列表，包括文件名、日期和每一项旁边的一个按钮，这样如果我需要的话我可以一键再次抓取它。我总是最后在我的文件夹里翻找试图找到我之前已经下载过的东西，浪费了很多时间。应用应该只是按顺序显示列表并让我立即重新下载任何内容。

corpus_topic: ZIP archive download for selected file set
query_text: Make a file manager tool for my phone where I can check off a bunch of files from a list and then hit one button to pack them all into a single ZIP file and download it, so I stop having to save files one at a time. It takes forever to grab each file separately when I need a whole batch. The app just needs a list with checkboxes, a select-all option, and a download-as-ZIP button at the bottom.
query_text_zh: 为手机做一个文件管理工具，我可以从列表中勾选一堆文件，然后点击一个按钮把它们全部打包成一个ZIP文件并下载它，这样我就不用一次一个地保存文件了。当我需要整批抓取文件时分别保存每个文件要花很长时间。应用只需要一个带复选框的列表、一个全选选项和底部的一个下载为ZIP的按钮。

corpus_topic: Media download with quality selector (4K / HD / SD)
query_text: Create a media downloader app for my phone that lets me pick between 4K, HD, and SD before the file actually starts downloading, so I can choose a smaller size when my storage is running low and save the good quality one when I have space. Right now I just get whatever the default is and then I have to delete and re-download if it turns out to be the wrong size. The app should show the quality options clearly with a file size estimate before I confirm.
query_text_zh: 为手机创建一个媒体下载应用，让我可以在文件真正开始下载前选择4K、HD或SD，这样当我的存储空间不足时我可以选择更小的尺寸，当我有空间时保存好质量的。现在我只是得到默认的任何东西，然后如果结果是错误的大小我不得不删除并重新下载。应用应该清楚地显示质量选项，并在我确认前显示文件大小估计。

corpus_topic: Invoice and receipt PDF batch export
query_text: Make an invoice and receipt manager for my phone that lets me select a bunch of invoices or receipts at once and export them all as PDFs in one go, so I can stop manually saving each one when I need to submit expenses. Dealing with dozens of receipts one at a time every month is just exhausting. The app should let me filter by date or by type, tick the ones I want, and then batch-export everything into a single PDF or separate files.
query_text_zh: 为手机做一个发票和收据管理器，让我可以一次选中一堆发票或收据并一次性把它们全部导出为PDF，这样我就不用在需要提交费用时手动保存每一个。每个月处理数十张收据，一次一个真的太累了。应用应该让我按日期或类型过滤，勾选我想要的那些，然后把所有东西批量导出成一个PDF或多个单独的文件。

corpus_topic: Replicate workout plan for another trainee profile
query_text: Build a workout planner app for my phone where I can take any existing training plan and copy it over to a different person's profile with one tap, so I stop re-entering the same exercises from scratch every time I set up a new trainee. I manage a few people at the gym and building each plan by hand is just repetitive and annoying. The app should let me pick a plan, choose which trainee profile to copy it to, and then let me tweak it from there.
query_text_zh: 为手机构建一个锻炼计划应用，我可以拿任何现有的训练计划并一键将其复制到另一个人的资料中，这样我就不用在每次为一个新学员设置时从零开始重新输入相同的练习。我在健身房管理几个人，手工创建每个计划真的很重复烦人。应用应该让我选择一个计划，选择要将其复制到哪个学员资料，然后让我从那里调整它。

corpus_topic: Copy delivery address from order to address book
query_text: Make a delivery address manager for my phone where I can look at any past order and save the shipping address from it straight into my address book with one tap, so I stop typing the same addresses over and over every time I order something new. Half my orders go to the same few places and I always have to retype everything. The app should show my order list, let me tap an address to copy it, and save it with a name I can reuse next time.
query_text_zh: 为手机做一个配送地址管理器，我可以查看任何过去的订单并一键将其送货地址直接保存到我的地址簿中，这样我就不用在每次订购新东西时一遍遍地重新输入相同的地址。我的一半订单都去到相同的几个地方，我总是必须重新输入所有内容。应用应该显示我的订单列表，让我点击一个地址来复制它，并用一个我下次可以重用的名称保存它。

corpus_topic: Duplicate report layout with same data source binding
query_text: Create a report builder app for my phone where I can take any report layout I have already set up and make a full copy of it that stays connected to the same data as the original, so I can use it as a starting point for a tweaked version without rebuilding all the charts and sections from scratch. Every time I need a slightly different report I end up redoing everything by hand. The copy should open ready to edit with the same data already hooked up.
query_text_zh: 为手机创建一个报告构建器应用，我可以拿任何我已经设置过的报告布局并制作一个完整的副本，它与原始报告连接相同的数据，这样我可以将其用作微调版本的起点，而不用从头重建所有的图表和部分。每次我需要一个略有不同的报告时，我最后都不得不手工重做一切。副本应该打开时已准备好编辑，相同的数据已经连接上去。

corpus_topic: Share card as image copy via screenshot flow
query_text: Need a sharing tool for my phone that turns any info card in the app into a clean image I can save to my photo roll and then send to friends or post anywhere, all in just a couple of taps. Right now I just do a regular screenshot but it always catches stuff I don't want in the frame. The app should let me tap a card, show me a tidy preview image of just that card, and then save or share it from there.
query_text_zh: 手机上需要一个共享工具，可以将应用中的任何信息卡片转换成一个干净的图像，我可以保存到我的相册然后发给朋友或在任何地方发布，仅仅需要几个点击。现在我只是做一个常规的屏幕截图，但它总是会抓到一些我不想在画面中的东西。应用应该让我点击一张卡片，为我显示一个只是那张卡片的整洁预览图像，然后从那里保存或共享它。

corpus_topic: Clone chatbot intent and adjust training phrases
query_text: A chatbot builder tool for my phone where I can take any conversation topic I already set up, duplicate it, and then edit the example phrases in the copy so I can quickly spin up a slightly different version for a related topic without starting over from zero. Setting up each topic fresh takes so long when they are mostly the same. The copy should open with all the original example phrases already there and ready to be changed.
query_text_zh: 一个手机聊天机器人构建工具，我可以拿我已经设置过的任何对话主题，复制它，然后编辑副本中的示例短语，这样我可以为一个相关主题快速创建一个略有不同的版本，而不用从零开始。从零开始设置每个主题需要很长时间，当它们大多相同时。副本应该打开时已经有所有原始示例短语在那里并准备好被改变。

corpus_topic: Copy invoice and reassign to new client and date
query_text: Build an invoice manager app for my phone where I can open any old invoice, copy it, and then swap in a different client name and a new date so I have a fresh invoice ready to send without typing out all the line items again. I bill multiple clients for the same kind of work every month and rebuilding each invoice from scratch is such a waste of time. The app should let me pick the invoice to copy, edit the client and date fields right away, and save or send it.
query_text_zh: 为手机构建一个发票管理应用，我可以打开任何旧发票，复制它，然后交换一个不同的客户名称和一个新日期，这样我就准备好了一份新发票可以发送，而不用再次输入所有的行项目。我每个月为多个客户开出相同类型工作的发票，从头重建每份发票真的是浪费时间。应用应该让我选择要复制的发票，立即编辑客户和日期字段，然后保存或发送它。

corpus_topic: Duplicate saved filter with modified condition
query_text: Need a filter manager tool for my phone that lets me take any saved search filter I use a lot and copy it as a new one so I can change just one or two conditions in the copy without messing up the original. I keep setting up the same filters with tiny differences and there is no easy way to reuse them. The app should list all my saved filters, let me tap one to copy it, and open the copy ready for me to adjust whatever I want.
query_text_zh: 手机上需要一个过滤器管理工具，让我可以拿我经常使用的任何已保存搜索过滤器并将其作为一个新的来复制，这样我可以只改变副本中的一两个条件而不搞乱原始的。我一直在设置基本相同但有微小差异的相同过滤器，没有简单的方法来重用它们。应用应该列出我所有已保存的过滤器，让我点击一个来复制它，并打开副本准备好让我调整我想要的任何东西。

corpus_topic: Mirror schedule to secondary calendar with color
query_text: Build a schedule manager app for my phone where I can take everything on my main calendar and mirror it to a second calendar, with each copied event showing in a different color so I can tell the two calendars apart at a glance. I want to keep a backup version of my schedule that I can share with someone else, and right now I just have to manually re-enter everything. The app should handle the copying automatically and let me pick a color for the mirrored events.
query_text_zh: 为手机构建一个日程管理应用，我可以拿我主日历上的所有内容并将其镜像到第二个日历，每个复制的事件以不同的颜色显示，这样我可以一眼看出两个日历的区别。我想保留我的日程的备份版本，我可以与别人共享，现在我只是必须手动重新输入所有内容。应用应该自动处理复制并让我为镜像事件选择一个颜色。

corpus_topic: Reorder with one-tap copy from previous order
query_text: Need a reorder tool for my phone that shows my past orders in a list and lets me tap one to copy all the items from it straight into a new order, so I stop picking everything out again from scratch when I just want the same thing I got last time. I order the same stuff pretty regularly and re-selecting item by item every single time is pointless. The app should pull up the old order details, let me confirm or make small tweaks, and then place the new order.
query_text_zh: 手机上需要一个重新订购工具，显示我过去的订单列表并让我点击一个来将其中的所有商品直接复制到一个新订单中，这样我就不用在我只想要我上次得到的相同东西时从头再选一遍所有东西。我定期订购相同的东西，每一次都逐项重新选择毫无意义。应用应该拉起旧订单详情，让我确认或做一些小的调整，然后放置新订单。

corpus_topic: Duplicate flashcard deck for grammar variant study
query_text: Create a flashcard study app for my phone where I can take any deck I have already made and duplicate it so I can practice the same words but with different grammar forms in the copy, like changing all the present-tense examples to past tense, without having to retype every card. I study language with lots of variations and rebuilding a whole deck from scratch each time is way too slow. The copy should have all the original cards already there and ready for me to edit.
query_text_zh: 为手机创建一个闪卡学习应用，我可以拿我已经制作过的任何牌组并复制它，这样我可以练习相同的单词但在副本中用不同的语法形式，比如把所有现在时的例子改为过去时，而不用重新输入每一张卡片。我学习有很多变化的语言，每次从零重建一整套牌组太慢了。副本应该打开时已经有所有原始卡片在那里并准备好让我编辑。

corpus_topic: Deep link routing from push notification
query_text: Need a notification manager app for my phone that handles push notifications properly, so when I tap one it takes me directly to the exact thing it was talking about inside the app instead of just dropping me on the home screen and making me hunt around. I want to try building a small tool that sends a few different kinds of notifications and each one should open the right spot in the app when tapped, so it actually feels useful and saves people from clicking around aimlessly.
query_text_zh: 手机上需要一个通知管理应用，正确处理推送通知，所以当我点击一个时它直接带我到应用内它所讲的确切东西，而不是只是把我丢在主屏幕上让我四处寻找。我想尝试构建一个小工具来发送几种不同类型的通知，每一个应该在点击时打开应用中的正确位置，这样它感觉真的有用并能救人们从漫无目的地点击。

corpus_topic: Undo toast with countdown timer before dismiss
query_text: Create a task manager app for my phone that shows a small pop-up message at the bottom of the screen whenever I delete something, with a live countdown of a few seconds and an undo button I can tap to bring the item back before the message goes away. I want to try this out because it feels way more forgiving than just deleting stuff with no safety net. The countdown should be visible so I know how long I have, and if I do nothing the item is just gone.
query_text_zh: 为手机创建一个任务管理应用，当我删除东西时在屏幕底部显示一个小弹窗消息，有一个几秒钟的实时倒计时和一个我可以点击来在消息消失前恢复条目的撤销按钮。我想尝试这个因为它感觉远比只是删除东西没有安全网更宽容。倒计时应该是可见的所以我知道我还有多长时间，如果我什么都不做该条目就完全消失了。

query_text: Create a shortcut reference app for my phone where I can open a panel from anywhere in the app that slides up from the bottom and shows all the keyboard shortcuts organized into groups, so I can quickly look up what I forget without leaving what I am doing. I always end up googling shortcuts because there is nowhere to check them inside the app itself. The panel should have the shortcuts listed clearly with a short label for each one and be easy to close and get back to work.
query_text_zh: 为手机创建一个快捷键参考应用，我可以从应用中的任何地方打开一个面板，从底部向上滑动并显示所有按组组织的键盘快捷键，这样我可以快速查找我忘记的而不用离开我正在做的事情。我总是最后谷歌搜索快捷键因为应用内没有地方来检查它们。面板应该有快捷键清楚列出，每个都有一个简短标签，并且很容易关闭和回到工作。

corpus_topic: Dark/light mode toggle with instant preview
query_text: Make a note-taking app for my phone that has a switch somewhere accessible letting me flip between a dark background and a light background, and the whole app should change over instantly so I can see exactly what it looks like right away. I want to tinker with both looks and pick whichever one feels easier to read at different times of day. The switch should be easy to reach from any screen so I can toggle back and forth without digging through settings.
query_text_zh: 为手机做一个笔记应用，某个容易到达的地方有一个开关让我在深色背景和浅色背景之间翻转，整个应用应该立即改变所以我可以立即看到它真的看起来什么样。我想尝试两种外观并选择一个在一天的不同时间感觉更容易读的那个。开关应该从任何屏幕都容易到达，这样我可以来回切换而不用翻找设置。

corpus_topic: Beta feature opt-in with feedback form link
query_text: Need a settings tool for my phone where users can sign up to try out a new experimental feature that is still being tested, and right after they turn it on they get a link to a short feedback form so they can share what they think while it is fresh. I want to build something like this for a small side project where I am testing new stuff with real people. The opt-in should be simple, just a toggle with a short description of what the feature does, and the form link should appear right after they enable it.
query_text_zh: 手机上需要一个设置工具，用户可以选择尝试一个仍在测试中的新实验功能，打开它后他们立即得到一个链接到一份短反馈表单，这样他们可以在它是新鲜的时候分享他们的想法。我想为一个小的附带项目构建这样的东西，我在用真实的人测试新东西。选择加入应该很简单，只是一个带有功能简短描述的切换，表单链接应该在他们启用它之后立即出现。

corpus_topic: Guided tour relaunch from help settings
query_text: Build a help center app for my phone that includes a step-by-step walkthrough showing users how to use the main parts of the app, and lets them relaunch that walkthrough at any time from the help or settings area in case they forgot something or skipped it the first time. I want to make a little app for my mom and she always forgets how things work, so being able to replay the whole tour on demand would be really handy. Each step should highlight the relevant part of the screen and have a short explanation.
query_text_zh: 为手机构建一个帮助中心应用，包括一个分步演练显示用户如何使用应用的主要部分，并让他们从帮助或设置区域随时重新启动该演练，以防他们忘记了什么或第一次跳过了。我想为我妈妈做一个小应用，她总是忘记东西如何工作，所以能够按需重新播放整个导览会真的很方便。每一步应该突出屏幕的相关部分并有一个简短的解释。

corpus_topic: Force update prompt with changelog accordion
query_text: Need a mobile app that shows users a prompt when there is a new required update available, and inside that prompt they can expand a section to read through what changed in the new version before they go update it. I want to build this into a small project I am working on so users know why they have to update instead of just getting a blank pop-up. The expandable list of changes should be easy to read on a phone screen, and the update button should be clearly there to tap when they are ready.
query_text_zh: 手机应用需要在有新的必需更新可用时向用户显示一个提示，在该提示内他们可以展开一个部分来阅读新版本中更改的内容，然后再去更新它。我想把这个构建到我正在进行的一个小项目中，这样用户知道为什么他们必须更新而不仅仅是得到一个空白弹窗。可扩展的更改列表应该很容易在手机屏幕上读取，更新按钮应该清楚地存在并准备好在他们准备好时点击。

corpus_topic: Session timeout warning with extend-session option
query_text: A login session manager for my phone that pops up a warning notice when the session is about to expire, showing how much time is left and giving the user a button to stay logged in so they can keep going without losing their work. I want to make a little app where people can edit something over a longer period and this kind of heads-up would save a lot of frustration. The warning should appear with enough time left to actually use the extend button, and tapping it should reset the timer right away.
query_text_zh: 一个手机登录会话管理器，当会话即将过期时弹出一个警告通知，显示还剩多少时间并给用户一个按钮来保持登录所以他们可以继续而不失去他们的工作。我想做一个小应用，人们可以在较长时间内编辑某些东西，这种提前警告会救很多挫折。警告应该在有足够时间来实际使用扩展按钮前出现，点击它应该立即重置计时器。

corpus_topic: Inline bug report form with screenshot attach
query_text: Build a feedback tool for my phone that lets users fill out a quick form right inside the app to report something that went wrong, and they can attach a photo or screenshot from their phone to help explain the issue. I want to add this to a small project I am working on so people can send me useful reports when something breaks, instead of just texting me a vague description. The form should have a short text field for describing the problem and a simple way to pick a photo to attach before sending.
query_text_zh: 为手机构建一个反馈工具，让用户可以直接在应用内填写一份快速表单来报告出问题的东西，他们可以附加一张照片或来自他们手机的截图来帮助解释问题。我想把这个加到我正在进行的一个小项目中，这样人们可以在出问题时给我发送有用的报告，而不是只是给我发短信含糊其辞的描述。表单应该有一个简短的文本字段来描述问题和一个简单的方式来在发送前选择一张照片来附加。

corpus_topic: Data sync conflict resolution picker dialog
query_text: Create a sync manager app for my phone that handles the situation where the same piece of info was changed in two places and shows the user a simple way to pick which version to keep, with both versions displayed side by side so they can compare before deciding. I want to try building something like this for a personal project where I edit notes on multiple devices and conflicts happen sometimes. The picker should make it obvious which version came from where and let me resolve each one with a single tap.
query_text_zh: 为手机创建一个同步管理应用，处理同一个信息在两个地方被改变的情况并向用户显示一个简单的方式来选择哪个版本保留，两个版本并排显示这样他们可以在决定前进行比较。我想尝试为一个个人项目构建这样的东西，我在多个设备上编辑笔记，冲突有时会发生。选择器应该清楚地表明哪个版本来自何处并让我通过单一点击来解决每一个。

query_text: Need a fuel cost and efficiency calculator app on my phone that saves me from doing math every time I fill up, just let me type in the distance, how many liters I used, and the price per liter, and it instantly tells me my cost per kilometer and overall trip fuel spend, with a little history list so I can compare how different cars or driving styles are costing me over time.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机油耗计算器应用，可以帮我省去每次加油时的心算，只需输入行驶距离、用油升数和油价，应用就能立即告诉我每公里油耗和这趟行程的总油费，还能保存历史记录，这样我可以比较不同车型或驾驶方式的成本差异。

corpus_topic: Power consumption and electricity bill estimator
query_text: Build a mobile app that estimates my electricity bill before it hits, I'm so tired of being surprised every month, so I want to type in each appliance I use at home, how many hours a day I run it, and my local rate per kilowatt-hour, and then the app totals it all up and shows me a clear monthly estimate, with the biggest power-draining items listed first so I know what to cut.
query_text_zh: 开发一个手机应用，能帮我提前预估电费账单，我已经厌倦了每月意外账单的惊吓，希望能输入家里每个电器、每天的使用时长和当地的度电价格，应用就能自动统计并显示清晰的月度预估费用，最耗电的设备要排在前面，这样我就知道该省哪些用电了。

query_text: Build a body fat percentage calculator app for my phone where I enter basic stuff like my height, weight, age, and gender, and it gives me a clear result right away using a standard formula, plus a small reference chart showing what range I fall into like healthy, overfat, or athletic, so I finally stop Googling this every time I want a quick check.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机身体脂肪率计算器，输入身高、体重、年龄和性别等基本信息后立即得出结果，还要附上参考图表显示我属于健康、偏胖还是运动员体型的范围，再也不用每次都去谷歌搜索了。

query_text: Make a tile and flooring area estimator app for my phone that figures out exactly how many tiles I need to buy for a room, I just type in the room length and width, pick the tile size from a few common options, and set a waste percentage for cuts, and the app calculates total tiles needed plus total cost if I enter the price per tile, so I stop buying too many or running short at the store.
query_text_zh: 设计一个瓷砖和地板面积计算应用，可以精确算出我需要购买多少块瓷砖，只需输入房间的长宽、从常见尺寸中选择瓷砖大小、设置损耗百分比，应用就能计算出需要的总瓷砖数和总成本（如果我输入了单价的话），这样我就不会在店里买多了或买少了。

corpus_topic: Wind chill and heat index calculator
query_text: Need a wind chill and heat index calculator app for my phone that tells me what the temperature actually feels like outside before I decide what to wear, I type in the real air temperature and the wind speed or humidity depending on the season, and it shows me the feels-like number right away with a quick note like whether it is safe to go out or if I should layer up.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机风寒指数和热指数计算器，可以告诉我实际温度感受怎么样，帮我决定穿什么衣服，输入真实气温和风速或湿度，应用立即显示体感温度，还要有一个简短的提示说明是否安全外出或需要多穿几层。

query_text: Need a cooking conversion calculator app for my phone that handles all the annoying unit swaps when I follow a recipe, so I can type in a number in cups, grams, ml, or oz and pick what I want to convert to, and it gives me the answer instantly, with a list of common ingredients like flour or sugar since their cup-to-gram ratios are all different and I always get confused mid-cook.
query_text_zh: 制作一个手机烹饪单位转换计算器，解决我按食谱做菜时的所有讨厌的单位转换问题，输入一个数字和单位（杯、克、毫升或盎司）后选择目标单位，应用立即给出答案，还要列出常见食材的转换比例，比如面粉和糖的杯克比都不一样，做菜时我总是搞混。

query_text: Create a GPA calculator app for my phone so I can finally stop manually averaging my grades at the end of every semester, I want to enter each course name, the credits it is worth, and the grade I got, and the app adds them all up and shows me my overall GPA and semester GPA side by side, with the option to add a new course row any time without losing what I already entered.
query_text_zh: 开发一个手机GPA计算器，这样我就不用每个学期末手动计算平均成绩了，输入课程名、学分和成绩，应用就能加总并同时显示总体GPA和学期GPA，还能随时添加新课程而不会丢失已输入的数据。

query_text: Build a bandwidth and data usage estimator app for my phone that helps me figure out whether my monthly data plan is enough before I upgrade or downgrade it, I type in how many hours a day I stream video, browse, or do video calls, pick the quality level for each activity, and the app totals up my estimated monthly usage in GB so I can actually compare it against my plan limit.
query_text_zh: 设计一个手机带宽和数据使用量估算器，帮我判断现有的流量套餐是否足够，在升级或降级前心里有数，输入每天看视频、浏览和视频通话各花多少小时，选择每项活动的画质等级，应用就能总计月度使用量（以GB计），这样我就能和套餐额度进行对比。

query_text: Create a blood alcohol content estimator app for my phone where I log what I drank, how many standard drinks, my body weight, and how many hours have passed, and the app gives me a rough BAC estimate right away, plus a simple guide showing what that level means for driving safety, so I have something concrete to look at before deciding whether to call a ride.
query_text_zh: 制作一个手机血液酒精含量估算器，记录我喝了什么、多少标准杯、体重和已经过了多少小时，应用立即给出大致的血液酒精含量估算值，还有简单指南说明这个水平对驾驶安全意味着什么，这样我在决定是否打车前就有了具体的参考。

query_text: Build an Ohm's law electrical resistance calculator app for my phone that lets me pick which value I want to find, voltage, current, or resistance, then type in the other two numbers, and it instantly solves for the missing one, plus shows the power in watts as a bonus result, so I have a quick reference tool handy whenever I am tinkering with a small electronics project.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机欧姆定律电阻计算器，可以选择我要求哪个值（电压、电流或电阻），输入另外两个数字，应用立即计算出缺失的那个，还能额外显示瓦特功率，这样当我在进行小电子项目改造时就有了一个快速参考工具。

query_text: Need a molecular weight calculator app for my phone that lets me type in a chemical formula like H2O or C6H12O6 and immediately get the total molecular weight in grams per mole, with a breakdown showing each element and how much it contributes, so I can stop looking up atomic masses one by one in my chemistry notes every time I need to do a quick stoichiometry problem.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机分子量计算器，输入化学式如H2O或C6H12O6，立即得到摩尔质量的总分子量，还要显示每个元素的分解和各自的贡献，这样我就能停止逐个查找原子质量，每次需要做化学当量问题时不用翻笔记了。

corpus_topic: Real Estate Cap Rate Investment Calculator
query_text: Create a real estate cap rate calculator app for my phone where I enter a property's purchase price, annual rental income, and estimated yearly expenses like maintenance and insurance, and it instantly calculates the cap rate and shows me whether the return looks reasonable, with a simple comparison showing how the cap rate changes if I adjust the price or income, so I can quickly size up a deal while I am out looking at places.
query_text_zh: 开发一个手机房地产资本化率计算器，输入房产购买价、年租赁收入和年度维护及保险等估计费用，应用立即计算资本化率并告诉我回报是否合理，还要有简单的对比功能显示调整价格或收入后资本化率如何变化，这样我在外看房子时就能快速评估一笔交易。

corpus_topic: Learning session timer and focus log
query_text: Need a learning session timer app for my phone that I can actually use to track my study time each day, I start a timer when I sit down to study, pick a subject from a short list I set up myself, and when I stop it logs the session with the subject and duration, then the home screen shows me a simple running total of hours studied today and this week so I can see my progress at a glance.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机学习时间计时器应用，用来跟踪我每天的学习时间，开始学习时启动计时器并从我自己设置的科目列表中选择，停止时应用就记录该科目和时长，首屏显示今天和这周的学习总时数，这样我一眼就能看到进度。

corpus_topic: Medicine dose and symptom note logger
query_text: Create a medicine dose and symptom logger app for my phone that makes it easy to keep a daily record when I am taking a new medication, I want to quickly tap in the medicine name, dose I took, and time, then add a short note about how I am feeling like any side effects or symptom changes, and later I can scroll back through the log to show the doctor a clear timeline without having to remember everything from memory.
query_text_zh: 制作一个手机药物剂量和症状日志应用，在我服用新药时方便记录，快速输入药物名称、剂量和时间，然后添加关于如何感觉的简短笔记，比如任何副作用或症状变化，之后我可以翻阅日志给医生看一个清晰的时间线，不用凭记忆回想一切。

query_text: Create a travel daily journal app for my phone where I can jot down a quick note each day of a trip, like what I did, where I ate, and one thing that surprised me, and attach the date and location so each entry stays organized by trip, the idea is to have a simple personal record I can look back on later that captures the feeling of the day without needing to write a full essay.
query_text_zh: 设计一个手机旅行日记应用，让我能在旅程中每天记下简短笔记，比如做了什么、在哪里吃饭和有什么令人惊喜的事，并附上日期和位置好让每条记录按行程整理，目标是留下一份简单的个人记录，可以日后回顾，捕捉那天的感觉而不需要写长篇大论。

corpus_topic: Creative output and inspiration daily note
query_text: Need a creative notes app for my phone where I can capture little sparks of inspiration throughout the day, whether it is a song idea, a sketch concept, or just a random thing I want to try making, I tap to add a new note with a title and a few lines of description, tag it loosely by type like music or visual or writing, and later browse the list to find the ones worth actually starting.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机创意笔记应用，可以在一整天内捕捉灵感火花，不论是歌曲创意、素描概念还是任何我想试着做的随机想法，点击添加新笔记输入标题和几行描述，用音乐、视觉、写作这样的标签松散分类，之后浏览列表找到真正值得启动的项目。

corpus_topic: Symptom and chronic pain level diary
query_text: Build a symptom and pain level diary app for my phone where each entry lets me pick a pain level from 1 to 10, note where it hurts, jot down any possible triggers like what I ate or how I slept, and save it with the current time, so over a few weeks I can scroll through the log and spot patterns to share with my doctor instead of just saying it comes and goes randomly.
query_text_zh: 制作一个手机症状和疼痛程度日记应用，每条记录让我从1到10选择疼痛级别、标记疼痛位置、记录可能的触发因素比如吃了什么或睡眠质量，并保存当前时间，这样几周后我可以回顾日志找出规律，然后和医生分享，而不是只能说症状时有时无。

query_text: A sobriety and habit streak diary app for my phone that tracks how many days in a row I have kept a specific habit going, like skipping alcohol or cutting out late-night snacks, each day I just tap to check in and the app shows me my current streak, a small calendar of which days I checked in, and a personal note field if I want to write what helped me that day, simple and encouraging without being preachy.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机戒酒和习惯连续天数日记应用，记录我在某个特定习惯上连续坚持的天数，比如戒酒或停止午夜零食，每天只需点击签到，应用就显示当前连续天数、签到的日历和一个个人笔记栏如果我想写下那天是什么帮助了我，简单且鼓励人心，不显得说教。

query_text: A weight and body measurement log app for my phone where I punch in my weight, waist, and a couple of other measurements whenever I feel like checking in, each entry saves with the date, and the app draws a simple line chart so I can see the trend over the past month or two without any complicated setup, just a clean record I can glance at quickly during my morning routine.
query_text_zh: 设计一个手机体重和身体测量日志应用，任何时候我都能输入体重、腰围和几个其他测量值，每条记录自动保存日期，应用就能绘制简单的折线图，让我看到过去一两个月的趋势而不需要复杂的设置，只是一份清晰的记录我能在早晨例行时快速扫一眼。

query_text: Need a correspondence archive app for my phone where I can log every letter, card, or package I send or receive, with fields for who it is from or to, the date, and a short note about what it was, so I have a personal record I can search through when I need to remember if I already wrote back to someone or what year I sent that birthday card, all stored right on my phone without needing an email account.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机信件存档应用，可以记录我发送或收到的每一封信、卡片或包裹，有字段标明来自或发往谁、日期和内容简述，这样我就有了个人记录可以搜索，想起来时可以查证我是否已经回信或那张生日卡是哪年寄的，全部存在手机里，不需要邮件账户。

query_text: Create a voice memory box app for my phone where I can record a short voice note any time I want to save a thought or a little story, each recording gets saved with the date and a title I type in, and the home screen shows a list of all my saved clips so I can tap one to play it back later, the idea is to capture things I want to remember but never feel like typing out fully.
query_text_zh: 制作一个手机语音备忘录应用，任何时候我都能录制一段短语音笔记来保存一个想法或小故事，每条录音自动保存日期和我输入的标题，首屏显示所有已保存的语音列表，点击可以回放，目的是捕捉我想记住的东西但又懒得完整打出来的内容。

corpus_topic: Daily Mood and Energy Level Journal
query_text: Create a daily mood and energy journal app for my phone where each morning or evening I tap in how I am feeling emotionally on a simple scale, log my energy level the same way, and add a short optional note about what might have affected my day, then the app shows a weekly summary so I can look back and notice what days I tend to feel low and what might be causing it.
query_text_zh: 设计一个手机日常心情和精力日志应用，每天早晨或晚间输入我的情绪感受（用简单的量表）、精力水平同样用量表，可选地添加可能影响当天的简短笔记，应用就显示周度总结，这样我能回顾并注意到我倾向于感到低谷的日子以及可能的原因。

query_text: Build a gratitude log app for my phone where every day I write down three things I am thankful for, quick and low-pressure, just three short lines, and the app saves each day's entry with the date so I can scroll back through past entries when I need a lift, with a little running count of how many days in a row I have filled it in to keep me coming back.
query_text_zh: 开发一个手机感恩日志应用，每天我都要记下三件我感谢的事，快速且无压力，就三短行，应用保存每天的记录和日期，当我需要提振情绪时可以翻阅过去的记录，还有一个小计数器显示我连续填写了多少天来激励我坚持。

query_text: Need a coffee and caffeine tracker app for my phone that lets me quickly log each cup I drink during the day, picking the type like espresso, drip, or energy drink, and it adds up my total caffeine intake so I can see when I am getting close to my daily limit, with a simple timeline showing what time I had each drink so I can figure out why I can not sleep at night.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机咖啡和咖啡因追踪应用，可以快速记录我白天喝的每一杯，选择类型比如浓缩咖啡、滴漏或能量饮料，应用就加总我的日度咖啡因摄入量，这样我就能看到何时接近每日限额，并有一个简单的时间线显示我每次喝饮料的时间，这样我就能弄清楚为什么晚上睡不着。

corpus_topic: Birthday message with animated card creator
query_text: A birthday card creator app for my phone where I pick a fun animated background like balloons or confetti, type in a personal message, and put the friend's name front and center, then the app generates a shareable link or image I can send over chat, the whole thing should take under a minute on my phone so it actually gets done instead of me forgetting to send anything at all.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机生日卡创建应用，可以选择一个有趣的动画背景比如气球或彩纸，输入个人信息，把朋友的名字放在最醒目的地方，应用就生成一个可分享的链接或图片我能通过聊天发送，整个过程在手机上不超过一分钟这样我才真的会做而不是忘了什么都不送。

query_text: Create a language formality tone checker app for my phone where I can paste in a message and it tells me how formal or casual it sounds, something like a little meter from super formal to very chill, and maybe highlights the words or phrases that are pushing it one way or the other so I know what to tweak before I send it.
query_text_zh: 制作一个手机语言正式度检查器应用，我可以粘贴一条信息，它会告诉我听起来有多正式还是多随意，有点像一个从超正式到非常随和的小仪表，还可能高亮那些推向某一方的单词或短语，这样我就知道在发送前该调整什么。

query_text: Make a mobile app that acts like a vocabulary guide for switching between different ways of talking, so if I need to say the same thing in a casual way versus a professional way I can just tap a situation and see word swaps, like it shows you the stuffy version next to the relaxed version so you can pick what fits the moment.
query_text_zh: 设计一个手机应用，作为不同讲话方式之间切换的词汇指南，如果我需要用随意方式或专业方式说同样的事，我只需点击一个场景就能看到词汇替换，比如它显示老气的版本和轻松版本放在一起，这样你就能挑选适合那一刻的表达方式。

query_text: Make a mobile app that gives me ready-to-use phrase cards for getting out of social situations gracefully, like a set of exit lines organized by how awkward the situation is, from just needing a polite wrap-up to a full emergency escape, so I can glance at my phone and pick something that sounds natural instead of panicking.
query_text_zh: 制作一个手机应用，提供我优雅脱身社交尴尬局面的现成短语卡片，比如一套按尴尬程度组织的脱身台词，从只需有礼貌地收场到完整的紧急逃脱，我就能瞥一眼手机选择一个听起来自然的表达而不是惊慌失措。

corpus_topic: Friendship level tracker and nurture reminder
query_text: Need a mobile friendship tracker app where I can log each friend, rate how close we are right now, and get little reminders when I haven't reached out in a while, so the app kind of nudges me to check in before a friendship quietly fades without me noticing, with a simple list showing who needs some attention soon.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机友谊跟踪应用，可以记录每个朋友，评估现在我们有多亲近，并在我有段时间没联系时获得小提醒，这样应用能轻轻推动我在友谊无声褪去前主动联系，有个简单的列表显示谁很快需要些关注。

corpus_topic: Group activity idea vote poll maker
query_text: Make a group poll app for my phone where I can type in a bunch of activity ideas, send a link to my friends, and everyone taps their favorites so we can actually agree on what to do instead of going back and forth in the group chat forever, and it shows the results as a simple ranked list once people have voted.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机群组投票应用，可以输入一堆活动主意、发个链接给朋友，每个人都点击他们的最爱，这样我们终于能达成一致做什么而不是在群聊里来回扯皮，一旦人们投过票后显示结果为一个简单的排序列表。

query_text: Create a daily check-in reminder app for my phone that helps me and an accountability partner stay on track together, where each morning it gives us a simple prompt to answer about what we plan to do that day and we can see each other's answers, so we actually follow through instead of just saying we will.
query_text_zh: 制作一个手机日常签到提醒应用，帮助我和一个问责伙伴一起保持轨道，每天早晨它给我们一个简单的提示来回答关于那天计划做什么，我们可以看到彼此的答案，这样我们才真的能跟进而不是只嘴上说说。

query_text: Need a phrase bank app on my phone full of conversation starters and topic bridges I can pull up whenever a chat hits a dead stop, organized by situation like a one-on-one hangout versus a group thing versus a work lunch, so I can just glance at a few options and pick something that gets the conversation going again.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机短语库应用，充满对话开场白和话题转接我可以在聊天停滞时拿出来，按场景组织比如一对一聚会对上团体活动对上工作午餐，我只需瞥几个选项选一个让对话继续进行的东西。

query_text: Build a daily compliment reminder app for my phone that nudges me once a day to give someone a genuine compliment, maybe suggests a few ideas so I'm not stuck thinking of something, and lets me log who I complimented each day so I can build up a streak and actually turn it into a real habit over time.
query_text_zh: 开发一个手机日常夸奖提醒应用，每天提醒我一次给某个人一个真诚的赞美，也许会建议几个想法这样我不至于卡壳，还能记录我每天夸过谁，这样我就能连续打卡，真的养成这个习惯。

query_text: Make a mobile app that generates icebreaker questions for events or parties, where I can pick a vibe like fun and silly versus thought-provoking, and it gives me a handful of questions to use, so when I'm hosting something or walking into a networking thing I always have a good opener ready right on my phone.
query_text_zh: 设计一个手机应用生成破冰问题用于活动或派对，可以选择一个调调比如有趣顽皮还是发人深省，它给我几个问题来用，这样当我在举办什么活动或走进人脉拓展场景时我手机里总能有一个好的开场白。

query_text: Build a mobile app with conversation prompt cards for people who get anxious in social situations, where you tap a card and it shows you a simple way to start or continue a conversation, organized by setting like meeting new people versus hanging with acquaintances, so you always have something in your pocket to fall back on when your mind goes blank.
query_text_zh: 制作一个手机对话提示卡应用给在社交场合感到焦虑的人，点击一张卡片它显示开始或继续对话的简单方式，按场景组织比如认识新人对上和熟人闲聊，这样当你的脑子一片空白时你口袋里总有东西可以依靠。

corpus_topic: Book or album release pre-order countdown
query_text: A pre-order countdown app for book or album releases where the whole screen feels like the cover art is breathing, with a big gorgeous timer showing days and hours until the drop date, and a soft animated background that matches the mood of the release so when I open it on my phone it feels like I'm already part of the moment.
query_text_zh: 做一个预售倒计时应用用于书籍或专辑发行，整个屏幕感觉像专辑封面在呼吸，有个大漂亮的计时器显示距发行日期还有多少天和小时，柔和的动画背景配合发行的氛围，这样当我在手机上打开它时感觉像我已经是那一刻的一部分。

query_text: Build a subscription renewal countdown app for my phone that shows all my recurring services in a clean list with a little timer next to each one counting down to the renewal date, so the design feels calm and organized, using soft colors and clear typography so I actually enjoy checking it instead of dreading the surprise charges.
query_text_zh: 开发一个手机订阅续费倒计时应用，在清晰的列表里显示我所有的循环服务，每个旁边有个小计时器倒数到续费日期，设计感觉平静有序，用柔和的颜色和清晰的字体所以我其实喜欢查看而不是害怕意外扣费。

query_text: Create a friendship anniversary reminder app for my phone that feels warm and personal, like a little card for each friend with their name, the date we met or became close, a small countdown to the next anniversary, and maybe a gentle color palette that feels nostalgic and cozy so opening it actually makes me smile and want to reach out.
query_text_zh: 制作一个手机友谊周年提醒应用，感觉温暖且个人化，像每个朋友一张小卡片有他们的名字、我们相识或亲近的日期、距下一个周年还有个小倒计时、也许用一个温情怀旧的柔和调色盘，打开时真的会让我微笑并想主动联系。

corpus_topic: Solar eclipse and astronomical event countdown
query_text: A mobile countdown app for solar eclipses and other sky events where the main screen looks like a deep space view, with a glowing timer counting down to the next big astronomical event, and each event gets its own mood, a solar eclipse feeling dramatic and golden while a meteor shower feels more ethereal and dark-sky calm.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机日食和其他天空事件倒计时应用，主屏幕看起来像深空视图，有个发光的计时器倒数到下一个大天文事件，每个事件都有自己的氛围，日食感觉戏剧性和金黄色，而流星雨感觉更空灵和暗天空平静。

query_text: Make a 100-day personal resolution tracker for my phone that has a satisfying visual feel, like a grid of 100 little tiles you fill in one by one each day, with a warm color gradient that slowly builds as you get further into your streak so the whole thing looks beautiful half-filled and feels really rewarding to check each evening.
query_text_zh: 制作一个手机100天个人目标追踪应用，有满意的视觉感，像100个小瓷砖的网格你每天逐个填充，有个温暖的色彩渐变缓慢构建当你深入你的连续记录，这样半满时整个东西看起来漂亮，每晚查看时感觉真的很有成就感。

corpus_topic: Moving-in date countdown with task checklist
query_text: Build a moving-in countdown app for my phone that feels fresh and exciting to open, with a big timer showing how many days until move-in day and a simple checklist below it for all the tasks I need to knock out before then, using a clean airy look so the whole thing feels organized and like a fun adventure I'm preparing for.
query_text_zh: 设计一个手机搬家倒计时应用，打开时感觉清新且令人期待，有个大计时器显示距搬家日还有多少天，下面有个简单的待办清单列出我在那之前需要完成的所有任务，用清晰通透的外观所以整个东西感觉有组织且像一场我在准备的有趣冒险。

query_text: Build a parenting milestone birthday countdown app for my phone that tracks each kid's next big birthday, like turning one or five or ten, with a warm illustrated feel, showing a countdown in days and a little note about what milestone that age represents so every time I open it on my phone it feels like celebrating something precious.
query_text_zh: 开发一个手机养育孩子的里程碑生日倒计时应用，跟踪每个孩子的下一个重要生日，比如一岁或五岁或十岁，有个温暖的插图感觉，显示以天计的倒计时和一个关于那个年龄代表什么里程碑的小注记，这样每次我在手机上打开它时都感觉像在庆祝什么珍贵的东西。
