query_text: A weight-loss goal date tracker for my phone where I set a target date and my goal weight, and the app shows a gentle progress visual each time I log in, something motivating and soft-toned rather than clinical, with a countdown to the target date and a small encouraging note so it feels supportive and keeps me looking forward.
query_text_zh: 制作一个手机体重减轻目标日期追踪器，设置一个目标日期和目标体重，应用每次我签到时显示一个温和的进度视觉，有点激励和柔和的语调而不是冷冰冰的，有个目标日期的倒计时和一个小的鼓励信息，这样感觉支持性且让我向前看。

query_text: A 21-day habit countdown app for my phone where each day feels like a small ceremony, with a beautifully minimal screen showing the habit name, which day you're on, and a ring or progress arc that fills up over the 21 days in a satisfying slow color shift, so the whole thing looks like something you'd want to screenshot and share when you finish.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机21天习惯倒计时应用，每一天都感觉像一个小仪式，有个漂亮的最小屏幕显示习惯名称、你在第几天和一个环形或进度弧在21天内填充满，用令人满足的缓慢色彩转变，这样整个东西看起来像你在完成时会想截图分享的东西。

query_text: Create a baby due date countdown app for my phone that has a soft dreamy feel, showing a big gentle timer in weeks and days until the due date, with a pastel palette and a little illustrated detail that changes as the due date gets closer, so opening it feels comforting and celebratory during the whole waiting period.
query_text_zh: 制作一个手机预产期倒计时应用，有个柔和梦幻的感觉，显示一个大温和的计时器用周和天计的到预产期，用柔和的调色盘和一个小插图细节随着预产期接近而改变，打开时感觉安慰和庆祝性，贯穿整个等待期。

query_text: Build a final exam countdown app for my phone that has a focused but encouraging feel, where I can add each exam with its date and subject, and the app shows a clean urgency timer for the soonest one with a study hours tracker below it, using a crisp high-contrast look that feels sharp and serious so it actually keeps me in the zone.
query_text_zh: 设计一个手机期末考试倒计时应用，有个专注但鼓励的感觉，我可以添加每场考试及其日期和科目，应用显示一个干净紧迫的最近考试计时器下面有个学习时数追踪，用清晰高对比的外观这样感觉锐利和严肃让我真的保持在状态。

query_text: A color converter tool app on my phone where I can type or paste in a hex code and it instantly shows me the RGB, HSL, and CMYK values all at once, with a big color swatch so I can actually see what the color looks like, and a one-tap copy button next to each value so I stop wasting time switching between tabs to do this manually.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机颜色转换工具应用，可以输入或粘贴一个十六进制代码，立即显示RGB、HSL和CMYK值全部一次性，有个大的颜色样本所以我能真的看到颜色看起来怎么样，每个值旁边有个一键复制按钮这样我就不再浪费时间在标签之间切换手动做这个。

query_text: Make a Morse code app for my phone that lets me type regular text and see it converted to dots and dashes instantly, and also paste in Morse code to decode it back to plain text, with a clear two-way layout so I can use it quickly without figuring out which direction to go, great for games or just satisfying my curiosity about how it works.
query_text_zh: 制作一个手机莫尔斯电码应用，可以输入普通文本看到它立即转换成点和破折号，也可以粘贴莫尔斯电码来将其解码回纯文本，有个清晰的双向布局这样我可以快速使用它而不用弄清楚要去哪个方向，非常适合游戏或只是满足我对它如何工作的好奇心。

query_text: Build a barcode label text generator app for my phone where I type in a name, price, or any short info and it spits out a ready barcode with the text underneath, so I can use it for labeling stuff around the house or small shop items, with a clean output I can screenshot and print rather than hunting for some complicated desktop tool every single time.
query_text_zh: 设计一个手机条形码标签文本生成器应用，输入一个名称、价格或任何短信息它就吐出一个现成的条形码下面有文字，这样我可以用它给房子周围或小商店物品贴标签，有个清晰的输出我可以截图和打印而不是每次都需要找一个复杂的桌面工具。

query_text: A text scrambler tool for my phone where I can type a message and pick either ROT13 or a simple cipher to encode it, and paste scrambled text back in to decode it, so my friends and I can send little coded notes for fun, with two clear input areas so the whole encode-decode flow is obvious and I'm not guessing which box does what.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机文本加扰工具，可以输入一条信息并选择ROT13或简单密码来编码它，粘贴加扰的文本回来解码它，这样我和我的朋友可以为了好玩互相发送小密码信息，有两个清晰的输入区域这样整个编码-解码流程很明显我不会猜测哪个框做什么。

query_text: Create a phone tool that just strips out all the extra spaces and weird invisible characters from text I paste in, because I keep copying stuff from PDFs or group chats and it always has garbage spacing that messes up my documents when I paste it somewhere else and I have to manually clean it up every single time, which is such a waste of time, so I want something where I just dump the text in and hit a button and it comes out clean.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个手机工具，能把我粘贴进去的文本中所有多余的空格和看不见的奇怪字符都清除掉，因为我经常从PDF或群聊里复制东西，出来的文本总是空格乱七八糟的，粘贴到别的地方时文档格式就坏了，我还得一次次手工清理，太浪费时间了，我就想要一个只需要把文本倒进去然后按个按钮就能立刻清理干净的东西。

corpus_topic: Paragraph re-formatter with custom word wrap
query_text: Make a phone tool for reformatting paragraphs where I can set my own line length so the text wraps exactly how I want it, because every time I copy text from somewhere it comes in with random line breaks in the wrong spots and I have to fix it by hand before I can use it anywhere, and it drives me crazy especially when I am dealing with long articles or reports that I need to paste into other places.
query_text_zh: 我想为手机做一个段落重新排版的工具，可以自己设定行长，让文本按照我想要的方式自动换行，因为我从各种地方复制的文本总是带着乱七八糟的换行符，使得我不得不手动修改才能用，特别是处理长篇文章或报告时简直太让人崩溃了，我需要把它们粘贴到其他地方去。

query_text: Create a phone tool that counts syllables in whatever words or lines I type in and then tells me if what I wrote actually works as a haiku, because I keep trying to write them for fun or for class but I always lose count halfway through and end up with the wrong number of syllables without realizing it until someone points it out, so I want something on my phone that just checks it for me instantly.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机工具，能数我输入的任何词语或句子里面的音节数，然后告诉我写的东西是不是正确的五言绝句，因为我一直喜欢自己玩着写或者为课堂作业写，可总是数到一半就数不清了，结果音节数不对也没意识到，后来被别人指出来才知道，我就想要一个手机上的工具能立刻帮我验证一下。

query_text: Need a rhyme finder tool on my phone for when I am trying to write song lyrics and I get totally stuck on a line because I cannot think of anything that rhymes with the word I want to use, it kills the whole flow and I end up sitting there for ages trying to think of something, so I just want to type in a word and get a list of words that rhyme with it so I can pick one that fits and keep going.
query_text_zh: 我想在手机上有一个找韵脚的工具，当我写歌词时卡壳了，实在想不出和某个词有韵脚的词来，那种感觉特别让人沮丧，整个节奏就断了，我就坐在那儿想啊想永远想不出来，我就想直接输入一个词然后得到一堆和它有韵脚的词列表，这样我就能挑一个合适的继续写下去了。

query_text: Make a quick converter tool on my phone that handles Roman numerals and regular numbers both ways, because I keep running into Roman numerals in books, movie titles, and old documents and I always have to stop and try to work it out in my head or search for a calculator, which is annoying when I just want to know what number it actually is without doing mental math every single time.
query_text_zh: 我想在手机上有一个快速转换器，既能把罗马数字转普通数字，也能反过来转，因为我经常在书里、电影标题或老文件里碰到罗马数字，要么我就停下来想半天，要么我就搜一个计算器，特别烦人，我只是想知道那个数字到底是多少，不想每次都得在脑子里硬算。

query_text: Create a phone tool where I can look up any emoji and find out what it actually means and what its code is, because half the time I get emojis from people and I genuinely do not know what they are trying to say and I also sometimes need the code to paste an emoji into a form that does not have a keyboard picker, so I want to be able to search by name or paste the emoji itself and get all that info right there.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机工具可以查任何表情符号，看它到底什么意思，还有它的代码是什么，因为别人发给我的表情符号我经常根本不知道他在说啥，有时候我还需要代码来在一些没有表情符号选择器的表单里粘贴，所以我想能按名字搜或者直接粘贴表情符号，然后立刻就能看到所有信息。

corpus_topic: Text Case Converter UPPER lower Title
query_text: Create a text case converter tool for my phone that can switch whatever I type or paste between all caps, all lowercase, and title case in one tap, because I constantly get text in the wrong case from copy-pasting things and retyping everything just to fix the capitalization is a huge hassle, especially when it is a long piece of text, so I just want to paste it in, tap which style I want, and have it done immediately.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机文字大小写转换工具，可以一键把我输入或粘贴的任何文本在全大写、全小写和标题格式之间切换，因为我一直在从各种地方复制粘贴文本，如果只是为了改大小写就得把整个东西重新输一遍实在太麻烦了，特别是文本很长的时候，我就想粘贴进去，点一下我想要的格式，然后立刻就搞定了。

corpus_topic: Sci-fi alien species and planet name generator
query_text: Need a fun little generator on my phone that makes up sci-fi alien species names and planet names, like I am always working on little story ideas and world-building stuff and I spend way too long trying to come up with names that sound properly alien and not just like random gibberish, so I want something where I just tap a button and it spits out a species name and a planet name together so I can grab whatever sounds cool and use it.
query_text_zh: 我想在手机上有一个好玩的生成器，可以生成科幻外星物种的名字和行星名字，因为我一直在做一些小的故事构思和世界设定的工作，我花太多时间来想那些听起来真正像外星的名字而不是乱七八糟的组合，我就想要一个只需要点一个按钮就能同时生成一个物种名字和一个行星名字的东西，这样我可以从里面挑选听起来酷的来用。

corpus_topic: Random hobby challenge generator for weekends
query_text: Make a phone app that throws random hobby challenges at me for the weekend, because I always end up doing the same things or just scrolling my phone when I have free time and I want something to push me to try something different, so I want to open it up and have it suggest a fun little challenge to try like learn a new skill or make something or go somewhere, something I actually would not have thought of on my own.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个手机应用，在周末给我扔出随机的爱好挑战，因为我总是做同样的事情或者有空的时候就刷手机，我想有什么东西能推我去试试不一样的东西，所以我想打开应用看到它建议一个有趣的小挑战比如学一个新技能或做什么东西或去某个地方，一些我自己根本不会想到的东西。

query_text: Create a startup name idea generator for my phone that I can use when I am brainstorming business ideas, because coming up with a name that sounds catchy and original is honestly one of the hardest parts and I end up going in circles, so I want something where I can tap a button and get a bunch of name ideas I can play with and riff off of, even if they are a bit silly sometimes it helps get the creative side going.
query_text_zh: 我想在手机上有一个创业公司名字创意生成器，我在进行脑力激荡商业想法时可以用，因为想出一个听起来朗朗上口又有创意的名字简直是最难的部分，我经常陷入死循环，我想要一个只需要点一个按钮就能得到一堆名字创意供我玩乐和启发灵感的东西，即使有些名字有点傻，至少能让我的创意思维动起来。

query_text: Create a phone tool that randomly picks a neighbourhood or area of a city for me to explore and gives me a little prompt about what to go check out there, because I live somewhere with tons of interesting spots but I always default to the same familiar areas and never branch out, so I want something that will just tell me where to go this time and give me a reason to actually walk around somewhere new instead of staying in my comfort zone.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机工具，可以随机为我选一个城市的街区或区域去探索，然后给我一点建议关于在那里去看什么，因为我住的地方有成吨的有趣地方但我老是只去那些熟悉的地方，从来不敢往外拓展，我就想要一个工具告诉我这次去哪儿，给我一个真正走到陌生地方去逛一逛的理由，而不是一直待在舒适区里。

query_text: A random emoji art generator on your phone where you tap once and it mashes together a bunch of emojis into a little combination that kind of looks like a scene or a character, something silly and shareable that changes every time you tap, with a way to save or copy whichever one you like so you can send it to friends or use it somewhere.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机上的随机表情符号艺术生成器，点一下就能把一堆表情符号混在一起组成看起来有点像场景或人物的东西，有点傻有点可分享，每次点都不一样，还能存或复制你喜欢的那个，这样你可以发给朋友或在什么地方用。

query_text: Build a phone app that randomly pairs up two star signs and gives a little note about how compatible they are supposed to be, because my friends and I are always joking about astrology stuff and checking compatibility and it would be fun to have something on my phone where I just hit a button and it picks two random signs and tells us if they are a great match or a total disaster, just for laughs.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个手机应用，可以随机搭配两个星座然后给出他们配不配的简短说明，因为我和朋友们一直开玩笑讨论占星术和配对的问题，如果有一个手机上的东西让我点一个按钮就能随机选两个星座然后告诉我们他们是绝配还是完全不搭就太有意思了，纯粹是为了好玩。

query_text: Build a little phone app that suggests random acts of kindness I can actually do, because sometimes I want to do something nice for someone but my brain goes completely blank and I just end up doing nothing, so I want to tap a button and get a real suggestion that I can actually pull off today without any big preparation, something small and doable that would genuinely make someone happy.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个小手机应用，建议我可以真正做的随机善举，因为有时候我想为别人做点好事但我的脑子完全空白了最后什么都没做，我想点一个按钮得到一个真实的建议，我今天真的能做到的，不需要任何大的准备，一些小的可行的东西能真正让别人开心的。

query_text: A random film and documentary picker you can use on your phone when you sit down to watch something and cannot decide what to put on, where it just gives you one suggestion at a time with a short description so you can say yes or skip it and get another one, covering all kinds of genres so you might actually end up watching something you would never have searched for yourself.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机应用随机挑电影和纪录片，当你坐下来想看什么但又决定不了时可以用，它一次给你一个建议并附上简短的描述，你可以说好或者跳过换另一个，涵盖各种类型所以你最后可能看上一部你自己从来不会搜的东西。

query_text: Create a weekend adventure randomizer on my phone that gives me a full little plan for what to do, because every Friday I ask myself what I want to do that weekend and I draw a total blank and then nothing happens and the weekend is wasted, so I want something that will just decide for me and give me an activity, an outing idea, or something creative to try so I actually have a plan to look forward to.
query_text_zh: 我想在手机上有一个周末冒险随机生成器，能给我整个周末的计划，因为每个周五我问自己周末想做什么然后我的脑子就完全空白，然后什么都没发生，周末就浪费了，我想要一个东西能为我决定然后给我一个活动、一个出去的想法或者什么创意东西让我试，这样我就真的有个周末计划可以期待了。

query_text: Need a phone app that picks a random word from a different language every day and shows me what it means and how to say it, because I am always curious about other languages but never know where to start and I thought it would be a fun low-effort way to pick up interesting words over time, so I want something that just gives me one interesting word a day from languages around the world and keeps it light and easy.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机应用每天给我从不同语言里挑一个随机词，告诉我什么意思和怎么说，因为我一直好奇其他语言但从来不知道从哪儿开始，我想这对我来说是一个有趣的低努力办法来慢慢学习一些有趣的词，所以我想要一个应用每天只给我一个从世界各地不同语言来的有趣词汇，让它简单轻松。

query_text: Create a phone app with a spin wheel that picks what to have for dinner tonight, because me and whoever I am eating with go back and forth forever about what to eat and nobody can ever just decide, so I want to put a bunch of meal options on the wheel and just spin it to settle it once and for all, and I want to be able to add or remove options from the wheel so it reflects what we actually feel like eating.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机应用有个转盘可以帮我决定今晚吃什么，因为我和一起吃饭的人总是来回争论着吃什么，没人能下定决心，我想把一堆吃饭的选项放在转盘上然后转一下就一劳永逸了，而且我想能添加或删除转盘上的选项，这样它能反映我们真正想吃什么。

corpus_topic: Time extension mode for timed quiz or tasks
query_text: Build a phone tool that lets me add extra time to a running countdown when I am in the middle of a timed quiz or task and I need just a little more time to finish, because I always run out of time on timed things and it is so stressful when the clock hits zero before I have finished and I lose my progress, so I want a timer on my phone where I can tap a button to extend it by a few minutes without having to stop and reset everything.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机工具让我能在做计时测验或任务时给还在运行的倒数加时间，因为我总是在计时的东西上超时，当时间到零的时候我还没做完简直太压力大了，我会失去进度，所以我想在手机上有个计时器，我可以点一个按钮延长几分钟而不用停下来重新设置所有东西。

query_text: Create a phone tool that always shows text labels next to icons so I never have to guess what a button does, because I get so frustrated when apps just show a little symbol and expect me to know what it means, half the time I have no idea if I am pressing the right thing and I end up tapping the wrong stuff, so I want something where every icon clearly says what it is right underneath it and that label never disappears.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机工具在图标旁边总是显示文字标签这样我从来不用猜某个按钮的作用，因为我对那些只显示一个小符号然后期望我知道它什么意思的应用感到特别沮丧，我经常根本不知道我是不是在按对的东西，我最后就点错了，我想要一个东西每个图标下面清楚地说明它是什么然后那个标签永远不会消失。

corpus_topic: Trigger and overstimulation warning content filter
query_text: A content filter tool on your phone that you can set up to automatically blur or hide anything that might be upsetting or overstimulating before you see it, like you type in the kinds of things that bother you and from then on anything matching those gets hidden behind a tap-to-reveal cover so you stay in control of what you see, useful for people who need to browse without getting blindsided by distressing content.
query_text_zh: 我想在手机上有一个内容过滤工具，可以自动模糊或隐藏任何可能让你不开心或过度刺激的东西，你输入那些让你烦的事的类型，之后任何匹配的东西都会隐藏在一个点击显示的盖子后面，这样你就能控制自己看到什么，对那些需要浏览网页但又不想被令人难受的内容突然袭击的人很有帮助。

query_text: Make a phone tool with a toggle that rewrites complicated text into simpler everyday language when I turn it on, because I run into walls of confusing official or technical writing all the time and I just want to understand what it is actually saying without having to read it five times, so I want to paste something in, flip the toggle, and get a version that sounds like a normal person wrote it.
query_text_zh: 我想在手机上有一个工具有个开关，当我打开时能把复杂的文本改写成更简单的日常语言，因为我一直碰到一堆让人困惑的官方或技术文体，我只是想理解它实际上在说什么而不用读五遍，所以我想粘贴点什么，翻动开关，然后得到一个听起来像普通人写的版本。

query_text: Need a phone tool that lets me set up a quick emergency shortcut so I can reach someone or send a message for help as fast as possible without having to unlock my phone and find a contact and type everything out, because in a real scary moment every second matters and I want something I can set up in advance and then trigger super fast when I actually need it.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机工具让我可以设置一个快速紧急快捷方式，这样我可以尽可能快地联系到某个人或发信息求救，不用解锁手机然后找联系人然后输入所有东西，因为在真正可怕的时刻每一秒都很关键，我想要一个可以提前设置好然后当我真正需要它时超快速触发的东西。

query_text: Build a phone communication tool with a board of picture symbols that predicts what I might want to say next based on what I just picked, for people who have trouble speaking and need to express themselves quickly on their phone, so I want the symbols to be big and easy to tap and the board to get smarter about the kinds of things I say often so I do not have to hunt around for the right symbol every single time.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机通讯工具有个图片符号面板，可以根据我刚选的东西预测我下一个可能想说什么，对那些说话有困难需要在手机上快速表达自己的人来说，我想要这些符号大且容易点击，而且这个面板能学习我经常说的那种东西的规律，这样我就不用每次都费力找到对的符号。

query_text: Build a phone tool that helps cut down on harsh or sudden sounds for people who are sensitive to loud noise, where I can set how much filtering I want and it gives me a calmer listening experience, because sudden loud noises are really overwhelming and I want something I can turn on when I need a quieter environment without having to completely block out all sound around me.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个手机工具帮那些对大声音很敏感的人减少刺耳或突然的声音，我可以设置我想要多少过滤然后它就能给我一个更平和的听觉体验，因为突然的大声音对我来说真的很压倒一切，我想要一个我需要的时候可以打开的东西来制造一个更安静的环境而不用完全阻断我周围的所有声音。

query_text: Create a phone tool that looks at a photo I upload and writes a short description of what is in it so I never have to type those out myself. I always skip that step when posting because it takes too long, but I know I should do it. Just let me tap a photo, get a description I can copy, and move on. Nothing fancy needed, just something that actually works on my phone.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机工具能查看我上传的照片然后写出一个简短的描述说里面有什么，这样我从来不用自己打这些东西。我发帖时总是跳过这一步因为太费时间了，但我知道我应该做。就让我点一张照片，得到一个我能复制的描述，然后继续就行。不需要什么花哨的，就要能在我手机上真正工作的东西。

query_text: A small phone app where you can turn off mouse-style clicking entirely and get around using only the keyboard keys, so everything is reachable without lifting your hands. I keep having to switch back and forth and it wastes so much time. The app should show you what key does what, let you move through things in order, and make it obvious where you are at any moment.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个小手机应用，可以完全关掉鼠标点击，只用键盘按键来操作，这样所有东西都可以在不抬手的情况下操作。我一直得来回切换太浪费时间了。这个应用应该告诉你哪个按键干什么，让你按顺序浏览东西，还要让你清楚地知道你现在在哪儿。

query_text: Need a phone tool that marks the different sections of whatever page you are on so you always know which part you are looking at, like a little indicator that says you are in the navigation area or the main content or the footer. I always get lost scrolling and have to backtrack. Something that quietly shows the region labels without getting in the way would save me a lot of hassle.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机工具标记出你正在看的任何页面的不同部分，这样你总是知道你在看哪一部分，像一个小指示器说你在导航区域或主要内容或页脚里。我经常在滚动时迷路然后得折回去。一个安静地显示区域标签又不打扰我的东西可以为我省很多麻烦。

query_text: Build a phone app that reads whatever is on the screen out loud as soon as it changes, so I do not have to manually trigger anything or tap around to hear what happened. I hate having to go looking for the new content after something loads. It should just narrate things as they appear, with a volume slider and a way to pause if I need quiet, and that is really all I need.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个手机应用，屏幕一有任何变化就马上把它读出来，这样我就不用手动触发什么或点来点去听发生了什么。我讨厌某个东西加载后还得去找新内容。它应该只是在东西出现时叙述，有一个音量滑块和一个我需要安静时可以暂停的方法，就这些了。

corpus_topic: Stopwatch with lap, split and export
query_text: Make a stopwatch app for my phone that can record individual laps and splits while still running, so I can see each interval time right there on the screen without stopping. I do interval training sometimes and I want to see how each round compares. It would also be great if I could save a session and export it somehow, maybe as a simple list I can share or look back at later.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机秒表应用，可以在运行时记录单个圈数和分段时间，这样我可以直接在屏幕上看到每个时间间隔而不用停止秒表。我有时做间歇训练，我想看到每一轮怎么比较的。如果我还能保存一个训练课程然后以某种方式导出它就太好了，也许作为一个简单的列表我可以分享或以后查看。

corpus_topic: Pedometer standalone with lap and distance split
query_text: Create a pedometer app for my phone that counts my steps on its own throughout the day and also lets me mark laps so I can see the distance for each stretch separately. I go for walks in chunks and I always want to know how far each chunk was. I would love to see total distance for the day too, and maybe a simple history so I can check back on how I did this week.
query_text_zh: 我想为手机做一个计步器应用，可以在整个一天里自动计算我的步数，同时还让我标记圈数这样我可以分别看到每段的距离。我分段走路，我总是想知道每段走了多远。我很想看到一天的总距离，还有可能一个简单的历史记录这样我可以查看这周我做得怎么样。

query_text: Build a colour picker app for my phone where I can point the camera at anything and tap to grab the exact colour from that spot. I am always trying to match colours for little craft projects and I end up just guessing. The app should show me the colour code or the name after I pick it, and let me save a few colours together so I can look at them side by side.
query_text_zh: 我想为手机做一个调色板选择器应用，可以用相机指向任何东西然后点击从那个地点获取确切的颜色。我一直在尝试匹配小工艺项目的颜色，我最后就只能瞎猜。这个应用应该在我选择后显示我颜色代码或名称，让我把几个颜色一起保存这样我可以并排看。

corpus_topic: Language alphabet chart for script learning
query_text: Make a phone app that shows me the full alphabet for a writing system I am trying to learn, like all the characters laid out in order with their sounds written next to them so I can see the whole thing at once. I keep forgetting which letter sounds like what when I am reading. Tapping a letter should show me more detail or play the sound, and I want to be able to flip through at my own pace.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机应用为我显示一个我正在学的书写系统的全部字母表，像所有字符按顺序排列并在旁边写上他们的发音这样我可以一次看到整个东西。我经常忘记在阅读时哪个字母听起来像什么。点一个字母应该显示我更多细节或播放声音，我想能按自己的速度翻过去。

corpus_topic: Blood pressure reading log and chart
query_text: Build a blood pressure log app for my phone that lets me type in my readings each time I check and then shows them in a simple chart so I can spot any patterns over time. I check pretty regularly but I keep losing track of the numbers in my notes app. I want to see the date and time next to each reading, and a little graph that shows whether things are going up or down.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个手机血压日志应用，让我每次检查时输入读数然后显示成简单的图表这样我可以看到一段时间内的任何规律。我检查得相当经常但我一直在我的笔记应用里丢失这些数字。我想看到每个读数旁边的日期和时间，和一个显示事情是否在上升或下降的小图表。

query_text: Build a timer app for my phone that can run several countdowns at the same time, each one with its own label so I know what each one is for. I cook a lot and I always have multiple things going at once and my current phone timer only does one at a time. Each timer should ring or buzz separately when it hits zero and I should be able to add or remove them without stopping the others.
query_text_zh: 我想为手机做一个计时器应用，可以同时运行多个倒数计时，每个都有自己的标签这样我知道每个是干什么用的。我做很多饭，我总是有多个东西在一起进行，我现在的手机计时器一次只能做一个。每个计时器应该在到达零时单独响或嗡嗡叫，我应该能添加或删除它们而不用停止其他的。

query_text: Need a breath-hold training timer app for my phone that guides me through the rounds and rest periods, shows how long I have held each time, and keeps a record of my best holds. I practice breath-holding for free diving and right now I just stare at a clock which is not great. Something that walks me through the cycle automatically and logs my progress would make training way easier.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机屏气训练计时器应用，能引导我通过几轮和休息时间，显示我每次屏气多长时间，并记录我最好的成绩。我练习自由潜水屏气，现在我就是盯着钟看这不太好。有个应用能自动引导我通过循环并记录我的进度会让训练容易得多。

query_text: A phone app where you shake it and it randomly picks one action from a list you set up beforehand, so you never have to decide what to do next. I made a little list of stretch routines I want to try but I always end up doing the same one because choosing is annoying. The list should be easy to edit right on the phone, and the random pick should be shown big and clear so it is easy to read.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机应用，你摇它然后它从一个你预先设置好的列表里随机选一个行动，这样你从来不用决定接下来做什么。我做了一个我想尝试的拉伸程序的小列表但我总是最后做同一个因为选择很烦人。这个列表应该容易在手机上编辑，随机选的结果应该显示得大而清楚这样容易读。

query_text: Make a phone companion app for when you are presenting on a bigger screen, so you can see your notes and control what slide is shown without walking back to the computer each time. I do small talks at meetups and I always end up hovering near my laptop. The phone should show me what is coming next and let me tap to move forward or back, just something simple that keeps me free to move around.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机伴侣应用，当你在更大的屏幕上演讲时可以用，这样你可以看到你的笔记并控制显示哪张幻灯片而不用每次都走回电脑，我在小聚会上做短讲演并且我一直在电脑旁边徘徊。手机应该显示我接下来是什么然后让我点击前进或后退，只是简单的能让我自由走动的东西。

corpus_topic: Star map and sky object identifier via AR
query_text: Need a star map app for my phone that uses the camera to show me what stars and planets I am pointing at right now, overlaid on the live view so it feels like I am looking through a window into space. I always look up at night and have no idea what anything is. Just point, see the names, maybe tap on something to get a few facts about it. I want to actually learn what I am looking at.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机星图应用，能用相机显示我现在指向的是什么星星和行星，叠在实时画面上这样感觉像我在看一个通向太空的窗口。我总是抬头看夜空但不知道任何东西是什么。只需要指向、看名字，也许点什么东西来了解一些关于它的事实。我想真的学会我在看什么。

query_text: Make a parking spot saver app for my phone where I can tap one button when I park and it drops a pin right where I am, so I can find my way back without stress later. I park in big lots or unfamiliar streets all the time and I end up wandering around looking for my car. It should show the saved spot on a map so I can walk toward it, and let me clear it once I find the car.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机停车位保存应用，当我停车时可以点一个按钮它就在我的位置滴一个标记，这样我以后可以不用压力地找回路。我在大停车场或陌生的街道上停车，我最后就在周围转来转去找我的车。它应该在地图上显示保存的位置这样我可以朝它走，一旦我找到车就可以清空它。

corpus_topic: Math theorem and proof card deck
query_text: Create a flashcard app for my phone that covers math theorems and their proofs, where each card shows the theorem name and statement on one side and the proof steps on the other so I can quiz myself anywhere. I want to be able to mark the ones I find hard so I review those more, and also filter by topic like geometry or algebra so I can focus on one area at a time when I study.
query_text_zh: 我想为手机做一个闪卡应用，包含数学定理和它们的证明，每张卡片一面显示定理名称和陈述，另一面显示证明步骤这样我可以在任何地方进行自我测试。我想能标记那些我觉得难的，这样我可以更多地复习那些，还能按主题过滤比如几何或代数这样当我学习时可以专注于一个领域。

query_text: Build a phone flashcard app for SAT reading vocabulary where each word is shown inside a real sentence from a passage so I actually understand how it gets used, not just the definition alone. I want to flip the card to see the meaning and part of speech, and mark words as learned or still working on them. Being able to sort by difficulty or by word list would help me stay organized during prep.
query_text_zh: 我想为手机做一个美国高考阅读词汇闪卡应用，每个词都显示在一个真实的句子里来自一篇文章这样我真正理解它是怎么使用的，不只是定义本身。我想翻卡片看到意思和词性，标记词为已学或还在学。能按难度或词汇表排序会帮我在准备时保持条理。

corpus_topic: Bible verse memorization with thematic tag
query_text: Create a Bible verse memorization app for my phone where I can save verses I want to learn and tag them by theme, like faith, patience, or gratitude, so I can pull up a group when I want to focus on one topic. Each card should show the verse text and the reference, and I want a way to quiz myself where some words are hidden and I have to fill them in from memory.
query_text_zh: 我想为手机做一个圣经经文背诵应用，可以保存我想学的经文并按主题标记它们，比如信仰、耐心或感谢，这样当我想专注于一个主题时我可以调出一组。每张卡片应该显示经文文本和参考，我想要一个自我测试的方法，其中一些词被隐藏而我必须从记忆中填入。

query_text: Anatomy labeling cards on my phone where each card shows a part of the body and I have to name it, with a simple diagram or outline so I know which area is being asked about. I am studying for a health class and I keep mixing up names for bones and muscles. I want to go through them in order or shuffle them, and see a score at the end so I know how I am doing.
query_text_zh: 我想要手机上的解剖标签卡片，每张卡片显示身体的一部分我必须给它命名，有一个简单的图表或轮廓这样我知道被问的是哪个区域。我在学健康课并且我一直在混淆骨头和肌肉的名字。我想按顺序通过它们或打乱它们，最后看一个分数这样我知道我做得怎么样。

query_text: Create a financial terms flashcard app for my phone where I can flip through cards with terms on one side and plain-language definitions on the other, so I can actually understand what people mean when they talk about money stuff. I want to sort cards into categories like investing or banking, mark the ones I keep forgetting, and quiz myself on just that marked set until I get them right.
query_text_zh: 我想为手机做一个金融术语闪卡应用，我可以翻过卡片一面显示术语另一面显示简洁语言的定义这样我可以真正理解当人们谈论钱的东西时的意思。我想把卡片排序成类别比如投资或银行，标记那些我一直在忘的，对标记的那个集合进行自我测试直到我答对。

corpus_topic: Geography river and mountain name card
query_text: Create a geography flashcard app for my phone with cards for major rivers and mountain ranges, showing the name and where it is located, so I can learn them properly before my exam. I want to be able to flip the card to see the answer and then mark it as right or wrong so the app tracks which ones I still need to practice. Grouping by continent would help a lot for studying by region.
query_text_zh: 我想为手机做一个地理闪卡应用，有重要河流和山脉的卡片，显示名称和位置这样我可以在我的考试前正确学到它们。我想能翻卡片看到答案然后标记为对或错这样应用追踪我还需要练习哪些。按大洲分组会对按地区学习有很大帮助。

query_text: Literary device cards for my phone where each card names a device like metaphor or foreshadowing on one side and gives a clear definition plus a short example from real writing on the other, so I can actually remember what each one means. I want to filter by type, mark the ones I mix up, and review just those until I have them down. A simple quiz mode at the end of each session would be perfect.
query_text_zh: 我想要手机上的文学设备卡片，每张卡片一面列出一个设备比如隐喻或伏笔，另一面给出清楚的定义加上来自真实写作的简短例子，这样我能真正记住每个的意思。我想按类型过滤，标记那些我搞混的，只复习那些直到我掌握它。每个学习时段末尾一个简单的测试模式会很完美。

query_text: Make a flashcard app for my phone that covers ISO country codes, with the two-letter code on one side and the country name on the other, so I can practice flipping through them whenever I have a spare moment. I deal with these codes at work and I keep having to look them up. I want to mark which ones I always get wrong and have a way to drill just those until I stop making mistakes.
query_text_zh: 我想为手机做一个闪卡应用，包含国际标准化组织国家代码，一面是两字母代码另一面是国家名称这样我可以在有空闲时间时练习翻过。我在工作中处理这些代码然后我一直得查一下。我想标记哪些我总是答错的，有个办法只钻那些直到我停止犯错。

query_text: Need a phone app for learning the NATO phonetic alphabet, with a card for each letter showing the word like Alpha or Bravo along with what letter it stands for, so I can flip through and quiz myself until I have them memorized. query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机应用来学习北约音素字母表，每个字母一张卡片显示词比如Alpha或Bravo以及它代表什么字母，这样我可以翻过卡片进行自我测试直到我背下来。我在一个工作地方使用这些通过电话然后我仍然得想太久。能打乱卡片和追踪我一直在错的哪些对确实会很有帮助。

query_text: Need a phone app full of business idioms and phrases, where each card shows the expression on one side and the meaning plus an example sentence on the other, so I can study them on the go. I keep running into phrases like touch base or move the needle in meetings and I am not always sure what they mean. I want to organize them by category and mark the ones I am still shaky on so I can revisit them.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机应用充满商业成语和短语，每张卡片一面显示表达另一面显示意思加上一个例句这样我可以在路上学习。我一直在会议上碰到短语比如顺便说一下或推动指标，然后我不总是确定他们的意思。我想按类别组织它们并标记那些我仍然摇摇欲坠的那些这样我可以再次查阅。

query_text: Create a CSS property quick-reference card tool for my phone where I can look up any CSS property and instantly see what it does, what values it accepts, and a simple example. I want the properties organized into groups like layout, text, color, and spacing so I can find things quickly without scrolling forever. It should be easy to tap through on mobile and load fast.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个 CSS 属性速查卡工具，我可以查任何 CSS 属性，马上看到它是干什么的、接受什么值，还有简单的例子。我想把属性按布局、文本、颜色、间距这样分组，这样我能快速找到东西，不用一直往下滑。手机上操作要方便，加载也要快。
