corpus_topic: Cohort progress leaderboard and peer ranking
corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面
query_text: Build a cohort progress leaderboard and peer ranking tool for my phone that shows me where I stand among my classmates based on lessons completed or quiz scores. I want to see a ranked list with names and scores, my own position highlighted so I can spot it quickly, and be able to tap any person to see a bit more about their progress so I know what I need to do to catch up.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个同学进度排行榜和同伴排名工具，显示我在同学中的位置，基于完成的课程或小测得分。我想看到一个有名字和得分的排名列表，我自己的位置高亮显示这样我能快速找到，还能点某个人看更多关于他们进度的信息，这样我知道我需要做什么来跟上。

corpus_topic: Subtitle and transcript toggle in video player
corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面
query_text: Create a mobile app for online classes that has a subtitle and transcript toggle built into the video player, so I can switch captions on or off with one tap and also pull up the full written transcript of the lesson when I want to read along or search for a specific part. I want the transcript to show the current line highlighted as the video plays, and the subtitles to stay readable at the bottom of the video without covering too much of the screen.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上的在线课程做一个应用，在视频播放器里内置字幕和文本记录切换，我可以一点打开或关闭字幕，还能打开完整的课程文字记录在上面阅读或搜索特定部分。我想文字记录显示当前行随着视频播放而高亮，字幕要在屏幕下方清晰可读又不要覆盖太多视频内容。

corpus_topic: In-lesson notebook for personal text notes
corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面
query_text: Create a note-taking app for phone that lets me write personal text notes while a lesson is playing, so I can jot things down without leaving the class. I want the notes area to stay on the same screen as the lesson player, and each note I save should automatically record which lesson it came from and roughly where in the lesson I wrote it, so I can go back and find the right spot later.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个笔记应用，让我在课程播放时可以记录个人文本笔记，这样我能记下东西又不用离开课程。我想笔记区域和课程播放器在同一个屏幕上，我保存的每条笔记要自动记录它来自哪个课程和我大概在课程的什么位置写的，这样我之后能回去找对的地方。

corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面
query_text: A resource manager app for my phone where each course has its own list of downloadable files and attachments, things like PDFs, slides, and worksheets. I want to see the file name, type, and size at a glance, tap to download, and have a separate section that collects everything I have already saved so I can find it quickly without digging through each course one by one.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个资源管理应用，每个课程都有自己的可下载文件和附件列表，比如 PDF、幻灯片、工作表这样的东西。我想快速看到文件名、类型和大小，点击下载，还有一个单独的部分收集我已经保存的所有东西，这样我能快速找到而不用逐个课程挖。

corpus_topic: Live poll and emoji reaction in class session
corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面
query_text: Create a mobile app for live class sessions that lets the teacher run a quick poll and lets students answer with a tap, and also lets everyone send emoji reactions during the lesson to show they understand or have a question. I want the poll results to show up right away so the whole class can see how people voted, and the emoji reactions to float up the screen briefly so they feel lively but do not get in the way.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上的直播课堂做一个应用，让老师可以快速发起一个投票学生可以点击回答，还让大家可以在课程中发送表情符号反应显示他们理解或有问题。我想投票结果马上显示出来这样全班都能看到投票情况，表情符号反应在屏幕上浮动一下这样感觉生动但不会挡路。

corpus_topic: Breakout room group display and join
corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面
query_text: Make a mobile app for online classes that shows all the small group rooms available during a session, with each room listed by name or topic and how many people are already in it, so I can pick the right one and join with a single tap. I want to see my current group clearly at the top and have an easy way to switch rooms if the teacher reassigns me.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上的在线课程做一个应用，显示一个课程中可用的所有小组房间，每个房间按名字或主题列出，显示已经进去的人数，这样我能选对房间一点就加入。我想在上面清楚看到我的当前组别，还要有简单的方法切换房间如果老师重新分配了我。

corpus_topic: Course recommendation based on completion history
corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面
query_text: Build a mobile app that recommends courses based on what I have already finished, so when I complete something it immediately suggests a few related things I might want to take next. I want each recommendation to show the course name, a short description, and roughly how long it takes, and I want to be able to tap to save any one of them to a personal list so I can come back to it when I am ready.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个应用，基于我已经完成的课程推荐新课程，所以当我完成一个时它马上建议几个相关的我可能想学的东西。我想每个推荐显示课程名、简短描述、大概要花多长时间，还能点选任何一个保存到个人列表这样我能以后准备好时再回来看。

corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面
query_text: Need a course tracker app for my phone that always remembers exactly where I left off in any lesson, so I can tap a big continue button right from the home screen and jump back in instantly. I want it to show the course name, the lesson I was on, and a progress bar so I know how far along I am, and the continue button should take me directly to the right spot in the video without any extra taps.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个课程追踪应用，它总是记住我在任何课程的任何课时的确切位置，这样我能在主屏幕点一个大的继续按钮马上跳回去。我想它显示课程名、我在的课时、进度条这样我知道我完成了多少，继续按钮应该直接把我带到视频的对的地方，不用额外点击。

corpus_topic: Glossary and term definition sidebar panel
corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面
query_text: Need a learning app for my phone that includes a built-in glossary I can open from any lesson, where I can look up terms and get a clear plain-language definition right away. I want the glossary to stay accessible as a panel that slides in from the side so I never lose my place in the lesson, and I also want to be able to search for a term by typing part of the word when I am not sure of the exact spelling.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个学习应用，里面内置一个词汇表我可以从任何课程打开，我可以查词条得到清晰的简明白话定义马上就能看。我想词汇表作为从侧边滑进来的面板保持可用这样我不会失去在课程中的位置，我还想能通过输入单词的一部分来搜索，即使我不确定精确拼法。

corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面
query_text: Make a mobile assignment app for courses where students can submit their work for peer review and also review a classmate's submission using a clear scoring guide that lists each thing being evaluated. I want the scoring guide to have a few simple criteria with a rating option for each one, and a text box at the bottom where I can leave a short comment, all on a single screen so the whole review process is quick and straightforward on my phone.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个课程作业应用，学生可以提交他们的作业供同学评审，还可以用一个清晰的评分指南评审同学的提交，指南列出每一个要评估的内容。我想评分指南有几个简单的标准，每个都有个评分选项，下面有个文本框让我留短评论，所有内容在一个屏幕上这样在手机上整个评审过程很快很直接。

corpus_topic: Survival phrase guide for foreign language
query_text: Need a survival phrase guide app for my phone when I travel or study a foreign language and just need the basics fast, without flipping through a textbook. I want the phrases grouped by situation, things like ordering food, asking for directions, or handling an emergency, so I can tap the right category and find the phrase I need in seconds, with a pronunciation hint next to each one.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个求生短语指南应用，我旅游或学外语时快速需要基础东西，不用翻课本。我想按情况分组比如点菜、问路、处理紧急情况，这样我点对的分类马上能找到我需要的短语，每个旁边有个发音提示。

query_text: Build a star and constellation reference app for my phone that I can check quickly when I am out at night or cramming for a test, because I always forget which stars belong to which constellation. I want to tap on a constellation name and see a simple diagram of its shape, the names of its main stars, and a few key facts about it, all on one screen so I am not hunting through multiple pages.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个星座和星群参考应用，我晚上出去时或考前突击时可以快速查看，因为我总是忘不了哪些星属于哪个星座。我想点一个星座名字就看到它形状的简单图表、主要恒星名字、一些关键事实，都在一个屏幕上这样我不用翻多个页面。

corpus_topic: Electrical circuit law and formula sheet
query_text: Create a formula reference app for my phone that covers electrical circuit laws like Ohm's law, Kirchhoff's rules, and power calculations, so I can pull up the right formula in class or during homework without digging through my notes. I want each formula displayed clearly with the variable names spelled out and a quick example of how to use it, and I want them organized by topic so I can find the one I need with one tap.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个公式参考应用，涵盖电路法则比如欧姆定律、基尔霍夫法则、功率计算，这样我在课堂上或做作业时能快速找到正确的公式而不用翻笔记。我想每个公式清楚显示，变量名写出来，还有快速的使用例子，按主题组织这样我一点就能找到我需要的。

query_text: Build a statistics helper app for my phone that walks me through picking the right test for my data by asking me a few simple questions, like whether my data is comparing groups or looking at a relationship, and then showing me which test fits. I want it to explain in plain words why that test was chosen and what I need to check before using it, so I stop guessing every time I sit down to analyze something.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个统计助手应用，通过问我几个简单问题指导我选对的统计检验，比如我的数据是比较组还是看关系，然后告诉我适合哪个检验。我想它用简明白话解释为什么选了这个检验、用之前需要检查什么，这样我停止每次要分析时都瞎猜。

query_text: A reference tool for my phone that lays out the main project management frameworks, things like Agile, Waterfall, Scrum, and Kanban, side by side so I can actually see how they differ without reading a long article. I want each framework to have a short description, its best use cases, and the key pros and cons listed in a simple table format, so the whole comparison fits neatly on one screen.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个参考工具，把主要项目管理框架比如敏捷、瀑布、 Scrum、看板并排放在一起这样我能实际看到它们怎么不同而不用读长文章。我想每个框架有短描述、最佳用例、关键优缺点用简单表格格式列出，这样整个比较能在一个屏幕上展开。

corpus_topic: Color theory and design principle reference
query_text: A color theory reference app for my phone that I can check whenever I am stuck on a design decision and need a quick reminder of how colors work together. I want it to cover the basics like complementary, analogous, and triadic color combos, plus a short note on contrast and readability, and each concept should show a visual example right next to the explanation so I understand it at a glance without reading a wall of text.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个色彩理论参考应用，任何我卡在设计决定并需要快速回忆色彩怎样配合的时候都能查。我想涵盖基础知识比如互补、类似、三角配色，加上关于对比和易读性的短笔记，每个概念旁边要显示视觉例子这样我能一眼理解而不用读一堆文字。

query_text: Build a photography guide app for my phone that helps me get the exposure right in any situation, because I can never remember how aperture, shutter speed, and ISO all work together when the light changes. I want a simple chart showing what each setting does to the image, with a few common scenarios like sunny outdoors or dim indoor, and a quick suggestion for where to start so I stop wasting shots guessing.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个摄影指南应用，帮我在任何情况下得到正确的曝光，因为我光线变化时永远记不住光圈、快门速度、ISO怎样一起工作。我想简单的图表显示每个设置怎样影响图像，有几个常见场景比如晴天户外或昏暗室内，快速建议从哪里开始这样我不用浪费拍摄次数瞎猜。

query_text: Make a first aid guide app for my phone that shows the steps for common emergencies in a clear numbered order so I can actually follow along in a stressful moment without reading a paragraph. I want things like CPR, choking, burns, and cuts each on their own screen with the most important step first and a simple note on what to watch out for, because when something goes wrong I need to find the right card fast and just do what it says.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个急救指南应用，常见紧急情况的步骤用清晰的编号顺序显示这样我在紧急时刻能真正跟着做而不用读一段文字。我想比如 CPR、窒息、烧伤、割伤这样的东西每个都在自己的屏幕，最重要的步骤在前面，短笔记说要注意什么，因为出了事我需要快速找到对的卡片然后按它说的做。

query_text: Need a tax reference app for my phone that shows the current income tax brackets in a simple table so I can quickly see which bracket my income falls into without searching through government websites. I want it to also list the most common deductions and credits people actually use, with a plain-language explanation of each one, so I can figure out roughly what applies to me before I talk to anyone or fill out any forms.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个税务参考应用，显示当前所得税级次在简单表格里这样我能快速看我的收入在哪个级次而不用翻政府网站。我还想它列出最常见的扣除和抵免人们真正在用，每个用简明白话解释，这样我能粗略看看什么可能适用于我在我跟谁聊或填任何表格前。

query_text: Build a sports rules reference app for my phone that lets me look up the scoring system for different sports, like how points are counted in tennis, volleyball, or basketball, so I stop having to explain that I have no idea what just happened. I want each sport to have a short summary of how scoring works and what counts as a foul or out, so I can pull it up quickly during a game and actually follow along.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个体育规则参考应用，让我查不同体育的计分系统，比如网球、排球、篮球怎么计分，这样我不用再解释我根本不知道刚发生了什么。我想每个体育有计分工作原理的简短总结和什么算犯规或出界，这样我能在比赛中快速打开看着实际跟上。

query_text: Make a machine learning reference app for my phone that puts the common models side by side in a plain comparison, covering things like when to use each one, what kind of data it works with, and roughly how complex it is. I am always mixing up which algorithm to try first, so I want each row of the comparison to be short and scannable, and I want to be able to tap a model name to see a bit more detail without leaving the app.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个机器学习参考应用，把常见模型并排放在简单比较里，涵盖什么时候用每个、什么样数据适合、大概有多复杂。我总是混淆先试哪个算法，所以我想比较的每一行都很短容易扫一眼，我还想能点模型名字看更多细节而不用离开应用。

corpus_l2_key: ① 待办清单/任务管理
query_text: Build a shared chore tracker app for my phone that lets everyone in the house see which chores are assigned to them this week and mark them done with a tap. I want the chores to rotate automatically on a set schedule, like weekly or every few days, so no one person is stuck doing the same thing every time, and I want a simple view that shows at a glance who still has something pending so we can actually keep each other accountable.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个家务分配追踪应用，让家里每个人都能看到这周分配给他们的家务，一点就标记为完成。我想家务按一个固定时间表自动轮换，比如每周或每几天，这样没有人会老是做同一件事，还要有个简单的视图一眼显示谁还有待处理的，这样我们能真的互相问责。

corpus_l2_key: ① 待办清单/任务管理
query_text: Make a reading and research queue app for my phone that lets me add articles, papers, or books I want to get through, so I stop saving links in random chat messages and then losing them. I want to be able to quickly add something with just a title and maybe a link, mark items as done when I finish them, and have the unread ones sorted by how long ago I added them so the oldest things do not get buried forever.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个阅读和研究队列应用，让我添加我想读完的文章、论文或书，这样我能停止把链接保存在随机聊天里然后丢失它们。我想快速添加东西，只要标题也许一个链接，标记项目为完成，还要把未读的按我添加它们多久前排序这样最旧的东西不会被埋没。

corpus_l2_key: ① 待办清单/任务管理
query_text: A task follow-up app for my phone where I can log things I have handed off to other people, like tasks I asked a teammate or family member to handle, and set a date to check back in on them. I want to see all my delegated items in one list sorted by the follow-up date, with the person's name and a short note on what they were supposed to do, so I have a clear picture of what is waiting on someone else and I actually remember to follow up.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个任务跟进应用，我可以记录我交接给别人的东西，比如我要求同事或家人处理的任务，设置一个日期来回顾它们。我想在一个列表里看到所有委派的项目按跟进日期排序，有这个人的名字和他们应该做什么的短笔记，这样我能清楚看到什么在等别人而我真的会记得跟进。

corpus_topic: Color-coded context label system (work, home, errand)
corpus_l2_key: ① 待办清单/任务管理
query_text: Make a to-do manager app for my phone that lets me label each task with a color-coded category, like work, home, or errand, so I can see at a glance what kind of thing is on my list without reading every entry. I want to be able to filter by category with one tap so I can focus on just the work tasks during office hours and just the home stuff on weekends, and adding a label should be as quick as picking a color when I create the task.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个待办事项管理应用，让我给每个任务用色彩编码分类，比如工作、家务或跑腿，这样我一眼看到我的列表是什么种类的事情而不用读每一条。我想能一点按分类过滤这样我可以在办公时间专注工作任务，周末专注家务，添加标签应该像创建任务时选个颜色一样快。

corpus_l2_key: ① 待办清单/任务管理
query_text: Need a task manager app for my phone that lets me duplicate any existing task in one tap and also save tasks as templates I can apply again later, because I keep re-typing the same recurring tasks from scratch every time. I want the cloned task to come up ready to edit with all the original details filled in, and templates should be easy to find in a separate saved list so I am not hunting for the one I set up last month.
query_text_zh: 给我手机上做一个任务管理应用，让我一点复制任何已存在的任务，还能把任务保存为模板以后再用，因为我总是一遍遍把相同的重复任务从头重新打一遍。我想克隆的任务显示为准备好编辑、原始所有细节都填好，模板应该容易在单独的保存列表里找到这样我不是在找我上个月设置的。

corpus_topic: Sequential task unlock (next step gated by prior)
corpus_l2_key: ① 待办清单/任务管理
query_text: Create a task manager for my phone where steps unlock one by one, so you can only tap into step 2 after you finish step 1, step 3 after step 2, and so on down the list. I hate when I accidentally jump ahead and skip something important, so I want each next step to stay locked until the previous one is marked done, with a clear visual showing which step I'm currently on and how many are left.
query_text_zh: 给我的手机做一个任务管理器，各个步骤要逐个解锁，只有完成第1步才能点进第2步，完成第2步才能进第3步，这样一个接一个。我特别讨厌不小心跳过某个步骤，所以我想要每一个下一步都锁着，直到上一步标记为完成。还要有清楚的视觉效果显示我现在在哪一步，还剩多少步。

corpus_topic: Completed task archive with full-text search
corpus_l2_key: ① 待办清单/任务管理
query_text: A completed tasks archive for a mobile to-do manager where everything you finish gets saved and you can search through it all by typing any keyword, so when your boss asks what you did last month you can actually find it fast. The archive should list finished items with the date they were completed, and the search bar should filter results as you type so you're not scrolling through hundreds of old entries.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机待办事项管理器，里面要有已完成任务的存档功能，所有完成的事情都自动保存下来，我可以通过输入任何关键词来搜索查找，这样boss问我上个月干了什么我能快速找到。存档要显示完成的项目和完成日期，搜索栏要在我打字的时候就实时筛选结果，这样我就不用在几百条旧记录里翻来翻去。

corpus_topic: Smart due-date suggestion from past behavior
corpus_l2_key: ① 待办清单/任务管理
query_text: Create a to-do manager for my phone that looks at how long I usually take to finish similar tasks and suggests a realistic due date when I add something new, so I stop setting deadlines I obviously won't hit. When I type a task name the app should show a suggested date based on my past finishing times, and I can tap to accept it or change it if I want.
query_text_zh: 做个手机待办管理器，能看我通常需要多长时间完成类似的任务，然后在我添加新任务时自动建议一个现实的截止日期，这样我就不会总是设定根本完成不了的期限。我输入任务名称时，应用应该根据我过去的完成时间显示建议日期，我可以点击接受或者改一下。

corpus_l2_key: ① 待办清单/任务管理
query_text: Make a planner app for my phone that takes the deadline I set on a task and automatically adds a time block to my calendar so I don't have to go do it manually every single time. When I set a due date and time on any task, it should show up as a calendar entry for that day, and I can see all my task deadlines laid out on the calendar on one screen so I know what days are already packed.
query_text_zh: 给我做个手机规划应用，我在任务上设置的截止日期能自动添加到日历上面形成一个时间块，这样我就不用每次都手动去做。任何任务的截止日期和时间一旦设置，就应该在日历上显示为那一天的一个日历条目，我可以在一个屏幕上看到所有任务的截止日期，这样我能知道哪些天已经排满了。

corpus_topic: Habit task streak with streak-protection option
corpus_l2_key: ① 待办清单/任务管理
query_text: Build a habit tracker for my phone that shows a streak count for each habit I log every day, so I can see my longest run without breaking it, and also has a streak-protection option I can use once in a while when I genuinely miss a day by accident, so one missed day doesn't wipe out two months of effort. The main screen should show each habit with its current streak number and a row of the past week's check-ins at a glance.
query_text_zh: 帮我做个手机习惯追踪器，每天记录的每个习惯都显示一个连续天数计数器，这样我能看到最长的坚持纪录没有打断，还有一个连续天数保护功能，我偶尔可以用一次，万一不小心漏了一天也不至于把两个月的努力全毁了。主屏幕应该显示每个习惯的当前连续天数和过去一周的打卡情况概览。

query_text: A focus timer app for my phone that keeps running in the background even when I switch to another app, and sends a buzz or pulse to my phone when the session ends so I actually notice it, because right now I start a timer and then miss it completely when I'm deep in work. The timer should be simple to start, show the countdown when I flip back to it, and give a clear vibration alert when time is up.
query_text_zh: 做个手机专注计时器应用，就算我切换到其他应用后它也能继续在后台运行，当时间到了要能发出嗡鸣或脉冲来提醒我，因为我现在经常启动计时器然后完全没注意到时间已经到了。计时器启动要简单，我切回来时能看到倒计时，时间到了要有清晰的震动提醒。

corpus_topic: Focus mode app and website blocker
query_text: Build a focus timer for my phone that also blocks the apps and sites I keep getting distracted by during a work session, so I can actually get through a solid chunk of time without falling into social media. I want to set a list of apps or websites to block at the start of each session, and the blocking turns off automatically when the timer runs out so I don't have to remember to unblock anything.
query_text_zh: 为我的手机做个专注计时器，还要能在工作时段屏蔽那些我经常分心的应用和网站，这样我才能真正安心工作一段时间，不至于陷进社交媒体。我想在每个计时session开始时设置一个要屏蔽的应用或网站列表，计时器时间到了屏蔽就自动解除，我不用记着手动解除。

corpus_topic: Energy level diary correlated to focus time
query_text: Build a daily logger for my phone where I can quickly note my energy level at different points in the day, like high, medium, or low, and it shows me a chart pairing those energy ratings alongside my focus session times so I can actually see if I tend to focus better in the morning or afternoon. I want to tap in my energy level in seconds and have the app draw the connection over a week or two of data.
query_text_zh: 做个手机日常记录应用，我能在一天的不同时间点快速记录我的能量水平，比如高、中等、低这样，然后它把这些能量等级和我的专注session时间配对在一起显示，这样我能看出我是不是早上专注力更好还是下午更好。我想要能在几秒钟内记录能量水平，应用能在一两周的数据基础上找出关联。

corpus_topic: Binaural beat and focus frequency player
query_text: A focus sound player for my phone that plays binaural beats or other concentration-boosting audio during work sessions, with a few preset options like deep focus, light focus, or relaxed concentration so I can just tap one and go. The player should run alongside a simple timer so when the focus session ends the audio stops too, and I can adjust the volume without leaving the app.
query_text_zh: 给我的手机做个专注音乐播放器，能在工作时段播放双耳节拍或其他能帮助集中注意力的音频，有几个预设选项比如深度专注、轻度专注或放松集中，我只要点一个就能用。播放器应该配合一个简单的计时器运行，当专注session结束时音频也跟着停止，我可以调节音量而不用离开应用。

query_text: Make a reminder app for my phone that pings me every 20 minutes to look away from my screen and stare at something about 20 feet away for 20 seconds, because my eyes are killing me from staring at screens all day and I keep forgetting to take breaks. The app should let me start and stop the reminders with one tap, count down to the next break, and show a simple prompt on screen when it's time to look away.
query_text_zh: 给我的手机做个提醒应用，每20分钟就提醒我一次要看离屏幕远一点的东西，眼睛要盯着约20英尺远的地方看20秒钟，因为我整天盯着屏幕眼睛快废了，总是忘记休息。应用要让我用一个按钮就能开启和停止这个提醒，显示下一次休息的倒计时，到时间了屏幕上显示一个简单的提示。

corpus_topic: Accountability partner sync for co-focus session
query_text: Build a co-focus timer for my phone where I can link up with a friend or coworker and both of us run the same focus session at the same time, so we keep each other honest about actually sitting down to work. The app should let me share a session code with someone, show both our names and a shared countdown once they join, and let us see when the other person finishes their session.
query_text_zh: 为我的手机做个共同专注计时器，我能和朋友或同事连接起来一起进行同一个专注session，这样我们能互相督促认真坐下来工作。应用要让我分享一个session代码给别人，一旦他们加入了就显示我们两个人的名字和共享倒计时，还要能看到对方什么时候完成他们的session。

corpus_topic: Focus journal prompt at session end
query_text: Make a focus timer for my phone that shows a short journal prompt right when a session ends, so I can jot down one or two sentences about what I actually got done or what got in the way, before I forget. The prompts should change each time, and I want to be able to scroll back through past session notes so I can see how my focus sessions have been going over the past week or so.
query_text_zh: 给我的手机做个专注计时器，当一个session结束时立刻显示一个简短的日记提示，我能快速写下一两句话说说我到底完成了什么或者什么东西挡住了我的路，趁着记忆还新鲜的时候。每次的提示应该不一样，我想要能往回翻看之前的session笔记，这样我能看出最近几周我的专注情况怎么样。

corpus_topic: Daily focus time goal and progress ring
query_text: Create a focus tracker for my phone that lets me set a daily goal for total focused minutes and shows a progress ring filling up as I complete sessions throughout the day, so I can tell at a glance whether I'm on track or falling behind. When I hit my daily goal the ring completes and I get a small celebration moment, and each new day the ring resets so I'm always working toward today's goal.
query_text_zh: 为我的手机做个专注追踪器，让我能设置一个每日的总专注分钟数目标，然后显示一个进度环，随着我全天完成的session逐步填充，这样我能一眼看出我是在轨道上还是落后了。当我达成每日目标时进度环会完成并给我一个小庆祝时刻，然后新的一天进度环重置，这样我总是在为今天的目标而努力。

corpus_topic: Weekend vs weekday focus comparison chart
query_text: Need a focus stats tracker that works as a mobile app and shows me a simple comparison of how many minutes I focused on weekdays versus weekends, because I have a feeling I barely get anything done on weekends but I want to actually see the numbers. The chart should let me flip between the current week and past weeks, and show the total for each type of day side by side so the difference is obvious.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用能追踪我工作日和周末的专注分钟数对比，因为我觉得周末基本上没干什么，但我想真正看到数字说话。表格要能让我在当前周和过去的周之间切换查看，并且要把每种日子的总数并排显示，这样差异一目了然。

query_text: Create a productivity analyzer for my phone that tracks when during the day I log my focus sessions and figures out which hours I'm most consistently productive, then shows me a simple breakdown like a bar chart by hour so I can see my peak times at a glance. I want to be able to look back over a week or two of sessions to see the pattern, so I can start scheduling my hardest work during those hours.
query_text_zh: 为我的手机做个生产力分析器，追踪我一天中什么时间记录的专注session，并找出我一天中哪个小时最有一致的生产力，然后用柱状图这样的简单图表按小时显示给我，这样我能一眼看出我的高效时段。我想要回顾一两周的session数据来看清楚这个规律，这样我就能开始在那些时间段安排最困难的工作。

query_text: Need a conference schedule app for my phone that lists all the sessions happening at an event by time slot, lets me tap any session to see the full title, speaker, and room location, and lets me mark the ones I want to attend so I have a personal lineup ready. I want the schedule laid out in time order for each day of the conference, so I can plan my day quickly each morning without hunting through a PDF.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机会议日程应用，按时间段列出活动中所有happening的session，我能点进任何一个session看完整的标题、演讲者和房间位置，还能标记我想参加的，这样我就有个个人的日程安排好了。我想日程要按时间顺序为会议的每一天排列，这样我每天早上能快速规划一天，不用去翻PDF。

corpus_topic: Weekly review scheduler and reflection prompt
query_text: Build a weekly review planner for my phone that reminds me once a week at a time I pick to sit down and do a quick reflection, then walks me through a set of short prompts asking things like what went well, what I want to carry into next week, and what I want to do differently. I want to be able to scroll back through past reviews so I can see how my thinking has shifted over the months.
query_text_zh: 为我的手机做个周回顾规划器，每周在我选择的时间提醒我一次坐下来快速反思，然后通过一系列简短的提示问题引导我，比如什么进展顺利、我想把什么带入下一周、我想做什么改变。我想能往回翻看过去的review，这样我能看出几个月来我的想法怎么变化的。

corpus_topic: Time-zone aware event creation for global team
query_text: Make a meeting planner for my phone where I can add team members in different cities, pick a meeting time, and immediately see what time that is for everyone on the list, so I stop accidentally scheduling calls at 2am for someone. The tool should show a simple list of each person's location and local time when I pick a slot, and flag times that fall outside normal working hours for anyone on the team.
query_text_zh: 为我的手机做个会议规划器，我能加进来不同城市的团队成员，选择一个会议时间，然后立刻看到这个时间对名单上每个人来说是几点，这样我就不会不小心给某人安排凌晨2点的会议。这工具应该在我选择时间段时显示每个人所在位置和当地时间的简单列表，还要标出那些对团队中任何人来说都不在正常工作时间内的时间。

query_text: Need a calendar planner for my phone that lets me copy an existing event with one tap and then just change the date on the copy, because I have a bunch of recurring-ish meetings that happen every few weeks at different times and retyping all the details every time is a pain. Once I duplicate an event I want to be able to edit the date, time, or title on the copy without touching the original.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机日历规划器，让我能用一个按钮复制现有的活动然后只改变复制版本的日期，因为我有很多几周发生一次但时间不固定的反复出现的会议，每次都要从头把所有细节打一遍特别烦。复制一个活动后我想要能编辑复制版本的日期、时间或标题，原始的不要动。

corpus_topic: Meeting note auto-linked to calendar event
query_text: Need a meeting notes app for my phone where I can pull up any calendar event and attach typed notes directly to it, so all my notes for a meeting live right alongside the event details instead of scattered across random documents. When I open a past event I should be able to read back everything I wrote for that meeting, and ideally search across all my meeting notes by keyword to find something specific from a past conversation.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机会议笔记应用，我能打开任何日历活动然后把类型的笔记直接附加到它上面，这样一个会议的所有笔记就能和活动细节住在一起，而不是散落在随机的文档里。我打开过去的活动时应该能读回我为那个会议写的所有东西，最好还能按关键词搜索所有会议笔记来找某个过去对话中的具体内容。

corpus_topic: Work-life balance time allocation pie view
query_text: A time tracker for my phone that splits my logged hours into work and personal categories and shows a pie chart of how my time is divided across a week, so I can actually see whether I'm working way more than I planned or leaving enough room for personal stuff. I want to tap to log time quickly by category, and the chart should update as I add entries so the balance is always visible on the main screen.
query_text_zh: 给我的手机做个时间追踪器，要把我记录的小时数分成工作和个人两个类别，然后显示一个饼图展示我的时间在一周内怎么分配的，这样我能真正看出我工作时间是不是比计划多得多，还是留够了个人时间。我想快速点按来按类别记录时间，表格应该随着我添加条目而更新，所以主屏幕上一直能看到时间的平衡。

query_text: An out-of-office planner tool for my phone where I can write a custom away message, set the start and end dates for when I'll be away, and save multiple message templates for different situations like vacation, sick day, or conference travel. The app should show me which template is currently active and when it's set to turn off, so I can glance at it and know everything is in order before I go offline.
query_text_zh: 给我的手机做一个外出假期规划工具，我能写一条自定义的离开提示消息，设置离开的开始和结束日期，保存多个不同情况下的消息模板，比如度假、病假或会议出差。应用应该显示我现在哪个模板是激活的，它设置成什么时候关闭，这样我在离线前可以一眼扫一下知道一切都准备好了。

corpus_topic: School timetable and class schedule viewer
query_text: Make a class schedule app for my phone that shows my weekly timetable in a grid with each day across the top and time slots down the side, so I can see all my classes at a glance and tap any class block to check the room number, teacher name, and any notes I've added. I want to be able to set it up once at the start of the semester and have it just show me today's classes highlighted on the home screen every morning.
query_text_zh: 做个手机课程表应用，用一个网格显示我的周课表，每天横着排在顶部，时间段竖着排在侧边，这样我能一眼看到所有课程，点进任何课程块检查教室号、老师名字和我添加的任何笔记。我想在学期开始时设置一次就完事了，然后每天早上主屏幕就自动显示今天的课程并highlight出来。

query_text: Build a sports calendar app for my phone that lets me add all the matches and games for my favorite team across a whole season, shows upcoming fixtures in a list with date and opponent, and lets me tap a game to mark whether I watched it and add a quick score or note. I want to be able to scroll through the full season at once and see which games I've already watched and which ones are still coming up.
query_text_zh: 为我的手机做个体育赛事日历应用，我能加入我最喜欢的球队整个赛季的所有比赛和场次，显示进来的比赛列表包括日期和对手，我能点进一场比赛标记我有没有看过，还能加一个快速的比分或笔记。我想要能一次翻看整个赛季，看出我已经看过哪些比赛，哪些还在等着。

query_text: Make a subscription tracker for my phone that keeps a list of all my paid subscriptions with the renewal date for each one, and sends me a reminder a few days before anything is about to renew so I have time to decide if I still want it. The main screen should show all my subscriptions sorted by which renewal is coming up soonest, with the name, price, and days until renewal visible at a glance.
query_text_zh: 做个手机订阅追踪器，保留我所有付费订阅的一个列表，每个都显示它的续费日期，然后在任何东西要续费前几天发提醒给我，这样我有时间决定我还想不想要。主屏幕应该按照哪个续费要来得最近来排序我所有的订阅，并显示名称、价格和还有多少天直到续费，全都一眼能看清。

query_text: Build a mobile app that pulls all the reviews from an app store listing and tells me whether people are happy or frustrated, without me having to read through hundreds of comments myself. I want to see a summary of the overall mood, a breakdown of what people praise versus what they complain about, and a simple score so I can tell at a glance whether sentiment is getting better or worse over time.
query_text_zh: 做个手机应用，能从应用商店的评论列表里抓出所有评价然后告诉我人们是满意还是沮丧，我不用自己读好几百条评论。我想看一个总体情绪总结，一个人们表扬什么和抱怨什么的对比分解，还有一个简单的分数让我能一眼看出情绪是在变好还是变差。

query_text: A tracker for my phone that logs all my home energy and utility usage each month, like electricity, water, and gas, so I can see exactly where the money is going and which bill keeps creeping up. The main screen should show my totals for the current month compared to last month, and tapping any utility should show a simple chart of how it has changed over the past several months.
query_text_zh: 做个手机追踪器，记录我每个月所有的家庭能源和水电使用，比如电、水、气，这样我能清楚地看到钱花在哪里了，哪个账单一直在增长。主屏幕应该显示我本月的总数和上月对比，点进任何水电后要显示一个简单的表格显示最近几个月它怎么变化的。

corpus_topic: Sprint velocity and team completion chart
query_text: Need a mobile app that shows our team how fast we are finishing work each sprint and whether we are getting better or worse over time. I want a simple bar chart that compares how much we planned versus how much we actually completed each sprint, so when someone asks why we keep missing deadlines I can pull out my phone and show them a real picture of what is happening.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用，展示我们团队每个sprint完成工作的速度有多快，还有我们在变好还是变差。我想要一个简单的柱状图，对比每个sprint我们计划了多少和实际完成了多少，这样当某个人问为什么我们总是赶不上deadline，我能掏出手机给他们看一个真实的情况图。

query_text: Need a mobile app that tracks our subscription revenue each month and shows whether it is growing, flat, or dropping. I want to log new subscribers, cancellations, and upgrades, then see the total monthly revenue as a number at the top and a line chart below it so I can spot if a bad month is a one-off or the start of a real trend.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用，追踪我们每个月的订阅收入，显示它在增长、平稳还是下降。我想记录新订户、取消和升级，然后看到顶部的每月总收入数字和下面的一条折线图，这样我能发现一个糟糕的月份是一次性的还是一个真实下降趋势的开始。

corpus_topic: Ad spend and ROAS by channel dashboard
query_text: Make a mobile app that shows me how much we are spending on each advertising channel and what we are getting back for every dollar we put in. I want to enter our weekly spend and revenue for things like search ads, social ads, and video ads, then see a simple comparison so I can stop guessing which channel is actually worth the money and which one is quietly draining the budget.
query_text_zh: 做个手机应用，显示我们在每个广告渠道花了多少钱，还有我们投进去的每一块钱换回了什么。我想输入我们按周对搜索广告、社交广告、视频广告这些的花费和收入，然后看一个简单的对比，这样我就能停止猜测哪个渠道真的值得花钱，哪个在悄悄地把预算抽干。

query_text: Build a mobile app that tracks whether our deliveries are hitting the promised time window or running late, because right now I have no fast way to check compliance and customers call us before I even know there is a problem. Each delivery should have a due time and an actual delivered time, and the app should show me a running percentage of on-time deliveries this week so I can see at a glance whether we are meeting our targets.
query_text_zh: 做个手机应用，追踪我们的delivery是不是在约定的时间窗口内完成或者延迟了，因为现在我没有快速的办法检查合规情况，经常客户在我甚至都不知道有问题之前就打电话来了。每次delivery应该有一个约定时间和实际delivered时间，应用应该显示我本周准时delivery的百分比，这样我能一眼看出我们有没有达成目标。

corpus_topic: Student performance and class average report
query_text: Need a mobile app that keeps a report of each student's scores alongside the class average, so when a parent asks how their child is doing I can pull up a clear picture in seconds instead of digging through spreadsheets. The app should let me enter scores per subject and per student, show each student's trend over the term, and highlight anyone who is falling significantly below the class average.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用，保存每个学生的分数和班级平均分，这样当家长问他们的孩子表现怎么样时我能在几秒钟内拉出一个清晰的画面，而不是去翻电子表格。应用应该让我按科目和学生输入分数，显示每个学生整个学期的趋势，还要highlight任何明显低于班级平均分的学生。

query_text: Build a mobile app that shows me how many people registered for an event versus how many actually showed up, so I can stop manually comparing two separate lists after every event. I want to track each event by name, see the total registrations, confirmed attendees, and actual check-ins in a simple funnel view, and compare attendance rates across multiple events so I know which ones get the best turnout.
query_text_zh: 做个手机应用，显示有多少人注册了活动对比有多少人真的出现了，这样我就不用在每个活动后手动比对两个单独的列表。我想按名称追踪每个活动，看到总注册数、已确认参加者和实际签到数的一个简单funnel view，还能对比多个活动的出席率，这样我能知道哪些活动的出席人数最多。

query_text: Build a mobile app for tracking how often products fail quality checks each week, because right now I jot numbers on paper and never actually go back to see if the defect rate is going up or down. I want to log the number of items inspected and how many failed each day, then see a chart on my phone that shows whether the defect rate is trending in the right direction over the past few weeks.
query_text_zh: 做个手机应用追踪产品每周有多少次质检不及格，因为现在我在纸上乱涂数字然后从不回头看缺陷率是不是在上升或下降。我想记录每天检查的件数和多少件失败，然后在手机上看一个表格，显示缺陷率在最近几周是不是朝着对的方向变化。

query_text: A mobile app that shows me which content categories are performing well and which ones are quietly underperforming, so I can stop spending time on topics that nobody engages with. The home screen should list each category with its key numbers like views and shares, and tapping a category should show a simple chart of how it has performed week by week so I can spot patterns.
query_text_zh: 做个手机应用，显示我哪些内容类别表现好、哪些在悄悄underperforming，这样我就能停止把时间花在没有人engagement的话题上。主屏幕应该列出每个类别和它的关键数字比如浏览量和分享量，点进一个类别应该显示它按周表现的简单图表，这样我能发现规律。

query_text: Need a note-taking app for my phone that feels clean and beautiful, where I can drop images or attach files directly into a note so everything stays in one place instead of scattered across my camera roll and email. The note editor should feel light and airy, with photos displaying as nice previews right inside the note and attached files showing as a tidy little row so the whole thing looks polished when I scroll back through it.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机笔记应用，看起来干净漂亮，我能直接把图片或附加文件放进笔记里，这样所有东西都能待在一个地方，而不是散落在我的相机相册和邮件里。笔记编辑器应该看起来轻盈通透，照片应该在笔记里显示成漂亮的预览，附加文件显示成一整齐的小行列，这样当我往回翻看时整个东西看起来很精致。

corpus_topic: Export to PDF, DOCX or Markdown
query_text: Build a writing app for my phone that has a warm, minimal feel, where I can take any note or document I have written and send it out as a PDF, a Word file, or a plain Markdown file depending on who I am sharing it with. The export options should be easy to reach after writing, and the resulting files should look clean and well-formatted so I am not embarrassed to send them to someone.
query_text_zh: 做个手机写作应用，有温暖的极简感觉，我能把我写的任何笔记或文档导出成PDF、Word文件或纯Markdown文件，取决于我要和谁分享。导出选项在写完之后应该很容易找到，导出的文件应该看起来干净格式良好，这样我就不会不好意思发给别人。

query_text: Create a note-taking app for mobile that has a satisfying, interconnected feel, where I can mention another note inside any note I am writing and the two notes remember they are linked to each other. I want to tap a link inside a note and jump straight to the connected note, and I also want each note to show a small section at the bottom listing every other note that links back to it, so I can see how my ideas are related.
query_text_zh: 为手机做一个笔记应用，有满足感很强的相互连接的感觉，我能在我写的任何笔记里提及另一个笔记，然后这两个笔记会互相记得它们之间有链接。我想点进笔记里的一个链接直接跳到连接的笔记，我也想每个笔记的底部显示一个小块地方列出所有其他链接到它的笔记，这样我能看出我的想法是怎么联系起来的。

corpus_topic: Tag-based note organisation with cloud sync
query_text: Need a notes app for my phone that lets me label every note with one or more topics so I can find related notes just by tapping a label, and everything should stay in sync across my devices so my notes on my phone match what I see anywhere else. The labeling system should feel visual and satisfying, like little colored flags on each note, and the app should have a clean, uncluttered look that makes browsing feel pleasant.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机笔记应用，让我能给每个笔记标上一个或多个话题标签，这样我就能通过点击一个标签找到相关笔记，而且所有东西应该在我的设备间自动同步，这样我手机上的笔记和我其他地方看到的一样。标签系统应该看起来视觉上令人满足，比如每个笔记上的彩色小旗子，应用应该有干净整洁的外观，这样浏览的感觉很愉快。

corpus_topic: Focus writing mode with word-count goal
query_text: Create a writing app for my phone that strips away every distraction and gives me a calm, full-screen space to write, with a word count goal I can set at the start of each session so I know how far I have to go. I want the goal to feel motivating rather than stressful, maybe a subtle progress indicator that fills up as I write, and the whole experience should feel serene and focused so getting words down actually feels enjoyable.
query_text_zh: 为手机做个写作应用，去掉所有分心的东西，给我一个冷静的全屏写作空间，我能在每个session开始时设置一个字数目标，这样我知道要写多远。我想目标感觉激励人而不是有压力，可能是一个微妙的进度指示器随我写而填满，整个体验应该感觉平和专注，这样把字写出来其实感觉很愉快。

corpus_topic: Version history with restore and diff
query_text: Need a notes app for mobile that saves a history of every edit I make to a note, so I can go back and look at an earlier version of something I was working on and bring back the wording I had before. I want to see a timeline of when changes were made, tap any point in the history to preview what the note looked like then, and restore it with one tap if that version was better than what I have now.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机笔记应用，保存我对一个笔记做的每一次编辑的历史记录，这样我可以回头看看我在做什么时的较早版本，并把我之前有的措辞改回来。我想看一个什么时候做了改变的时间线，点进历史上的任何一点来预览那时笔记看起来是什么样，如果那个版本比我现在有的好就用一个按钮恢复。

corpus_topic: Public share link with edit or view permission
query_text: Make a notes app for mobile that lets me share any note by generating a link I can send to someone, and I want to choose whether that person can just read it or actually make edits to it. The shared note should look beautiful when someone opens it on their phone, like a nicely laid-out page rather than a raw text dump, and I should be able to turn the link off whenever I want to stop sharing.
query_text_zh: 做个手机笔记应用，让我能通过生成一个链接分享任何笔记给别人，我想选择那个人只能读还是能真的编辑。被分享的笔记在别人在手机上打开时应该看起来很漂亮，就像一个排版整齐的页面而不是原始文本转储，我应该能随时关掉这个链接来停止分享。

query_text: Need a private notes app for my phone that lets me lock any note behind a password so certain things stay truly personal and I feel safe writing whatever I want. The locked notes should look indistinguishable from regular notes in the list, and when I tap one it should ask for my password before showing anything, so if someone picks up my phone they have no idea there is private content there.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机私密笔记应用，让我能把任何笔记锁在密码后面，这样某些东西就能真的保持私人，我能感到安心地写任何我想写的。被锁定的笔记在列表中应该看起来和普通笔记没区别，我点进一个时应该在显示任何东西前问我的密码，这样如果有人拿起我的手机他们根本不知道里面有私密内容。

query_text: Need a notes app for my phone where I can attach a reminder or a deadline to any note, so important things I have written down actually surface again at the right moment instead of getting buried. The reminder should feel like a gentle nudge tied to that specific note, and when it goes off I want to be taken straight to the note so I can act on it right away without hunting for it.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机笔记应用，让我能给任何笔记附加一个提醒或截止日期，这样我记下的重要东西能在对的时刻再冒出来，而不是被buried。提醒应该感觉像一个tied到那个特定笔记的温柔推送，当它触发时我想直接被带到那个笔记，这样我能立刻采取行动而不用费劲去找它。

query_text: An app for my phone designed for writing step-by-step process guides, where each procedure is laid out as a numbered list I can build up one step at a time and edit whenever the process changes. The steps should be easy to reorder by dragging them around, and when someone follows the guide they should be able to tap through each step and mark it done so nothing gets skipped.
query_text_zh: 做个为手机设计的应用，用来写一步一步的流程指南，每个流程都排成一个编号列表我能一步步建起来，流程变化时随时编辑。步骤应该很容易通过拖曳来重新排序，当有人按照指南操作时应该能点进每一步并标记完成，这样什么都不会被跳过。

corpus_l2_key: ① 饮水/服药/习惯提醒
query_text: Build a mobile reading habit app that nudges me to read at least 10 pages every day, because I keep meaning to read more but the evening comes and I have forgotten entirely. I want to log how many pages I read each day with a quick tap, see a streak of how many days in a row I have hit my goal, and get a friendly reminder at a time I choose if I have not logged anything yet.
query_text_zh: 做个手机阅读习惯应用，每天督促我至少读10页，因为我一直想多读但晚上来了我就全忘了。我想用一个快速点按每天记录我读了多少页，看到我有多少天连续达成目标的连续记录，如果我到了选择的时间还没记录任何东西的话能收到一个友好的提醒。

corpus_l2_key: ① 饮水/服药/习惯提醒
query_text: Need a journaling app for my phone that sends me a gratitude prompt every day at a set time so I actually sit down and write something, because I always say I want to journal but I never start. I want a new question each day to answer, a place to type a few sentences, and a way to scroll back through my past entries on good days when I need a reminder of what is going well.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机日记应用，每天在一个设定时间发感谢提示给我，这样我实际上能坐下来写一些东西，因为我总是说我想写日记但我从不开始。我想每天一个新问题来回答，一个地方来打几句话，还有一个办法在好的日子往回翻看我过去的日记条目，当我需要一个提醒什么事进展顺利时。

corpus_topic: Breathing exercise habit at stress-trigger moments
corpus_l2_key: ① 饮水/服药/习惯提醒
query_text: Create a breathing exercise app for my phone that reminds me to pause and breathe whenever I am likely to feel stressed, like before a big meeting or late in the afternoon when my energy crashes. I want to be able to set a few specific times or triggers for reminders, tap into a guided breathing exercise with a simple visual that expands and contracts to pace my breathing, and log each completed session so I can see how consistent I am being.
query_text_zh: 为手机做个呼吸练习应用，当我可能要感到压力时提醒我要停下来呼吸，比如在一个大会议前或下午晚些时候我能量崩溃时。我想能设置几个具体的时间或triggers来提醒，点进一个有简单视觉效果的guided呼吸练习，这个视觉会展开和收缩来给我的呼吸设置节奏，还要记录每个完成的session这样我能看我坚持的有多一致。

corpus_l2_key: ① 饮水/服药/习惯提醒
query_text: Build a mobile reminder app that helps me wind down from screens in the evening by sending a gentle alert at a time I set, because I keep scrolling on my phone way longer than I intend to and then sleep badly. I want the reminder to show a calming message I can customize, a checklist of small offline activities I like to do before bed, and a log so I can see how many nights I actually followed through.
query_text_zh: 做个手机提醒应用，帮我晚上从屏幕上缓过来，在我设置的时间发一个温柔的警告，因为我经常在手机上scroll的时间比我打算的长得多然后睡眠就糟了。我想提醒要显示一个我可以customize的平静信息，一个清单是睡前我喜欢做的小offline活动，还有一个log这样我能看有多少晚我实际上follow through了。

corpus_topic: Caffeine intake tracker with afternoon cut-off alert
corpus_l2_key: ① 饮水/服药/习惯提醒
query_text: Need a mobile caffeine tracker that lets me log each coffee, tea, or energy drink throughout the day and warns me when I am getting close to my personal limit or when it is past the time I should stop drinking caffeine. I want to enter what I had and roughly when, see a running total for the day, and get an alert in the early afternoon reminding me that anything after this point will probably mess with my sleep.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机咖啡因追踪器，让我能记录我整天喝的每一杯咖啡、茶或能量饮料，并在我接近我的个人极限或过了我应该停止喝咖啡因的时间时警告我。我想输入我喝的什么以及大概什么时候喝的，看到本日的running total，还要在下午早些时候收到一个提醒，提醒我这之后的任何东西都可能搞砸我的睡眠。

corpus_l2_key: ① 饮水/服药/习惯提醒
query_text: An alcohol-free day tracker screen on my phone where I can see my current no-drink streak right at the top, plus a simple row of circles for each day this month that fills in when I mark a good day. I want to see my longest streak so far and my total dry days this year, and there should be a quick tap button to log today as alcohol-free without having to dig through anything.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机应用，用来追踪不喝酒的日子，最上面能清楚地显示我当前的戒酒连续天数，下面有一排圆圈代表这个月的每一天，当我标记这一天没有喝酒时就会填满。我还想看到目前为止最长的连续记录和今年总共的禁酒天数，最好有一个快速按钮，不用深入菜单就能记录今天已戒酒。

corpus_l2_key: ① 饮水/服药/习惯提醒
query_text: Need a cold shower habit streak tracker for my phone that shows how many days in a row I have completed a cold shower, with a big clear number at the top so I can see my streak right away. I want to be able to tap once to mark today as done, see a row of past days in a simple checklist style, and get a small reminder if I forget to log before bedtime.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机冷水浴习惯追踪器，显示我连续完成冷水浴的天数，最上面用一个大大的清晰数字让我一眼就能看到今天的连续记录。我想只需点一下就能标记今天完成了，看到过去的日子排成简单的清单式样，还有一个小提醒，万一我在睡前忘记记录会提醒我。

corpus_l2_key: ① 饮水/服药/习惯提醒
query_text: Make a 10,000 steps daily walking nudge screen for my phone that lists today's step count clearly at the top, shows how many steps I still need to hit the goal, and gives me a gentle push notification reminder in the afternoon if I am running behind. I also want a simple week view that shows which days I hit the target and which I missed, all on one screen without having to tap around.
query_text_zh: 帮我制作一个每日一万步走路督促屏幕，最上面清楚地显示今天的步数，下面显示还需要多少步才能达到目标，如果下午时间过半还没有达到目标就给我一个温和的推送提醒。我还想要一个简单的周视图，显示哪些天达到了目标、哪些天没有，所有内容都在一个屏幕上，不用到处点击。

corpus_topic: Social connection habit (call a friend) reminder
corpus_l2_key: ① 饮水/服药/习惯提醒
query_text: Create a social connection habit reminder for my phone that helps me remember to call or check in with a friend or family member every few days. I want a simple checklist of the people I care about staying in touch with, a way to mark when I last reached out to each one, and a daily nudge so the habit stays on track. The streak counter should show how many days in a row I kept up the calling habit.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个社交习惯提醒应用，提醒我每隔几天就要给朋友或家人打电话或问候他们。我想要一个简单的清单列出我想保持联系的人，可以记录我最后联系每个人的时间，还有每天的督促提醒，这样习惯就不会掉链子。连续记录应该显示我有多少天都坚持了打电话的习惯。

corpus_topic: Journaling habit streak with guard option
corpus_l2_key: ① 饮水/服药/习惯提醒
query_text: Create a journaling habit streak tracker for my phone where I can see how many days in a row I have written something, with an option to protect my streak once in a while if I miss a day unexpectedly. I want a clean list view showing this week and last week, a one-tap button to mark today as journaled, and a count of my total entries this month so I can see my consistency at a glance.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个日记习惯追踪器，显示我连续写日记有多少天，如果突然有一天没写也可以选择保留连续记录。我想看到本周和上周的清晰列表视图，有一个只需轻点一下的按钮来标记今天已写日记，还能看到这个月的总条目数，这样我就能一眼看出自己的一致性。

corpus_l2_key: ② 运动记录/健身计划
query_text: Build a 5K to marathon running plan builder for my phone that lays out each week of training in a simple list, showing what type of run I should do each day, how far, and at what effort level in plain words like easy or hard. I want to tap on any day to see the details for that session and mark it as done when I finish. The plan should adjust the upcoming weeks if I fall behind or skip a run.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个从5公里到马拉松的跑步计划制造器，把每周的训练以简单列表形式列出来，显示每天应该进行什么类型的跑步、距离多远以及用用词简单的强度描述比如简单或困难。我想点击任意一天都能看到那次训练的详细信息并标记完成，如果我落后或跳过某次跑步，计划应该调整接下来的几周。

corpus_l2_key: ② 运动记录/健身计划
query_text: Personal best milestone screen on my phone where all my running and workout records are listed in one place, sorted by type of activity, so I can quickly find my fastest 5K time or my heaviest lift. Each record should show the date I set it and how much I improved from the one before. When I beat a record it should feel like a small celebration on screen, not just a silent number update.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机个人最佳成绩里程碑屏幕，所有跑步和健身的记录都集中在一个地方，按运动类型排序，这样我能快速找到我最快的5公里成绩或最重的举重记录。每条记录都应该显示我创造它的日期以及相比之前的进步有多大。当我打破一个记录时应该在屏幕上有小庆祝感，而不只是默默地更新一个数字。

corpus_l2_key: ② 运动记录/健身计划
query_text: Create a workout buddy challenge leaderboard for my phone where I can see how my weekly activity compares to a few friends I have added. The list should show each person's name, their total workouts or active minutes this week, and a simple rank order. I want to be able to challenge a specific friend to match my step count or workout days for the week with a quick send button right on that same screen.
query_text_zh: 帮我创建一个健身伙伴挑战排行榜，让我能看到我这周的运动量和添加的几个朋友的对比。列表应该显示每个人的名字、他们这周的总锻炼次数或活跃分钟数以及排名顺序。我想能够直接向某个朋友发出挑战，比较这周的步数或锻炼天数，屏幕上就有一个快速发送按钮。

corpus_topic: Heart rate zone workout intensity guide
corpus_l2_key: ② 运动记录/健身计划
query_text: Build a heart rate zone workout intensity guide for my phone that explains each zone in plain everyday language, like easy pace, moderate effort, or really pushing hard, and shows which zone I should be in for different types of workouts. I want to enter my age to get my personal zone ranges and then see a list of suggested exercises for each level so I know exactly what kind of effort to aim for during my session.
query_text_zh: 帮我制作一个心率区域训练强度指南，用日常简单的语言解释每个区域，比如轻松节奏、中等强度或真正的全力以赴，显示不同类型训练应该在哪个区域。我想输入我的年龄来获得个人的区域范围，然后看到每个强度级别的建议练习列表，这样我就能清楚知道训练时应该努力什么强度。

corpus_l2_key: ② 运动记录/健身计划
query_text: Create a post-workout nutrition prompt for my phone that pops up after I log a workout and gives me a short checklist of things to eat or drink in the next hour. I want it to list a few simple options like protein, carbs, and water with checkboxes I can tap off as I go. The screen should also show how long ago I finished my workout so I know if I am still in the good window for refueling.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个训练后营养提示，在我记录完一次健身后弹出来，给我一个短清单，列出未来一小时内应该吃或喝什么。我想看到几个简单的选项比如蛋白质、碳水和水，每个都有复选框我可以逐个点击标记。屏幕还应该显示我完成训练已经过了多久，这样我就能知道自己是否还在最佳补充能量的时间窗口内。

corpus_l2_key: ② 运动记录/健身计划
query_text: Create a mobility and stretching routine guide for my phone that lists each stretch or movement in order with a brief plain-language description of what body part it helps and how long to hold it. I want to be able to tap through the routine one step at a time with a simple timer for each move, and at the end see a summary of how many minutes I spent and which areas I covered that day.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个活动能力和拉伸常规指南，按顺序列出每个伸展或动作，用简单的日常语言描述它帮助哪个身体部位以及要保持多久。我想按部就班地轻点进行这个常规，每个动作都有简单的计时器，最后看到一个总结，显示我花了多少分钟以及当天覆盖了哪些区域。

corpus_topic: Group fitness class schedule and booking
corpus_l2_key: ② 运动记录/健身计划
query_text: Make a group fitness class schedule and booking screen for my phone that lists upcoming classes in a clear day-by-day layout with the class name, time, location, and how many spots are still open. I want to tap any class to see a short description and then tap again to book my spot or add it to my personal list of upcoming sessions. query_text_zh: 我需要一个咒语冥想计时器，让我设置我想要多少次重复或多少分钟，然后在我无声地重复我的咒语时创建一个温和、专注的氛围。我想它感觉神圣和不匆忙，有一个柔和的视觉标记每个周期，结束时发出一个安静、令人愉快的声音，这样我就知道训练结束了而不会被惊吓。整体气氛应该感觉尊敬和静止，而不是像一个通用的倒计时计时器。

query_text: Make a grounding exercise for my phone based on the 5-4-3-2-1 technique that feels safe and gentle, guiding me through noticing things I can see, hear, touch, smell, and taste one step at a time. The visual should feel soft and reassuring, like a warm hand on the shoulder rather than a bright clinical interface, with calming colors and unhurried transitions between each sense. I want it to feel like a safe little refuge I can open any time I feel overwhelmed.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个基于5-4-3-2-1技术的接地运动，感觉安全和温和，引导我通过一次注意到我能看到、听到、接触、嗅到和尝到的东西的一步一步的过程。视觉应该感觉柔和和放心，像肩膀上的温暖的手而不是明亮的临床界面，有平静的颜色和不匆忙的过渡在每个感官之间。我想它感觉像一个安全的小避难所，我可以在任何我感到不知所措时打开。

query_text: Build an open awareness meditation app for my phone that gently guides me into a spacious, present state of mind without locking me into a rigid structure, so I can just sit and notice what arises. The feel should be airy and minimal, like looking out at a wide open sky, with very soft background sound and a visual that suggests openness rather than enclosure. I want it to feel like an invitation to rest in stillness rather than another thing to achieve.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个开放意识冥想应用，温和地引导我进入一个宽敞的、当下的心理状态，而不是锁定我在一个严格的结构中，这样我就可以只是坐着注意到出现的东西。感觉应该是通风和最小的，就像朝向一个宽敞的天空看去，有非常柔和的背景声和一个视觉暗示开放而不是包围。我想它感觉像一个邀请去休息在平静而不是另一件要达成的东西。

query_text: Need a work stress decompression break routine for my phone that I can do in five to ten minutes at my desk, with guided steps that feel genuinely relaxing rather than performative. I want the visual to feel calm and slightly warm, like stepping away from a screen into softer light, and the prompts to lead me through breathing, releasing tension, and resetting mentally before I go back to work. It should feel like a real break, not just a productivity trick.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个工作压力减轻中断常规，我可以在我的办公桌上五到十分钟内完成，有引导的步骤感觉真正放松而不是表演性的。我想视觉感觉平静和稍微温暖，像离开屏幕进入更柔和的光线，提示引导我通过呼吸、释放紧张和精神上重置，在我回到工作之前。它应该感觉像一个真实的中断，而不只是生产力的把戏。

query_text: Build a calm-down breathing game for kids on a phone that makes deep breathing feel playful and satisfying, with friendly animations that respond to the rhythm of the exercise so a child naturally wants to breathe slowly to see what happens. The look should be bright and inviting but not overstimulating, with soft cheerful characters or shapes that grow and shrink with each breath. I want it to feel like a fun little world a child can visit whenever they feel wound up.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个儿童冷静呼吸游戏，让深呼吸感觉快乐和令人满意，有友好的动画随着运动的节奏响应，这样一个孩子自然想慢慢呼吸来看看会发生什么。外观应该是明亮和吸引人的但不是过度刺激，有柔和的愉快角色或形状随着每个呼吸长大和缩小。我想它感觉像一个有趣的小世界，一个孩子可以在任何他们感到紧张时访问。

query_text: Make a couples synchronized breathing exercise for two people to do together on a phone, where both people can follow the same gentle rhythm and feel like they are sharing a calm, connected moment. The visual should feel warm and intimate, maybe with two soft shapes that pulse together in sync, and the overall mood should be tender rather than sporty. I want it to feel like a quiet ritual a couple can build into their day to feel more in tune with each other.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个情侣同步呼吸运动，两个人可以在手机上一起做，两个人都可以跟随同样的温和节奏，感觉他们在分享一个平静的、联系的时刻。视觉应该感觉温暖和亲密，也许有两个柔和的形状一起同步脉动，整体气氛应该感觉温柔而不是运动的。我想它感觉像一个安静的仪式，一对夫妇可以建立到他们的日子里，感觉更相互协调。

corpus_topic: Visa requirement checker by passport nationality
query_text: A visa requirement checker for my phone where I pick my passport nationality and the country I want to visit, and it immediately shows me whether I need a visa, can get one on arrival, or can enter visa-free, along with how long I am allowed to stay. I want the information to be laid out clearly with the most important details front and center, and I want to be able to check several destinations quickly one after another. Clean and easy to scan while planning a trip.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个签证要求检查器，我选择我的护照国籍和我想要访问的国家，它立即显示我是否需要签证、可以在抵达时获得一个，还是可以免签证进入，以及我被允许停留多久。我想信息以清晰的布局呈现，最重要的细节在前面和中心，我想能够快速连续检查几个目的地。整洁和易于在计划旅行时扫描。

query_text: Make a travel insurance comparison tool for my phone that lets me look at several plans side by side so I can see the key differences clearly without reading walls of fine print. Being able to filter by coverage type or price range would help me narrow down the options quickly.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个旅行保险比较工具，让我能够并排查看几个计划，这样我就能清楚地看到关键的差异而不用读一堵细字。我想看医疗覆盖限额、旅行取消覆盖、冒险活动是否包括和价格之类的东西，全部排成一种方式使得选择变得容易。能够按覆盖类型或价格范围过滤会帮助我快速缩小选项范围。

query_text: Make a currency exchange rate card for my phone that shows the current exchange rate between my home currency and the currency of wherever I am traveling, along with a quick converter so I can type in an amount and instantly see what it equals in the other currency. I want the layout to be clean and easy to read at a glance, with the rate and the converter both visible without any extra tapping. Useful to have open while shopping or paying for things abroad.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个货币兑换率卡，显示我的主币和我旅行地点的货币之间的当前兑换率，加上一个快速转换器，这样我就能输入一个金额并立即看到它在另一种货币中等于什么。我想布局清洁和易于一眼阅读，汇率和转换器都可见而无需额外的点击。在国外购物或付款时很有用。

corpus_topic: Auto-generated packing list from weather and duration
query_text: A packing list maker for my phone where I enter my destination, the weather I expect, and how many days I am going, and it gives me a sensible list of things to pack based on that information. I want the list organized into categories like clothing, toiletries, documents, and gadgets so it is easy to work through, and I want to be able to check things off as I pack them. Being able to add my own items to any category would make it even more useful.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个打包清单制造器，我输入我的目的地、我期望的天气和我要去多少天，它根据这个信息给我一个合理的打包物品清单。我想列表组织成衣服、洗漱用品、文件和小工具这样的类别，这样就很容易进行，我想能够在我打包它们时勾选东西。能够向任何类别添加我自己的东西会让它更有用。

corpus_topic: Emergency contact and embassy info card
query_text: Make an emergency info card for my phone that I can fill in before a trip with the local emergency number, the nearest embassy or consulate address and phone number, my travel insurance hotline, and one or two personal emergency contacts. I want everything on one screen that is easy to read quickly in a stressful moment, with the most critical numbers at the top. Being able to save it for offline access so I can open it without a signal would be really important.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个紧急信息卡，在旅行前我能填写当地的紧急号码、最近的大使馆或领事馆地址和电话号码、我的旅行保险热线和一两个个人紧急联系人。我想所有内容都在一个屏幕上，在紧急时刻易于快速阅读，最关键的号码在最上面。能够保存它用于离线访问，这样我就可以在没有信号的情况下打开它会非常重要。

query_text: Create a trip planner tool on my phone that lets me filter places to visit by whether they are good for families with kids, so I can quickly pick things like playgrounds, kid-friendly museums, and calm parks while avoiding spots that are too crowded or not suitable for little ones. I want to be able to tap a few options and see only the matching places listed clearly.
query_text_zh: 在手机上做一个旅行规划工具，可以按照是否适合带小孩的家庭来筛选景点，这样我就能快速找到游乐园、儿童友好的博物馆和安静的公园，同时避免太拥挤或不适合小孩的地方。我想只要轻点几个选项就能看到符合条件的景点列表。

query_text: Build a travel route planner app for my phone that works well for people who have trouble walking long distances or use a wheelchair, so I can plan a route that avoids stairs, steep hills, and narrow paths. I want it to show me step-by-step directions that only use flat walkways and accessible entrances, and let me tap through each part of the route one screen at a time.
query_text_zh: 在手机上做一个旅行路线规划应用，专门为那些走不了长距离或者用轮椅的人设计，这样我就能规划一条避开楼梯、陡坡和狭窄小路的路线。我想看到一步步的导航指示，只用平坦的走道和无障碍入口，还能一屏一屏地轻点浏览路线的每个部分。

query_text: Make a travel planner tool on my phone that highlights the more eco-friendly ways to get around and stay at a destination, like trains instead of flights, or hotels that use less plastic and waste, so I can see right away which options are better for the environment and pick those first when I am putting my trip together.
query_text_zh: 在手机上做一个旅行规划工具，突出显示更环保的出行方式和住宿选择，比如坐火车而不是飞机，或者选择少用塑料和产生较少垃圾的酒店，这样我就能马上看到哪些选项对环境更友好，在安排行程时优先选择这些。

query_text: Build a trip planning tool on my phone that shows me all the festivals, local events, and public holidays happening at the destination on the dates I plan to visit, so I can see at a glance what is going on each day and plan around things like road closures, crowded markets, or special shows I might want to catch while I am there.
query_text_zh: 在手机上做一个旅行规划工具，显示目的地在我计划访问的日期里会有哪些节日、当地活动和公众假期，这样我一眼就能看到每天有什么活动，可以提前规避道路关闭、拥挤的市场，或者我可能想参加的特殊演出。

query_text_zh: 在手机上做一个导航工具，在我开电动车时显示路线上所有的充电站，因为我总是担心电池会在找到充电站前就没电了。我想在地图上看到这些充电站，知道哪些现在有空，轻点就能加一个停靠点，不用离开应用或在其他地方查询。

query_text_zh: 在手机上做一个停车位查找工具，显示我要去的地方附近的空停车位，这样我就不用一到达就在街区转圈浪费时间。我想在一个屏幕上看到周围有什么选择、是否要付费，还有我到目的地要走多远，这样我甚至在开进这个区域前就能快速查看。

corpus_topic: Safety score for walking area at night
query_text: A walking safety tool on my phone that tells me how safe it is to walk through a certain area at night before I actually go there, because sometimes I just do not know a neighborhood and I would rather check first. query_text_zh: 在手机上做一个行走安全工具，告诉我晚上在某个区域行走有多安全，在我真正去那里之前，因为有时我对一个社区不熟悉，我宁愿先查查。我想输入一条街或一个区域，就能得到一个简单的安全评分或等级，以及一个快速的解释说明要注意什么，这样我就能决定是否去或找其他路线。

query_text_zh: 在我的手机上开发一个拼写蜜蜂游戏，难度随着你的进行而真正提升，从容易的短词开始，进入更复杂的长词，每个级别与最后一个感觉清晰不同。我想让它读出单词，所以你必须输入它，当你错误时它就在那里显示正确的拼写。有一个小分数或连胜会很有趣，这样你可以看到你走了多远。

corpus_l2_key: ① 文字猜谜/知识竞赛

Something I can play in short bursts when I have a minute to spare.

corpus_l2_key: ① 文字猜谜/知识竞赛

corpus_topic: Book genre roulette for next read

corpus_l2_key: ② 抽签/转盘/随机决策

corpus_l2_key: ② 抽签/转盘/随机决策

I want it to have a few different vibes you can filter by, like stay-in versus go-out, so the suggestions actually match your mood that evening. Simple and fun to use.

corpus_topic: Workout move of the day picker

Good for adding a tiny bit of movement into a normal day.
query_text_zh: 为手机建立一个应用，每天为你选择一个随机的锻炼动作或运动，这样你总是有什么快速的东西可以做而不用考虑，比如十个深蹲或一分钟的木板或一些跳跃起来。我想让它显示如何做动作的简短说明或小动画，这样你就知道你在做什么，也许让你点击来交换它，如果你真的不能做那个。很好在一个正常的一天里添加一小点运动。

query_text: Need a solitaire card game on my phone where you stack and move cards around to get them sorted by suit from ace to king, the classic kind where you are playing alone and just working through the deck. query_text: Create a mahjong tile matching game for my phone where you tap pairs of matching tiles to clear them off the board, working through the whole stack until the board is empty. query_text: Create a nonogram puzzle game for my phone where you fill in squares on a grid based on the number clues along the rows and columns to reveal a hidden picture. query_text_zh: 为我的手机创建一个非式拼图游戏，你根据行和列沿着数字线索填充网格上的正方形来揭示隐藏的图片。我想让它有不同大小的谜题，这样你可以做一个快速的小的或根据你有多少时间承诺一个更大的。网格应该在手机屏幕上感觉容易点击和标记，有办法标记你知道是空的正方形在解决狡猾的人时会很有帮助。

query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的钉棋游戏，你跳过彼此的钉子来一个一个地移除它们，尽力在最后只剩下一个钉子。我想让钉子和孔足够大，可以舒适地点击而不会意外击中错误的地方，有一个撤销按钮会很有帮助，这样当你意识到你在几个步骤前犯了一个坏举动时，你可以备份。简单满足在短时间内玩，当我有几分钟时。
