query_text_zh: 为手机创建一个应用，你可以放下一张照片，然后在顶部分层文本和贴纸，在周围移动它们，调整它们的大小，为文本选择不同的字体和颜色，这样你就能让它看起来完全像你想要的。我想贴纸包括一些有趣的日常的，像星星、心形、小图标，文本应该容易输入和调整，没有繁琐的菜单。一个简单的编辑器，你想要打扮一张照片来与朋友分享。

corpus_l2_key: ① 图片编辑/滤镜/裁剪
query_text: Build a photo annotation app for my phone where I can draw freehand lines and shapes directly on top of any picture, choose from a few brush sizes and colors that feel warm and editorial rather than clinical, and add short text labels that sit cleanly over the image without covering the whole composition, so the finished piece looks like a thoughtfully marked-up mood board I could share with friends.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机照片标注应用，可以在任何图片上随意涂画线条和形状，提供几种笔刷大小和温暖文艺的颜色选择（不是冰冷的那种），还能添加简短的文字标签，这些标签要整洁地放在图片上，不会遮挡整个画面，这样最后的效果看起来就像一个经过精心标注的灵感板，可以跟朋友分享。

corpus_topic: EXIF data viewer and GPS strip tool
corpus_l2_key: ① 图片编辑/滤镜/裁剪
query_text: A mobile tool that reads all the hidden info baked into a photo, like the camera settings, date, and GPS location, lays it out in a clean, readable way so it actually feels like a little story about where and how the shot was taken, and gives me a one-tap option to wipe the location data before I share the image anywhere online, keeping the aesthetic of the photo intact while protecting my privacy.
query_text_zh: 想要一个手机工具，能读取照片里隐藏的信息，比如相机设置、拍摄日期和GPS位置，把这些信息用整洁易读的方式呈现出来，感觉就像在讲述这张照片在哪里、怎样被拍下来的小故事，还要有一键删除位置数据的选项，分享图片前保护隐私，而且不影响照片的美感。

corpus_l2_key: ② 海报/简历/卡片模板
query_text: Create a mobile app that feels like a proper little print shop for restaurants, where I can build a beautiful menu card or promotional flyer by picking a layout that has real character, typing in the dish names and prices, and getting something that looks hand-crafted and specific to the place rather than generic, with the option to share it straight from my phone as an image people would actually want to look at.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机应用，就像一个真正的小型印刷厂，专门给餐厅设计菜单或宣传单张，我能选择有特色的布局，输入菜名和价格，最后做出来的东西看起来是手工定制的，有这家餐厅特有的感觉，不是那种通用的模板，还能直接从手机分享成图片，让人真的想看。

corpus_l2_key: ② 海报/简历/卡片模板
query_text: Make a mobile app that lets me design a social media profile header that actually feels like it belongs to me, where I can pick a background mood, drop in my name and a short tagline, choose a type style that has some personality, and preview exactly how it will look on my phone so there are no surprises when I upload it, something that feels personal and considered rather than thrown together.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个手机应用，设计社交媒体的头部横幅，要感觉真的属于我，能选择背景的氛围，放上我的名字和一句简短的标语，挑一种有个性的字体，还能在手机上看到最终效果预览，这样上传的时候就不会有意外，整个感觉要个性化和经过深思熟虑，不是仓促拼凑的。

corpus_topic: Motivational quote poster with font choice
corpus_l2_key: ② 海报/简历/卡片模板
query_text: Create a mobile poster-maker app that is just for motivational quotes, where the whole point is choosing the right font because the typeface is what gives the words their feeling, so I can type in a quote, scroll through a curated handful of font options that each carry a different mood, pick a background color or texture that fits, and save a clean image to share from my phone without it looking like every other quote graphic out there.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机海报制作应用，专门用来制作励志语录的，重点就是字体选择，因为字体本身就能给词语赋予感觉，我输入一句名言，然后能翻看精心挑选的几种字体选项，每种都有不同的气质，选择适合的背景色或纹理，最后保存成清爽的图片分享，看起来不像其他千篇一律的语录图。

corpus_l2_key: ② 海报/简历/卡片模板
query_text: Build a mobile banner-maker app specifically for sale and discount announcements, where the energy of the design actually matches the excitement of the deal, so I can type in the offer details, choose a bold color scheme that pops, pick a layout that puts the discount front and center, and export a sharp image I can post on my phone in seconds, something that feels genuine and confident rather than noisy and cheap.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机横幅制作应用，专门用来做促销和折扣公告，设计的能量要配上优惠的兴奋感，我输入优惠详情，选择一个很显眼的配色方案，选择一个把折扣放在最显眼位置的布局，然后导出一张清晰的图片，几秒钟就能在手机上发布，感觉要真诚和有自信，不是吵闹和廉价的。

corpus_l2_key: ② 海报/简历/卡片模板
query_text: Build a mobile app that is a job posting flyer maker, because every hiring notice I see looks the same and I want something that carries the actual personality of the place doing the hiring, so I can fill in the role, the pay, and the contact info, pick a layout and color palette that feels right for the kind of job it is, and download a clean flyer image ready to share straight from my phone.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机应用，专门用来做招聘海报，因为我看到的招聘启事看起来都一样，我想要一些能展现招聘公司真实个性的设计，我能填上岗位、薪资和联系方式，选择适合这个职位类型的布局和颜色，最后下载一张整洁的海报，可以直接从手机分享出去。

corpus_l2_key: ② 海报/简历/卡片模板
query_text: A presentation slide template gallery app for my phone where the templates are organized by the feeling they give off, like calm and minimal versus bold and energetic, so I can browse them one at a time, tap to preview a full sample slide with placeholder text, pick the one that matches the vibe of what I am working on, and then export or share it as a starting point, something that feels like it was curated by someone with taste.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机应用，里面是演讲幻灯片模板库，模板按照给人的感觉来分类，比如宁静极简风格还是大胆充满活力，我能逐个浏览这些模板，点击看完整的样品幻灯片和占位符文本，选择和自己项目气质相配的那个，然后导出或分享作为起点，整个感觉要像是被一个有品味的人精心挑选的。

corpus_topic: Video player with playback speed control
query_text: Make a mobile video player app where the playback speed control is the star of the experience, with a smooth slider that lets me nudge the speed up or down in small steps and actually feel the change rather than jumping between fixed presets, the interface clean and dark so the video always looks good, and the speed indicator sitting somewhere visible but not distracting so I always know where I am.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机视频播放器应用，播放速度控制要是核心体验，用一个流畅的滑块让我能微调速度，能真实感受到变化，而不是在固定的几个快进选项之间跳跃，界面要清爽深色，这样视频效果始终很好，速度指示器要放在显眼但不分散注意力的位置，我总是清楚现在播放速度是多少。

query_text: Need a mobile video player app where subtitle and caption handling feels as thoughtfully done as the rest of the experience, so I can tap once to turn captions on or off, choose a text style and size that is easy on the eyes against any background, and have the whole interface feel calm and unhurried rather than cluttered with settings I never use, just a clean screen where the words and the video breathe together.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机视频播放器应用，字幕和字幕处理要做得很考究，就像整个体验的其他部分一样，我轻点一下就能打开或关闭字幕，选择舒服的文本风格和大小，在任何背景上都清晰易读，整个界面要感觉镇定和不急不躁，没有乱七八糟的我从不用的设置，就是一个清爽的屏幕，文字和视频能和谐地呼吸。

query_text: Create a mobile video player app built around the idea that you should be able to keep watching even when life pulls you away from the main screen, so the player keeps the audio going when I switch to another app, and when I want to keep an eye on the video it floats as a small picture on my phone screen that I can move to a comfortable corner, the whole thing feeling effortless and unobtrusive rather than fiddly.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机视频播放器应用，核心理念是即使生活打断我离开主屏幕，我仍然可以继续看，所以当我切换到另一个应用时播放器能继续放音频，当我想继续看视频时，它能以小窗口浮在我的手机屏幕上，我可以拖动到舒服的位置，整个过程感觉要轻松不费劲，不是那种繁琐的。

query_text: Create a mobile music player app where the equalizer and sound tuning controls look and feel as good as the music sounds, with sliders for different frequencies laid out in a way that is visually satisfying to adjust, preset sound profiles you can tap between like warm, crisp, or deep, and the whole interface carrying the same aesthetic care as the listening experience itself, designed for a phone and easy to reach with one thumb.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机音乐播放器应用，均衡器和音效调节控制要看起来和用起来都和音乐的效果一样好，不同频率的滑块要排列得视觉上很舒服，可以在预设音效配置间轻点切换，比如温暖、清亮或深沉，整个界面要和聆听体验本身一样精心设计，要为手机优化，用一只大拇指就能轻松操作。

query_text: Create a mobile media player app that is specifically for stuff I have already saved to my phone, where the library looks beautiful even if the files are a mix of music and videos, with covers displayed in a way that feels like flipping through a personal collection, a simple way to organize things into groups, and playback that is smooth and immediate so it feels like opening a favorite book rather than navigating a file system.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机媒体播放器应用，专门用来播放我已经保存在手机里的文件，库看起来要很漂亮，即便文件是音乐和视频的混合，专辑封面要用感觉像翻阅个人收藏的方式展示，有简单的方式把东西分组整理，播放要流畅迅速，感觉就像打开一本最爱的书，而不是在浏览文件系统。

corpus_topic: Artist radio and smart shuffle mode
query_text: A mobile music app centered on artist radio and smart listening, where the whole experience is discovering music that feels connected to what you already love, so when I pick an artist the player builds a flowing mix that stays in the same emotional territory, the shuffle feels curated rather than random, and the now-playing screen on my phone shows enough context about each track to make the discovery feel intentional and warm.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机音乐应用，以艺人电台和智能听歌为中心，整个体验就是发现和你已经喜欢的音乐有关联的新音乐，当我选一个艺人时，播放器会编织一个流畅的混合歌单，始终保持在同样的感情领域，随机播放感觉是精心策划的而不是真随机，现在播放的屏幕显示足够的每首歌的背景信息，让发现感觉是有意图和温暖的。

query_text: Make a mobile headline testing tool where I can type two different versions of a title or caption side by side, see them both presented in a way that feels like real editorial context so I can actually feel which one lands better, add a quick note about why I prefer one, and save a few rounds of comparisons to look back on, something that helps me develop an eye for what works rather than just guessing.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机标题测试工具，我能在两个不同版本的标题或文案并排输入，看到它们都呈现在像真实编辑上下文一样的方式，这样我能真实感受哪个效果更好，加一个快速笔记说明我为什么更喜欢某一个，保存几个对比回顾，这个工具能帮助我培养眼光，而不是光凭猜测。

query_text: Create a mobile newsletter planner app that combines a simple template builder with a little calendar so I can sketch out what each issue will look and feel like, pick a layout that matches the mood of that edition, write a short note about the theme, and then mark the send date so everything lines up visually and I always know what is coming next, something that makes the whole process feel intentional and considered.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机新闻通讯计划应用，结合简单的模板生成器和小日历，我能勾勒每期通讯的样子和感觉，选择符合这期主题气质的布局，写一个简短的笔记说明这期的主题，然后标记发送日期，这样视觉上一切都对齐，我总是清楚下一期是什么，整个过程感觉有意图和经过深思熟虑。

query_text: Need a mobile app that is a thumbnail designer for YouTube videos, where I can quickly sketch out concept ideas for how a thumbnail should feel before I commit to making the real thing, trying different background moods, where the text sits, and whether the energy is calm or punchy, with a preview that shows roughly how it would look at small size in a feed, all on my phone so I can work on ideas whenever inspiration hits.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用，专门设计YouTube视频缩略图，我能快速画出缩略图应该是什么感觉的概念想法，在做真正的缩略图之前试试，尝试不同的背景氛围，文字放在哪里，能量是宁静还是劲爆，预览要大致显示它在订阅流中小尺寸时的样子，全在手机上做，这样灵感来了随时能工作。

corpus_topic: TikTok trend and hook idea explorer
query_text: Need a mobile app that is like a trend and hook idea explorer for short videos, where I can browse what kinds of openings and themes are catching people right now, organized by feeling rather than just hashtag, tap into any idea to see a brief breakdown of why it works visually and emotionally, and save the ones that feel right for what I am working on, something that helps me stay inspired rather than just copying what everyone else is doing.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用，就像短视频的趋势和开场想法浏览器，我能看最近什么样的开场和主题在吸引人，按感觉来分类而不是按主题标签，轻点任何想法看为什么它在视觉和情感上有效的简短分析，保存感觉适合我正在做的东西的那些，这个应该帮我保持灵感，而不是只是抄别人的。

query_text: A brand voice checker app for my phone where I can paste in a piece of writing, tell the app what tone and personality my brand is supposed to carry, and get back a simple read on whether the text actually sounds like that or has drifted into something generic or off, with a few highlighted phrases that feel inconsistent and suggestions that stay true to the original voice, so I can make quick fixes without losing the feeling I am going for.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机应用，是品牌声音检查器，我能粘贴一段文字，告诉应用我的品牌应该有什么样的语气和个性，然后得到一个简单的判断，这段文字听起来是否真的像我的品牌还是已经偏向了通用和不对，应用会突出几个不一致的短语和建议，这些建议要保持原来的声音特质，这样我能快速修改而不失去我想要的感觉。

query_text: Make a mobile writing app specifically for composing Twitter threads and longer social posts, where the whole interface is designed around the rhythm of writing in connected pieces, so I can type each part in its own block, see them stacked in order like a real thread, rearrange them with a simple tap-and-hold, and preview the whole thing looking polished before I copy it out, something that makes long-form social writing feel as satisfying as the posts themselves look.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机写作应用，专门用来写Twitter线程和更长的社交媒体文章，整个界面是以写作相连部分的节奏来设计的，我能在自己的文本框里写每一部分，看到它们按顺序堆叠得像真正的线程，用简单的点击并按住来重新排列，在复制出去之前预览整个东西看起来够不够精致，这个能让长文社交写作感觉和这些文章最后看起来一样令人满足。

query_text: Need a mobile news reader app that pulls in stories from a few topics I care about and shows them in a clean feed I can scroll through on my phone during a break, where each story has a short summary so I can decide if it is worth reading the full thing, I can mark ones to save for later, and the whole thing is simple enough that I am actually reading the news instead of fighting with the app to find what I want.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机新闻阅读应用，它从我关心的几个话题拉取新闻，在清爽的信息流中显示，我可以在休息时在手机上浏览，每个新闻都有简短摘要让我决定是否值得读全文，我能标记保存供稍后阅读，整个很简单，我是在真正读新闻而不是和应用较劲去找我想要的。

query_text: Create a news browsing app for my phone where I can set up a few topic areas I follow and then just get a steady feed of fresh stories from those areas every day, with each item showing the headline, a small image, and where it came from, so I can tap in when something looks interesting and come back to the feed easily without losing my place, just a tidy way to stay up on things I actually care about.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机新闻浏览应用，我能设置几个我关注的话题领域，然后每天就得到来自这些领域的新鲜新闻稳定流，每个条目显示标题、一个小图片和来源，我能轻点点击感兴趣的东西，轻松回到信息流又不丢失阅读位置，就是一个整洁的方式来了解我真正关心的事。

query_text: A little mobile news feed app where the experience feels like having a well-edited morning briefing in your pocket, stories grouped loosely by subject, each one with a clear headline and the source name so I know what I am reading, a way to swipe past things that are not relevant and have the feed adjust over time, and a reading view that is clean and comfortable on a phone screen so I actually enjoy catching up rather than just skimming.
query_text_zh: 做一个小手机新闻流应用，体验感觉像在你口袋里有一份精心编辑的晨间简报，新闻大致按主题分组，每一条都有清晰的标题和来源名称，这样我知道我在读什么，有办法快速划过不相关的内容，随着时间推移信息流会自我调整，阅读视图在手机屏幕上很清爽舒服，这样我真的享受追赶新闻而不是只是扫一眼。

query_text: Create a personalized news feed app for my phone where I pick a handful of subjects I am into when I first open it, and from then on the feed just shows me stories related to those subjects in the order they come in, with a clean card for each story showing the title and a line or two of preview text, a simple saved-for-later pile for things I want to read properly, and a way to add or swap topics whenever my interests shift.
query_text_zh: 做一个个性化新闻信息流应用给我的手机，我首次打开时选择几个感兴趣的话题，之后信息流就只显示和这些话题相关的新闻，按照新闻发出的顺序，每条新闻有一个清爽的卡片显示标题和一两行的预览文本，一个简单的稍后阅读堆放给我想好好读的东西，还能随时在我感兴趣的东西改变时添加或替换话题。

query_text: Need a news reader app that works well on my phone and makes it easy to follow a handful of topics without getting overwhelmed, where the feed is organized so the freshest stories show up at the top, I can tap a story to read the full text in a comfortable reading layout, and there is a simple bookmark feature so I can collect the pieces I want to come back to, something low-fuss that just helps me stay informed on the things I care about.
query_text_zh: 需要一个在我手机上表现很好的新闻阅读应用，能很容易地跟踪几个话题而不至于不知所措，信息流组织得很好最新的新闻显示在顶部，我能轻点一条新闻用舒适的阅读布局读全文，有一个简单的书签功能这样我能收集我想回来读的东西，没有麻烦的，只是帮助我在关心的事上保持信息灵通。

query_text: Create a news feed reader app for my phone where I can scroll through the latest stories from a mix of topics I care about, like tech and food, and each story card shows the headline and a small image so I can quickly decide if I want to read it, with a simple way to mark the ones I have already seen so they stop cluttering the feed.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机新闻信息流阅读应用，我能上下浏览来自我关心的各种话题的最新新闻，像科技和美食，每条新闻卡片都显示标题和一个小图片，这样我能快速决定是否想读，有一个简单的办法来标记我已经看过的新闻这样它们就不会继续堵在信息流里。

corpus_l2_key: ② 文章详情/阅读模式
query_text: Create a mobile article reader app that reads articles out loud to me so I can listen while I am doing something else, with a nice calm voice and a little bar at the bottom of the reading screen that shows how far along the narration is, and I want it to feel elegant and polished, like something I actually enjoy opening up rather than just a plain text player.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机文章阅读应用，能大声读出文章让我可以在做其他事时听，用一个好听的镇定的声音和一个小的进度条在阅读屏幕底部显示朗读进度，我希望它感觉优雅和精致，像我真的想打开的东西而不是一个普通的文本播放器。

corpus_l2_key: ② 文章详情/阅读模式
query_text: Make a bilingual reading app for my phone that shows an article in two languages at the same time, one on top and one below, so I can compare them as I read, with the two versions staying in sync as I scroll so I never lose my place, and the whole thing should feel clean and literary, like a well-designed book rather than a cluttered translation tool.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机双语阅读应用，同时显示一篇文章的两种语言，一种在上面一种在下面，这样我能在阅读时对比，两个版本保持同步随着我的滚动这样我从不丢失位置，整个应该感觉清爽和文学，像一本设计精良的书而不是混乱的翻译工具。

corpus_l2_key: ② 文章详情/阅读模式
query_text: Create a reader app for my phone where the comments section on any article is properly organized, with options to sort by most liked or by newest at the top so the good stuff floats up, and the whole comments area should feel warm and inviting to read through, with each comment having a clear author name and timestamp so it feels like a real conversation and not a wall of noise.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机阅读应用，任何文章的评论区要组织得当，有选项按最多喜欢或最新排序在顶部这样好的内容会浮起来，整个评论区应该感觉温暖和邀请阅读，每条评论都有清晰的作者名字和时间戳所以感觉像真正的对话而不是噪音墙。

corpus_l2_key: ② 文章详情/阅读模式
query_text: A save-for-later reading app for your phone where you tap a little bookmark icon on any article and it gets added to a personal reading list that feels curated and beautiful, almost like a magazine shelf, so when you open the list you see each saved article with its cover image and headline in a warm, tasteful layout that makes you actually want to sit down and read through everything you saved.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机稍后阅读应用，你轻点任何文章上的一个小书签图标它就被添加到感觉策划和美观的个人阅读列表，像一个杂志架，所以当你打开列表时你看到每篇保存的文章有它的封面图片和标题在一个温暖有品味的布局中，这让你真的想坐下来读通过你保存的所有东西。

corpus_l2_key: ② 文章详情/阅读模式
query_text: Need a mobile article reader app that can translate any article into my preferred language with one tap, so the translated version shows up right there in the same reading experience without jumping to another app or browser tab, and I want the translated text to look just as nice as the original, same clean fonts and spacing, so the reading vibe stays consistent no matter what language I switch to.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机文章阅读应用，能用一个轻点把任何文章翻译成我喜欢的语言，所以翻译版本就出现在同样的阅读体验里而不是跳到另一个应用或浏览器标签，我想翻译文本看起来和原文一样好看，同样的清爽字体和间距，这样无论我切换到什么语言阅读气质都保持一致。

corpus_l2_key: ② 文章详情/阅读模式
query_text: Make a mobile reading app with a beautiful dark mode that kicks in when I am reading at night, where the background goes a deep soft dark tone instead of harsh black, the text stays easy on the eyes in a warm off-white, and there is a simple toggle somewhere on the reading screen so I can flip between the light and dark looks depending on where I am and how I feel.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机阅读应用有一个漂亮的深色模式，当我晚上阅读时启动，背景变成深色柔和的色调而不是生硬的黑色，文本在温暖的米白色中仍然很容易读，阅读屏幕上某处有一个简单的切换所以我能根据我在哪里和我的感觉在亮和暗的样子之间切换。

corpus_topic: Content keyword mute and topic block
query_text: Build a news filter manager app for my phone where I can type in keywords I am tired of seeing, like certain celebrity names or topics I want to avoid, and those words get muted so stories containing them just disappear from my feed, plus I want to be able to block entire topic categories in one go, with a clear list showing everything I have muted so I can edit or remove any entry whenever I want.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机新闻过滤管理应用，我能输入我厌倦看的关键词，像某些名人或我想避免的话题，这些词会被静音所以包含它们的新闻就从我的信息流消失，加上我想能一次性屏蔽整个话题类别，有一个清单显示所有我静音的东西这样我能编辑或删除任何条目无论何时。

query_text: Need a news source manager app for my phone that lets me block or unsubscribe from specific publishers in just a tap or two, so their content stops showing up anywhere in my feed, and I want a tidy list of all the sources I follow so I can see at a glance which ones I have blocked and easily undo a block if I change my mind later.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机新闻来源管理应用让我能屏蔽或退订特定发布者只需一两个轻点，这样他们的内容就从我信息流的任何地方停止显示，我想要一个整洁的我关注的所有来源的列表所以我能一眼看清哪些我屏蔽了，轻易地撤销屏蔽如果我后来改主意的话。

query_text: An RSS feed reader app for my phone that lets me upload an OPML file to bring in all my existing subscriptions at once, so I do not have to add each one by hand, with the imported feeds organized into whatever folders were set up in the file, and a clear list screen where I can see all my channels, check when each was last updated, and tap into any one to read the latest posts.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机RSS信息流阅读应用让我能上传一个OPML文件来一次性导入我所有已有的订阅，这样我不必逐个添加，导入的信息流按文件中设置的任何文件夹组织，和一个清单屏幕我能看到所有我的频道，查看每一个最后更新的时间，轻点进去任何一个来读最新文章。

corpus_topic: Source credibility and bias rating display
query_text: Need a news reader app for my phone that shows me how trustworthy each news source is, with a simple rating next to each publisher's name that tells me whether the source leans left, right, or stays fairly neutral, and also whether it has a good track record for accuracy, so I can quickly decide how much to trust what I am reading and choose sources that are more reliable for my daily news.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机新闻阅读应用显示每个新闻来源有多可信任，每个发布者的名字旁边有一个简单的评级告诉我这个来源倾向左还是右还是保持相当中立，也是否有一个好的准确度记录，这样我能快速决定我要多信任我读的东西，选择更可靠的来源做我的日常新闻。

query_text: Build a paid newsletter manager app for my phone where I can see all the newsletters I subscribe to in one place, including what I pay for each one per month or year and when my renewal dates are, so I can keep track of what I am actually spending on newsletters, and tap into any subscription to go read the latest issue or pause and cancel it right from the app.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机付费新闻通讯管理应用我能在一个地方看到所有我订阅的新闻通讯，包括我为每一个每月或每年付多少和我的续期日期什么时候，这样我能跟踪我实际上在新闻通讯上花多少钱，轻点进去任何订阅去读最新一期或暂停和取消它就在应用里。

query_text: Build a topic-following app for my phone where I can search for any topic I am interested in, like space exploration or personal finance, follow it with one tap, and the app then suggests a handful of good sources that cover that topic so I can pick the ones I want to add to my feed, with a clear list on my profile showing all the topics I currently follow and how many sources I have added for each.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机话题跟踪应用我能搜索任何我感兴趣的话题，像太空探索或个人财务，用一个轻点跟踪它，应用然后建议一些覆盖这个话题的好来源这样我能选择哪些我想添加到我的信息流，一个清楚的列表在我的资料上显示所有我当前跟踪的话题和我为每个添加了多少来源。

query_text: Need a news filter app for my phone that lets me choose whether I want to see positive news, neutral reporting, or negative stories so I can skip all the doom and gloom on bad days and just read the uplifting stuff, with a simple selector at the top of my feed where I can switch between those three moods and the feed updates right away to show only the kind of stories I picked.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机新闻过滤应用让我选择我是想看积极新闻、中立报道还是负面故事这样我能在坏日子跳过所有悲观的东西只读提升心情的，在我的信息流顶部有一个简单的选择器我能在这三种情绪间切换和信息流立刻更新只显示我选择的那种新闻。

query_text: Need a mobile news app that has a switch I can flip to show only stories that have already been fact-checked, so I stop wasting time reading things that turn out to be wrong or misleading, and when the switch is on each story in the feed should have a small label showing who verified it, so I know the information has actually been checked by someone before it reached me.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机新闻应用有一个我能翻动的开关只显示已经被事实查证的新闻，这样我停止浪费时间读那些结果是错误或误导的东西，当开关打开时信息流中每条新闻应该有一个小标签显示谁验证了它，这样我知道这个信息在到达我之前实际上已经被某人检查过。

query_text: A news sorting app for my phone that defaults to showing the very latest stories at the top of the feed, with breaking news flagged clearly so it jumps out when something urgent is happening, and a simple toggle that lets me switch between sorted-by-time and sorted-by-topic so I can quickly find fresh updates on the things I care about without digging through a messy unsorted pile.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机新闻分类应用默认显示最新的新闻在信息流顶部，突发新闻清楚地标记所以当紧急的事发生时它会跳出来，和一个简单的切换让我能在按时间分类和按话题分类间快速切换这样我能轻松找到我关心的东西上的新鲜更新而不用在混乱未分类的堆里挖。

query_text: A news ranking app for my phone where I can sort my feed by what is getting the most reads or what people are sharing the most right now, so instead of guessing what matters today I can just see what everyone else is actually reading, with a clear number on each story card showing read count or share count, and tabs to switch between the two rankings whenever I want.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机新闻排名应用我能按最多阅读或人们现在分享最多的来分类我的信息流，所以与其猜测今天什么重要，我能只看每个人实际上在读什么，每条新闻卡片上有一个清晰的数字显示阅读计数或分享计数，和选项卡来在两个排名间切换无论何时我想。

query_text: Make a mobile news reader app where I can filter articles by how long they are, so when I only have five minutes I can tap a quick-reads option and only see short pieces, and when I have time to sit down I can switch to a long-form option that surfaces the deeper articles, with the app showing an estimated reading time on each story card so I always know what I am committing to before I open it.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机新闻阅读应用我能按它们有多长来过滤文章，所以当我只有五分钟时我能轻点一个快速阅读选项只看短片段，和当我有时间坐下来时我能切换到一个长篇选项显示更深入的文章，应用显示一个每条新闻卡片上的估计阅读时间这样我在打开它前总是知道我在承诺什么。

corpus_topic: Opinion vs reporting content type filter
query_text: Create a mobile news filter app that lets me separate opinion pieces from straight news reporting so I always know what kind of thing I am reading, with a filter at the top of my feed where I can tap to show only factual reporting, only opinion columns, or both mixed together, and each story card should have a small label that says whether it is a news report or someone's personal take before I even open it.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机新闻过滤应用让我把观点文章和直新闻报道分开这样我总是知道什么样的东西我在读，在我信息流顶部有一个过滤器我能轻点只显示事实报告，只显示评论专栏，或两个混在一起，每条新闻卡片应该有一个小标签说它是新闻报道还是某人的个人想法在我甚至打开它之前。

corpus_l2_key: ① 商品详情/规格选择
query_text: Create a mobile tool for my phone that helps me check whether accessories I am looking at buying will actually work with the device or product I already own, so I can enter my device model and then see a clear yes or no answer for each accessory, along with a short note explaining why something is or is not compatible, so I stop buying things that turn out not to fit.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机工具帮助我查证我想买的配件是否能和我已经有的设备或产品兼容，我能输入我的设备型号然后看每个配件有一个清楚的是或否答案，加上一个简短的说明解释为什么某些东西是或不是兼容，这样我停止买那些结果不能装的东西。

corpus_topic: Stock availability by size and color display
corpus_l2_key: ① 商品详情/规格选择
query_text: Make a mobile shopping app that shows stock levels organized by size and color on the product detail screen, so when I pick a size I can immediately see which color options are still in stock and which ones are sold out or nearly gone, with a simple visual indicator on each color that makes it obvious at a glance what is available so I do not add something to my cart only to find out it is out of stock.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机购物应用显示库存按尺码和颜色在产品细节屏幕上组织，所以当我选一个尺码我立刻能看哪个颜色选项仍然有库存哪些卖完了或快没了，每个颜色有一个简单的视觉指示符让一眼看清什么是可得的这样我不把什么东西加到我的购物车然后发现它没有库存。

query_text: Build a mobile shopping checkout app where I can redeem my loyalty points to lower my bill, so when I get to the payment screen it shows me how many points I have and how much money they are worth, and I can decide how many points to use with a simple slider or input, with the total price updating right away so I can see exactly how much I am saving before I confirm the order.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机购物结账应用我能用我的忠诚度点数来降低我的账单，所以当我到达付款屏幕时它显示我有多少点和它们值多少钱，我能决定用多少点一个简单的滑块或输入，总价立刻更新这样我能看清在我确认订单前我存多少钱。

query_text: Make a mobile shopping cart app that figures out bundle deals for me automatically, so when I add items that qualify for a buy-two-get-one or a percentage-off deal the discount just appears in the cart without me having to enter a code or do the math myself, with a clear breakdown showing which items triggered the deal and exactly how much I saved so I always know the final price before I pay.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机购物车应用它自动为我算出促销包，所以当我加入符合买二赠一或百分比折扣交易的物品时折扣就出现在购物车里没有我输入代码或自己做数学，有一个清楚的分解显示哪些物品触发了交易和精确我存多少钱这样我总是在付款前知道最终价格。

query_text: Build a mobile order tracker app where I can see the photo the delivery person took when they dropped off my package, so I have actual proof of where it was left and I do not have to wonder whether it was delivered or just marked delivered by mistake, with the photo showing up clearly on the order detail screen along with the delivery timestamp so I have everything in one place.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机订单跟踪应用我能看到当他们放下我的包裹时快递员拍的照片，这样我有实际证据说它在哪里被放下，我不必想知道它是否被送达或只是被错误地标记为已送达，照片要在订单细节屏幕上清楚显示加上送达时间戳这样我在一个地方有全部。

query_text: A delivery appointment scheduler app for my phone that handles packages needing a signature, where I can pick a time slot from a calendar that shows the available windows for my address, confirm the appointment in a couple of taps, and then get a reminder notification the morning of the delivery so I actually remember to be home, with all my upcoming scheduled deliveries listed clearly on the home screen of the app.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机送达预约调度应用为需要签名的包裹处理，我能从一个日历里选择时间槽显示我地址的可用窗口，在几个轻点中确认预约，然后在送达当天早上得到一个提醒通知这样我真的记得在家，所有我的即将安排的送达清楚地列在应用的主屏幕。
